  dateRow.createDiv({ cls: "dh-today-date", text: today.setLocale("ru").toFormat("cccc, d MMMM") });

  const badgesWrap = dateRow.createDiv({ cls: "dh-today-badges" });

  const actions = head.createDiv({ cls: "dh-actions" });
  actionButton(
    actions,
    note ? "\u041E\u0442\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u044C \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u044C \u0434\u043D\u044F" : "\u0421\u043E\u0437\u0434\u0430\u0442\u044C \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u044C \u0434\u043D\u044F",
    openToday,
    note ? "dh-btn" : "dh-btn mod-cta"
  );

  if (!note) {
    root.createDiv({
      cls: "dh-muted",
      text: "\u0417\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0438 \u0437\u0430 \u0441\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0434\u043D\u044F \u043F\u043E\u043A\u0430 \u043D\u0435\u0442. \u041D\u0430\u0436\u043C\u0438 \xAB\u0421\u043E\u0437\u0434\u0430\u0442\u044C \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u044C \u0434\u043D\u044F\xBB, \u0447\u0442\u043E\u0431\u044B \u043E\u0442\u043C\u0435\u0447\u0430\u0442\u044C \u043E\u0446\u0435\u043D\u043A\u0443, \u044D\u043D\u0435\u0440\u0433\u0438\u044E, \u043F\u0440\u0438\u0432\u044B\u0447\u043A\u0438, \u043F\u043E\u043A\u0430\u0437\u0430\u0442\u0435\u043B\u0438 \u0438 \u0433\u043B\u0430\u0432\u043D\u043E\u0435 \u0441\u043E\u0431\u044B\u0442\u0438\u0435 \u043F\u0440\u044F\u043C\u043E \u0441 \u0433\u043B\u0430\u0432\u043D\u043E\u0439.",
      attr: { style: "margin-top: 12px; font-size: 0.84rem;" }
    });
  } else {
    const file = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(note.file.path);
    const manualOverrides = getManualHabitOverrides();

    const saveField = (key, value) => enqueueFrontMatterSave(file, fm => {
      fm[key] = value;
    });

    const savedCalories = parseNum(note.\u043A\u0430\u043B\u043E\u0440\u0438\u0438_\u043A\u043A\u0430\u043B);
    const savedProtein = parseNum(note.\u0431\u0435\u043B\u043A\u0438_\u0433);
    const savedFat = parseNum(note.\u0436\u0438\u0440\u044B_\u0433);
    const savedCarbs = parseNum(note.\u0443\u0433\u043B\u0435\u0432\u043E\u0434\u044B_\u0433);
    const savedSleep = parseNum(note.\u0441\u043E\u043D_\u0447\u0430\u0441\u043E\u0432);
    const savedPages = parseNum(note.\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446_\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E);
    const savedFocus = parseNum(note.\u0433\u043B\u0443\u0431\u043E\u043A\u0430\u044F_\u0440\u0430\u0431\u043E\u0442\u0430_\u0447\u0430\u0441\u043E\u0432);
    const savedSocialMin = parseNum(note.\u0441\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0438_\u043C\u0438\u043D);
    const effectivePages = readingSync.autoBookPages > 0 && (savedPages === null || readingSync.totalPages > savedPages)
      ? readingSync.totalPages
      : savedPages;

    const states = new Map(HABITS.map(h => [h.key, typeof note[h.key] === "boolean" ? note[h.key] : null]));
    const pendingPatch = {};

    // 1. \u0410\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0441\u0438\u043D\u0445\u0440\u043E\u043D\u0438\u0437\u0430\u0446\u0438\u044F \u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446 \u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F \u0438\u0437 \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433 \u0438 \u043F\u0440\u0438\u0432\u044B\u0447\u043A\u0438 \xAB\u0427\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435\xBB
    if (readingSync.autoBookPages > 0 && (savedPages === null || readingSync.totalPages > savedPages)) {
      pendingPatch.\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446_\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E = readingSync.totalPages;
    }
    if ((effectivePages !== null && effectivePages > 0) || readingSync.readBookTitles.length > 0) {
      if (manualOverrides.\u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435 === undefined && states.get("\u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435") !== true) {
        states.set("\u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435", true);
        pendingPatch.\u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435 = true;
      }
    }

    // 2. \u0410\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0441\u0438\u043D\u0445\u0440\u043E\u043D\u0438\u0437\u0430\u0446\u0438\u044F \u043F\u0440\u0438\u0432\u044B\u0447\u043A\u0438 \xAB\u0422\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0430\xBB \u043F\u0440\u0438 \u043D\u0430\u043B\u0438\u0447\u0438\u0438 \u0441\u0435\u0441\u0441\u0438\u0438 \u0437\u0430 \u0441\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0434\u043D\u044F
    if (trainings.length > 0 && manualOverrides.\u0442\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0430 === undefined && states.get("\u0442\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0430") !== true) {
      states.set("\u0442\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0430", true);
      pendingPatch.\u0442\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0430 = true;
    }

    // 3. \u0410\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0441\u0438\u043D\u0445\u0440\u043E\u043D\u0438\u0437\u0430\u0446\u0438\u044F \u043F\u0440\u0438\u0432\u044B\u0447\u043A\u0438 \xAB\u0414\u0438\u0435\u0442\u0430\xBB \u0442\u043E\u043B\u044C\u043A\u043E \u0435\u0441\u043B\u0438 \u0432 my-nutrition-tracker \u0437\u0430\u0434\u0430\u043D\u0430 \u0434\u043D\u0435\u0432\u043D\u0430\u044F \u0446\u0435\u043B\u044C \u043A\u0430\u043B\u043E\u0440\u0438\u0439
    if (calorieGoal !== null && savedCalories !== null && savedCalories >= calorieGoal && manualOverrides.\u0434\u0438\u0435\u0442\u0430 === undefined && states.get("\u0434\u0438\u0435\u0442\u0430") !== true) {
      states.set("\u0434\u0438\u0435\u0442\u0430", true);
      pendingPatch.\u0434\u0438\u0435\u0442\u0430 = true;
    }

    // 4. \u0410\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0441\u0438\u043D\u0445\u0440\u043E\u043D\u0438\u0437\u0430\u0446\u0438\u044F \u043F\u0440\u0438\u0432\u044B\u0447\u043A\u0438 \xAB\u0420\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C \u0441\u043D\u0430\xBB \u043F\u0440\u0438 \u0441\u043D\u0435 > 6 \u0447\u0430\u0441\u043E\u0432
    if (savedSleep !== null && savedSleep > AUTO_SLEEP_MIN_HOURS && manualOverrides.\u0440\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C_\u0441\u043D\u0430 === undefined && states.get("\u0440\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C_\u0441\u043D\u0430") !== true) {
      states.set("\u0440\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C_\u0441\u043D\u0430", true);
      pendingPatch.\u0440\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C_\u0441\u043D\u0430 = true;
    }

    // 5. \u0410\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0441\u0438\u043D\u0445\u0440\u043E\u043D\u0438\u0437\u0430\u0446\u0438\u044F \u043F\u0440\u0438\u0432\u044B\u0447\u043A\u0438 \xAB\u0411\u0435\u0437 \u0441\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0435\u0439\xBB \u043F\u0440\u0438 \u0441\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0438_\u043C\u0438\u043D <= SOCIAL_LIMIT_MIN
    if (savedSocialMin !== null && manualOverrides.\u0431\u0435\u0437_\u0441\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0435\u0439 === undefined) {
      const withinLimit = savedSocialMin <= SOCIAL_LIMIT_MIN;
      if (states.get("\u0431\u0435\u0437_\u0441\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0435\u0439") !== withinLimit) {
        states.set("\u0431\u0435\u0437_\u0441\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0435\u0439", withinLimit);
        pendingPatch.\u0431\u0435\u0437_\u0441\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0435\u0439 = withinLimit;
      }
    }

    if (Object.keys(pendingPatch).length > 0) {
      enqueueFrontMatterSave(file, fm => {
        Object.assign(fm, pendingPatch);
      }).catch(e => console.log("Auto-sync error:", e));
    }

    const rawGoals = Array.isArray(note.\u0446\u0435\u043B\u0438_\u0434\u043D\u044F) ? note.\u0446\u0435\u043B\u0438_\u0434\u043D\u044F : [];
    const goalsState = rawGoals.map(g => ({
      text: String(g?.text ?? "\u0417\u0430\u0434\u0430\u0447\u0430").trim(),
      category: g?.category ? String(g.category).trim() : "",
      progress: Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(g?.progress) || 0))
    }));

    const calcPlanSummary = () => {
      const totalG = goalsState.length;
      if (!totalG) return { totalG: 0, doneG: 0, avgPct: 0 };
      const doneG = goalsState.filter(g => g.progress >= 100).length;
      const avgPct = Math.round(goalsState.reduce((acc, g) => acc + g.progress, 0) / totalG);
      return { totalG, doneG, avgPct };
    };

    const planHeadPill = badgesWrap.createSpan({ cls: "dh-status-pill" });
    const updatePlanHeadPill = () => {
      const { totalG, doneG, avgPct } = calcPlanSummary();
      if (totalG > 0) {
        const color = avgPct === 100 ? "#4aab80" : avgPct >= 60 ? "#599ed6" : "#e5a158";
        const icon = avgPct === 100 ? "\u2713" : "\u26A1";
        planHeadPill.setText(\`\${icon} \u041F\u043B\u0430\u043D \u0434\u043D\u044F: \${avgPct}% (\${doneG}/\${totalG})\`);
        planHeadPill.style.color = color;
        planHeadPill.style.borderColor = \`\${color}55\`;
        planHeadPill.style.background = \`\${color}14\`;
      } else {
        planHeadPill.setText("\u041F\u043B\u0430\u043D \u0434\u043D\u044F \u043D\u0435 \u0437\u0430\u0434\u0430\u043D");
        planHeadPill.style.color = "var(--text-muted)";
        planHeadPill.style.borderColor = "var(--background-modifier-border)";
        planHeadPill.style.background = "var(--background-primary)";
      }
    };
    updatePlanHeadPill();

    const habitsHeadPill = badgesWrap.createSpan({ cls: "dh-status-pill" });

    const body = root.createDiv({ cls: "dh-today-body" });
    const stateSection = body.createDiv({ cls: "dh-today-section" });

    function renderScaleRow(label, key) {
      const r = stateSection.createDiv({ cls: "dh-today-row" });
      const lblWrap = r.createDiv({ cls: "dh-today-row-label" });
      lblWrap.createSpan({ text: label });
      const valBadge = lblWrap.createSpan({ cls: "dh-today-row-sub" });

      const chips = r.createDiv({ cls: "dh-today-chips" });
      const parsedCurrent = parseNum(note[key]);
      let current = parsedCurrent !== null && parsedCurrent >= 1 && parsedCurrent <= 10 ? parsedCurrent : null;
      const buttons = [];

      const paint = () => {
        valBadge.setText(current !== null ? \`\${current}/10\` : "\u2014");
        buttons.forEach((b, idx) => {
          const isAct = current === idx + 1;
          b.classList.toggle("is-active", isAct);
          b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(isAct));
        });
      };

      for (let n = 1; n <= 10; n++) {
        const b = actionButton(chips, String(n), async () => {
          const prev = current;
          const next = current === n ? null : n;
          current = next;
          paint();
          try {
            await saveField(key, next);
          } catch (err) {
            current = prev;
            paint();
            throw err;
          }
        }, "dh-chip dh-score");
        b.style.setProperty("--chip-color", COLORS[n - 1]);
        b.setAttribute("aria-label", \`\${label}: \${n}\`);
        buttons.push(b);
      }
      paint();
    }

    renderScaleRow("\u041E\u0446\u0435\u043D\u043A\u0430 \u0434\u043D\u044F", "\u043E\u0446\u0435\u043D\u043A\u0430_\u0434\u043D\u044F");
    renderScaleRow("\u042D\u043D\u0435\u0440\u0433\u0438\u044F", "\u044D\u043D\u0435\u0440\u0433\u0438\u044F");

    const habitsRow = stateSection.createDiv({ cls: "dh-today-row" });
    const habitsLabelWrap = habitsRow.createDiv({ cls: "dh-today-row-label" });
    habitsLabelWrap.createSpan({ text: "\u041F\u0440\u0438\u0432\u044B\u0447\u043A\u0438" });
    const habitsCountSub = habitsLabelWrap.createSpan({ cls: "dh-today-row-sub" });
    const habitChips = habitsRow.createDiv({ cls: "dh-today-chips" });

    const habitPainters = new Map();
    const updateHabitsSummary = () => {
      const done = [...states.values()].filter(v => v === true).length;
      habitsCountSub.setText(\`\${done}/\${HABITS.length}\`);
      habitsHeadPill.setText(\`\u041F\u0440\u0438\u0432\u044B\u0447\u043A\u0438: \${done}/\${HABITS.length}\`);
      const isAllDone = done === HABITS.length;
      habitsHeadPill.style.color = isAllDone ? "#4aab80" : "var(--text-muted)";
      habitsHeadPill.style.borderColor = isAllDone ? "#4aab8055" : "var(--background-modifier-border)";
      habitsHeadPill.style.background = isAllDone ? "#4aab8014" : "var(--background-primary)";
    };

    for (const h of HABITS) {
      const b = actionButton(habitChips, "", async () => {
        const prev = states.get(h.key);
        const next = prev !== true;
        states.set(h.key, next);
        setManualHabitOverride(h.key, next);
        paintHabit();
        updateHabitsSummary();
        try {
          await saveField(h.key, next);
        } catch (err) {
          states.set(h.key, prev);
          paintHabit();
          updateHabitsSummary();
          throw err;
        }
      }, "dh-chip dh-habit-chip");

      b.style.setProperty("--chip-color", h.color);
      const checkIcon = b.createSpan({ cls: "dh-habit-check" });
      b.createSpan({ text: h.name });

      const paintHabit = () => {
        const s = states.get(h.key);
        const isDone = s === true;
        b.classList.toggle("is-active", isDone);
        b.classList.toggle("is-unknown", s === null);
        b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(isDone));
        b.setAttribute("title", isDone ? \`\${h.name}: \u0432\u044B\u043F\u043E\u043B\u043D\u0435\u043D\u043E (\u043D\u0430\u0436\u043C\u0438, \u0447\u0442\u043E\u0431\u044B \u0441\u043D\u044F\u0442\u044C)\` : \`\${h.name}: \u043D\u0435 \u043E\u0442\u043C\u0435\u0447\u0435\u043D\u043E\`);
        checkIcon.setText(isDone ? "\u2713" : "\u25CB");
      };

      habitPainters.set(h.key, paintHabit);
      paintHabit();
    }
    updateHabitsSummary();

    const metricsGrid = body.createDiv({ cls: "dh-metrics-grid" });
    const inputRefs = new Map();

    // \u0424\u0443\u043D\u043A\u0446\u0438\u044F \u043E\u0442\u0440\u0438\u0441\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0438 \u043E\u0431\u044B\u0447\u043D\u043E\u0433\u043E \u043F\u043E\u043B\u044F \u0432\u0432\u043E\u0434\u0430 (\u0412\u0435\u0441, \u0421\u043E\u043D, \u0427\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435)
    const renderInputMetricCard = (m) => {
      const card = metricsGrid.createEl("label", { cls: "dh-metric-item" });
      const top = card.createDiv({ cls: "dh-metric-top" });
      top.createSpan({ cls: "dh-metric-label", text: m.label });
      const statusSpan = top.createSpan({ cls: "dh-metric-status" });

      const control = card.createDiv({ cls: "dh-metric-control" });
      const input = control.createEl("input", {
        cls: "dh-metric-input",
        attr: {
          type: "text",
          inputmode: m.digits > 0 ? "decimal" : "numeric",
          placeholder: m.placeholder,
          "aria-label": \`\${m.label}, \${m.unit}\`
        }
      });
      control.createSpan({ cls: "dh-metric-unit", text: m.unit });

      if (m.hint) {
        const subHint = card.createDiv({ cls: "dh-metric-subhint", text: m.hint });
        if (m.key === "\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446_\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E" && readingSync.readBookTitles.length > 0) {
          subHint.setAttribute("title", "\u041A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0438 \u0441\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0434\u043D\u044F: " + readingSync.readBookTitles.join(", "));
        }
      }

      const errorEl = card.createDiv({ cls: "dh-metric-error" });
      errorEl.style.display = "none";

      const savedRaw = m.key === "\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446_\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E" ? effectivePages : note[m.key];
      const savedFormatted = formatNumForInput(savedRaw, m.digits);
      const hasDraft = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(uiDrafts.inputs, m.key);
      input.value = hasDraft ? uiDrafts.inputs[m.key] : savedFormatted;

      if (uiDrafts.errors[m.key]) {
        card.classList.add("is-invalid");
        errorEl.setText(uiDrafts.errors[m.key]);
        errorEl.style.display = "block";
      } else if (uiDrafts.savedStamp[m.key] && Date.now() - uiDrafts.savedStamp[m.key] < 2200) {
        statusSpan.setText("\u2713");
        setTimeout(() => { if (statusSpan.isConnected) statusSpan.setText(""); }, 1800);
      }

      input.onfocus = () => {
        uiDrafts.activeKey = m.key;
      };

      input.oninput = () => {
        uiDrafts.inputs[m.key] = input.value;
        uiDrafts.selectionStart = input.selectionStart;
        uiDrafts.selectionEnd = input.selectionEnd;
        if (uiDrafts.errors[m.key]) {
          delete uiDrafts.errors[m.key];
          card.classList.remove("is-invalid");
          errorEl.style.display = "none";
        }
      };

      input.onkeydown = e => {
        if (e.key === "Enter") {
          e.preventDefault();
          input.blur();
        } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
          e.preventDefault();
          delete uiDrafts.inputs[m.key];
          delete uiDrafts.errors[m.key];
          card.classList.remove("is-invalid");
          errorEl.style.display = "none";
          input.value = savedFormatted;
          input.blur();
        }
      };

      let isSavingMetric = false;
      const commitMetric = async () => {
        if (isSavingMetric) return;
        if (uiDrafts.activeKey === m.key) uiDrafts.activeKey = null;

        const rawTrimmed = input.value.trim();
        const normalized = rawTrimmed.replace(",", ".");

        if (normalized === "") {
          delete uiDrafts.inputs[m.key];
          delete uiDrafts.errors[m.key];
          card.classList.remove("is-invalid");
          errorEl.style.display = "none";
          if (savedFormatted === "") return;
          isSavingMetric = true;
          try {
            if (m.key === "\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446_\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E") {
              updateReadingManualOffset(0, readingSync.autoBookPages);
            }
            await saveField(m.key, null);
            uiDrafts.savedStamp[m.key] = Date.now();
            statusSpan.setText("\u2713");
          } catch (err) {
            notify(\`\u041D\u0435 \u0443\u0434\u0430\u043B\u043E\u0441\u044C \u043E\u0447\u0438\u0441\u0442\u0438\u0442\u044C \xAB\${m.label}\xBB: \${err?.message ?? err}\`);
          } finally {
            isSavingMetric = false;
          }
          return;
        }

        const numVal = parseNum(normalized);
        if (numVal === null || numVal < m.min || numVal > m.max) {
          const msg = \`\u041D\u0443\u0436\u043D\u043E \u0447\u0438\u0441\u043B\u043E \${m.min}\u2013\${m.max} \${m.unit}\`;
          uiDrafts.errors[m.key] = msg;
          card.classList.add("is-invalid");
          errorEl.setText(msg);
          errorEl.style.display = "block";
          return;
        }

        const finalValue = Math.round(numVal * 10 ** m.digits) / 10 ** m.digits;
        const finalFormatted = formatNumForInput(finalValue, m.digits);
        input.value = finalFormatted;
        delete uiDrafts.inputs[m.key];
        delete uiDrafts.errors[m.key];
        card.classList.remove("is-invalid");
        errorEl.style.display = "none";

        let autoHabitKey = null;
        let autoHabitVal = null;

        if (m.key === "\u0441\u043E\u043D_\u0447\u0430\u0441\u043E\u0432") {
          autoHabitKey = "\u0440\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C_\u0441\u043D\u0430";
          autoHabitVal = finalValue > AUTO_SLEEP_MIN_HOURS;
        } else if (m.key === "\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446_\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E") {
          updateReadingManualOffset(finalValue, readingSync.autoBookPages);
          autoHabitKey = "\u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435";
          autoHabitVal = finalValue > 0;
        } else if (m.key === "\u0441\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0438_\u043C\u0438\u043D") {
          autoHabitKey = "\u0431\u0435\u0437_\u0441\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0435\u0439";
          autoHabitVal = finalValue <= SOCIAL_LIMIT_MIN;
        }

        const habitNeedsUpdate = autoHabitKey !== null && states.get(autoHabitKey) !== autoHabitVal;
        if (finalFormatted === savedFormatted && typeof savedRaw === "number" && !habitNeedsUpdate) return;

        isSavingMetric = true;
        try {
          if (autoHabitKey !== null) {
            setManualHabitOverride(autoHabitKey, undefined);
            states.set(autoHabitKey, autoHabitVal);
            habitPainters.get(autoHabitKey)?.();
            updateHabitsSummary();
          }

          await enqueueFrontMatterSave(file, fm => {
            fm[m.key] = finalValue;
            if (autoHabitKey !== null) {
              fm[autoHabitKey] = autoHabitVal;
            }
          });
          uiDrafts.savedStamp[m.key] = Date.now();
          statusSpan.setText("\u2713");
        } catch (err) {
          uiDrafts.inputs[m.key] = rawTrimmed;
          notify(\`\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u0441\u043E\u0445\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F \xAB\${m.label}\xBB: \${err?.message ?? err}\`);
        } finally {
          isSavingMetric = false;
        }
      };

      input.onchange = commitMetric;
      input.onblur = commitMetric;
      inputRefs.set(m.key, input);
    };

    // \u0424\u0443\u043D\u043A\u0446\u0438\u044F \u043E\u0442\u0440\u0438\u0441\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0438 \u0432\u0440\u0435\u043C\u0435\u043D\u0438 (\u041E\u0442\u0431\u043E\u0439 \u0438 \u041F\u043E\u0434\u044A\u0451\u043C \u0441 \u0430\u0432\u0442\u043E\u043F\u043E\u0434\u0441\u0447\u0451\u0442\u043E\u043C \u0441\u043D\u0430)
    const renderTimeMetricCard = (label, key, placeholder, hint) => {
      const card = metricsGrid.createEl("label", { cls: "dh-metric-item" });
      const top = card.createDiv({ cls: "dh-metric-top" });
      top.createSpan({ cls: "dh-metric-label", text: label });
      const statusSpan = top.createSpan({ cls: "dh-metric-status" });

      const control = card.createDiv({ cls: "dh-metric-control" });
      const input = control.createEl("input", {
        cls: "dh-metric-input",
        attr: {
          type: "text",
          placeholder,
          "aria-label": label,
          style: "width: 72px !important; text-align: center !important;"
        }
      });
      control.createSpan({ cls: "dh-metric-unit", text: "" });

      if (hint) {
        card.createDiv({ cls: "dh-metric-subhint", text: hint });
      }

      const errorEl = card.createDiv({ cls: "dh-metric-error" });
      errorEl.style.display = "none";

      const savedVal = typeof note[key] === "string" ? note[key].trim() : "";
      const hasDraft = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(uiDrafts.inputs, key);
      input.value = hasDraft ? uiDrafts.inputs[key] : savedVal;

      if (uiDrafts.errors[key]) {
        card.classList.add("is-invalid");
        errorEl.setText(uiDrafts.errors[key]);
        errorEl.style.display = "block";
      } else if (uiDrafts.savedStamp[key] && Date.now() - uiDrafts.savedStamp[key] < 2200) {
        statusSpan.setText("\u2713");
        setTimeout(() => { if (statusSpan.isConnected) statusSpan.setText(""); }, 1800);
      }

      input.onfocus = () => { uiDrafts.activeKey = key; };
      input.oninput = () => {
        uiDrafts.inputs[key] = input.value;
        if (uiDrafts.errors[key]) {
          delete uiDrafts.errors[key];
          card.classList.remove("is-invalid");
          errorEl.style.display = "none";
        }
      };

      input.onkeydown = e => {
        if (e.key === "Enter") {
          e.preventDefault();
          input.blur();
        } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
          e.preventDefault();
          delete uiDrafts.inputs[key];
          delete uiDrafts.errors[key];
          card.classList.remove("is-invalid");
          errorEl.style.display = "none";
          input.value = savedVal;
          input.blur();
        }
      };

      let isSavingTime = false;
      const commitTime = async () => {
        if (isSavingTime) return;
        if (uiDrafts.activeKey === key) uiDrafts.activeKey = null;

        const raw = input.value.trim();
        if (raw === "") {
          delete uiDrafts.inputs[key];
          delete uiDrafts.errors[key];
          card.classList.remove("is-invalid");
          errorEl.style.display = "none";
          if (savedVal === "") return;
          isSavingTime = true;
          try {
            await saveField(key, null);
            uiDrafts.savedStamp[key] = Date.now();
            statusSpan.setText("\u2713");
          } catch (err) {
            notify(\`\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u043E\u0447\u0438\u0441\u0442\u043A\u0438 \xAB\${label}\xBB: \${err?.message ?? err}\`);
          } finally {
            isSavingTime = false;
          }
          return;
        }

        const normalized = normalizeTimeString(raw);
        if (!normalized) {
          const msg = "\u0424\u043E\u0440\u043C\u0430\u0442: \u0427\u0427:\u041C\u041C (\u043D\u0430\u043F\u0440. 23:30)";
          uiDrafts.errors[key] = msg;
          card.classList.add("is-invalid");
          errorEl.setText(msg);
          errorEl.style.display = "block";
          return;
        }

        input.value = normalized;
        delete uiDrafts.inputs[key];
        delete uiDrafts.errors[key];
        card.classList.remove("is-invalid");
        errorEl.style.display = "none";

        if (normalized === savedVal) return;

        isSavingTime = true;
        try {
          const counterpartKey = key === "\u043E\u0442\u0431\u043E\u0439" ? "\u043F\u043E\u0434\u044A\u0451\u043C" : "\u043E\u0442\u0431\u043E\u0439";
          const counterpartVal = typeof note[counterpartKey] === "string" ? note[counterpartKey].trim() : "";
          const otboy = key === "\u043E\u0442\u0431\u043E\u0439" ? normalized : counterpartVal;
          const podjom = key === "\u043F\u043E\u0434\u044A\u0451\u043C" ? normalized : counterpartVal;
          const autoSleep = computeSleepDurationHours(otboy, podjom);

          let autoSleepHabit = null;
          if (autoSleep !== null) {
            autoSleepHabit = autoSleep > AUTO_SLEEP_MIN_HOURS;
            if (manualOverrides.\u0440\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C_\u0441\u043D\u0430 === undefined) {
              states.set("\u0440\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C_\u0441\u043D\u0430", autoSleepHabit);
              habitPainters.get("\u0440\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C_\u0441\u043D\u0430")?.();
              updateHabitsSummary();
            }
          }

          await enqueueFrontMatterSave(file, fm => {
            fm[key] = normalized;
            if (autoSleep !== null) {
              fm["\u0441\u043E\u043D_\u0447\u0430\u0441\u043E\u0432"] = autoSleep;
              if (autoSleepHabit !== null && manualOverrides.\u0440\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C_\u0441\u043D\u0430 === undefined) {
                fm["\u0440\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C_\u0441\u043D\u0430"] = autoSleepHabit;
              }
            }
          });

          if (autoSleep !== null && inputRefs.has("\u0441\u043E\u043D_\u0447\u0430\u0441\u043E\u0432")) {
            inputRefs.get("\u0441\u043E\u043D_\u0447\u0430\u0441\u043E\u0432").value = formatNumForInput(autoSleep, 1);
          }

          uiDrafts.savedStamp[key] = Date.now();
          statusSpan.setText("\u2713");
        } catch (err) {
          uiDrafts.inputs[key] = raw;
          notify(\`\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u0441\u043E\u0445\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F \xAB\${label}\xBB: \${err?.message ?? err}\`);
        } finally {
          isSavingTime = false;
        }
      };

      input.onchange = commitTime;
      input.onblur = commitTime;
      inputRefs.set(key, input);
    };

    // \u0420\u042F\u0414 1: \u0412\u0435\u0441, \u041A\u0430\u043B\u043E\u0440\u0438\u0438, \u0421\u043E\u043D (\u0430\u0432\u0442\u043E/\u0440\u0443\u0447\u043D\u043E\u0439), \u0427\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435
    renderInputMetricCard(INPUT_METRICS[0]); // \u0412\u0435\u0441

    // \u041A\u0430\u043B\u043E\u0440\u0438\u0438 (\u0438\u0437 \u043F\u043B\u0430\u0433\u0438\u043D\u0430 my-nutrition-tracker)
    {
      const calCard = metricsGrid.createDiv({
        cls: "dh-metric-item is-clickable",
        attr: {
          role: "button",
          tabindex: "0",
          title: "\u041D\u0430\u0436\u043C\u0438, \u0447\u0442\u043E\u0431\u044B \u043E\u0442\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u044C \u0434\u043D\u0435\u0432\u043D\u0438\u043A \u043F\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u0438\u044F \u0438 \u0434\u043E\u0431\u0430\u0432\u0438\u0442\u044C \u043F\u0440\u0438\u0451\u043C \u043F\u0438\u0449\u0438"
        }
      });
      const top = calCard.createDiv({ cls: "dh-metric-top" });
      top.createSpan({ cls: "dh-metric-label", text: "\u041A\u0430\u043B\u043E\u0440\u0438\u0438" });
      top.createSpan({
        cls: "dh-metric-status",
        text: "\u{1F957} \uFF0B",
        attr: { style: "color: var(--interactive-accent);" }
      });

      const control = calCard.createDiv({ cls: "dh-metric-control" });
      control.createSpan({
        cls: "dh-metric-readonly-val",
        text: savedCalories !== null ? String(Math.round(savedCalories)) : "\u2014"
      });
      control.createSpan({
        cls: "dh-metric-unit",
        text: calorieGoal !== null ? \`/ \${calorieGoal} \u043A\u043A\u0430\u043B\` : "\u043A\u043A\u0430\u043B"
      });

      let calHint = "\u043D\u0430\u0436\u043C\u0438, \u0447\u0442\u043E\u0431\u044B \u0432\u043D\u0435\u0441\u0442\u0438 \u0435\u0434\u0443";
      if (savedProtein !== null || savedFat !== null || savedCarbs !== null) {
        calHint = \`\u0411:\${Math.round(savedProtein || 0)} \xB7 \u0416:\${Math.round(savedFat || 0)} \xB7 \u0423:\${Math.round(savedCarbs || 0)} \u0433\`;
      } else if (calorieGoal !== null) {
        calHint = \`\u0430\u0432\u0442\u043E-\u0434\u0438\u0435\u0442\u0430 \u2265\${calorieGoal} \u043A\u043A\u0430\u043B\`;
      }
      calCard.createDiv({ cls: "dh-metric-subhint", text: calHint });

      calCard.onclick = () => openNutritionFromHome();
      calCard.onkeydown = e => {
        if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
          e.preventDefault();
          openNutritionFromHome();
        }
      };
    }

    renderInputMetricCard(INPUT_METRICS[1]); // \u0421\u043E\u043D
    renderInputMetricCard(INPUT_METRICS[2]); // \u0427\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435

    // \u0420\u042F\u0414 2: \u0424\u043E\u043A\u0443\u0441 (my-focus-tracker), \u041E\u0442\u0431\u043E\u0439, \u041F\u043E\u0434\u044A\u0451\u043C, \u0421\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0438 (\u043C\u0438\u043D), \u0428\u0430\u0433\u0438
    // \u041A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043A\u0430 \xAB\u0424\u043E\u043A\u0443\u0441\xBB
    {
      const focusCard = metricsGrid.createDiv({
        cls: "dh-metric-item is-clickable",
        attr: {
          role: "button",
          tabindex: "0",
          title: "\u041D\u0430\u0436\u043C\u0438, \u0447\u0442\u043E\u0431\u044B \u043E\u0442\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u044C \u0442\u0430\u0439\u043C\u0435\u0440 \u0433\u043B\u0443\u0431\u043E\u043A\u043E\u0439 \u0440\u0430\u0431\u043E\u0442\u044B (my-focus-tracker)"
        }
      });
      const top = focusCard.createDiv({ cls: "dh-metric-top" });
      top.createSpan({ cls: "dh-metric-label", text: "\u0424\u043E\u043A\u0443\u0441" });
      top.createSpan({
        cls: "dh-metric-status",
        text: "\u23F1\uFE0F \uFF0B",
        attr: { style: "color: #9c83e8;" }
      });

      const control = focusCard.createDiv({ cls: "dh-metric-control" });
      control.createSpan({
        cls: "dh-metric-readonly-val",
        text: savedFocus !== null ? String(savedFocus).replace(".", ",") : "\u2014"
      });
      control.createSpan({
        cls: "dh-metric-unit",
        text: "\u0447"
      });

      const focusPlugin = getFocusPlugin();
      const activeSession = focusPlugin?.session;
      let focusHint = "\u043D\u0430\u0436\u043C\u0438 \u0434\u043B\u044F \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0443\u0441\u043A\u0430 \u0442\u0430\u0439\u043C\u0435\u0440\u0430";
      if (activeSession && activeSession.isRunning) {
        focusHint = \`\u0438\u0434\u0451\u0442: \${activeSession.project}\`;
      } else if (savedFocus !== null && savedFocus > 0) {
        focusHint = "\u0441\u0435\u0441\u0441\u0438\u0438 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0430\u043D\u044B";
      }
      focusCard.createDiv({ cls: "dh-metric-subhint", text: focusHint });

      focusCard.onclick = () => openFocusTrackerFromHome();
      focusCard.onkeydown = e => {
        if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
          e.preventDefault();
          openFocusTrackerFromHome();
        }
      };
    }

    renderTimeMetricCard("\u041E\u0442\u0431\u043E\u0439", "\u043E\u0442\u0431\u043E\u0439", "23:30", "\u0432\u0440\u0435\u043C\u044F \u0437\u0430\u0441\u044B\u043F\u0430\u043D\u0438\u044F");
    renderTimeMetricCard("\u041F\u043E\u0434\u044A\u0451\u043C", "\u043F\u043E\u0434\u044A\u0451\u043C", "07:15", "\u0432\u0440\u0435\u043C\u044F \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0431\u0443\u0436\u0434\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F");
    renderInputMetricCard(INPUT_METRICS[3]); // \u0421\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0438 (\u043C\u0438\u043D)
    renderInputMetricCard(INPUT_METRICS[4]); // \u0428\u0430\u0433\u0438

    const bottomGrid = body.createDiv({ cls: "dh-today-bottom-grid" });

    if (goalsState.length > 0) {
      const planBox = bottomGrid.createDiv({ cls: "dh-plan-box" });
      const planHead = planBox.createDiv({ cls: "dh-plan-head" });
      planHead.createSpan({ cls: "dh-plan-title", text: "\u041F\u043B\u0430\u043D \u0434\u043D\u044F (\u0437\u0430\u0434\u0430\u0447\u0438 \u0438\u0437 \u0435\u0436\u0435\u0434\u043D\u0435\u0432\u043D\u0438\u043A\u0430)" });
      const planMeta = planHead.createSpan({ cls: "dh-today-row-sub" });

      const barTrack = planBox.createDiv({ cls: "dh-plan-bar-track" });
      const barFill = barTrack.createDiv({ cls: "dh-plan-bar-fill" });

      const planList = planBox.createDiv({ cls: "dh-plan-list" });
      const itemPainters = [];

      const refreshPlanUI = () => {
        const { totalG, doneG, avgPct } = calcPlanSummary();
        planMeta.setText(\`\${avgPct}% \xB7 \u0432\u044B\u043F\u043E\u043B\u043D\u0435\u043D\u043E \${doneG} \u0438\u0437 \${totalG}\`);
        barFill.style.width = \`\${avgPct}%\`;
        barFill.style.background = avgPct === 100 ? "#4aab80" : avgPct >= 60 ? "#599ed6" : "#e5a158";
        updatePlanHeadPill();
        itemPainters.forEach(fn => fn());
      };

      goalsState.forEach((goal, idx) => {
        const item = planList.createDiv({
          cls: "dh-plan-item",
          attr: { role: "button", tabindex: "0", title: "\u041D\u0430\u0436\u043C\u0438, \u0447\u0442\u043E\u0431\u044B \u043E\u0442\u043C\u0435\u0442\u0438\u0442\u044C \u0437\u0430\u0434\u0430\u0447\u0443 \u0432\u044B\u043F\u043E\u043B\u043D\u0435\u043D\u043D\u043E\u0439 (100% / 0%)" }
        });

        const left = item.createDiv({ cls: "dh-plan-item-left" });
        const check = left.createSpan({ cls: "dh-plan-check" });
        left.createSpan({
          cls: "dh-plan-text",
          text: goal.category ? \`\${goal.text} (\${goal.category})\` : goal.text
        });
        const pctSpan = item.createSpan({ cls: "dh-plan-pct" });

        const paintGoalItem = () => {
          const isDone = goal.progress >= 100;
          item.classList.toggle("is-done", isDone);
          check.setText(isDone ? "\u2713" : "");
          pctSpan.setText(\`\${goal.progress}%\`);
        };
        itemPainters.push(paintGoalItem);

        let isTogglingGoal = false;
        const toggleGoal = async () => {
          if (isTogglingGoal) return;
          isTogglingGoal = true;
          const prevProgress = goal.progress;
          goal.progress = prevProgress >= 100 ? 0 : 100;
          refreshPlanUI();

          try {
            await enqueueFrontMatterSave(file, fm => {
              const fmGoals = Array.isArray(fm.\u0446\u0435\u043B\u0438_\u0434\u043D\u044F) ? fm.\u0446\u0435\u043B\u0438_\u0434\u043D\u044F : [];
              if (fmGoals[idx] && typeof fmGoals[idx] === "object") {
                fmGoals[idx].progress = goal.progress;
              }
              const total = fmGoals.length;
              fm.\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0433\u0440\u0435\u0441\u0441_\u0434\u043D\u044F_\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0446\u0435\u043D\u0442 = total > 0
                ? Math.round(fmGoals.reduce((acc, g) => acc + (Number(g?.progress) || 0), 0) / total)
                : 0;
            });
          } catch (err) {
            goal.progress = prevProgress;
            refreshPlanUI();
            notify(\`\u041D\u0435 \u0443\u0434\u0430\u043B\u043E\u0441\u044C \u043E\u0431\u043D\u043E\u0432\u0438\u0442\u044C \u0437\u0430\u0434\u0430\u0447\u0443: \${err?.message ?? err}\`);
          } finally {
            isTogglingGoal = false;
          }
        };

        item.onmousedown = e => e.preventDefault();
        item.onclick = toggleGoal;
        item.onkeydown = e => {
          if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
            e.preventDefault();
            toggleGoal();
          }
        };
      });

      refreshPlanUI();
    }

    const eventRow = bottomGrid.createDiv({ cls: "dh-event-row" });
    const eventLabelWrap = eventRow.createDiv({ cls: "dh-today-row-label" });
    eventLabelWrap.createSpan({ text: "\u0413\u043B\u0430\u0432\u043D\u043E\u0435 \u0441\u043E\u0431\u044B\u0442\u0438\u0435" });
    const eventStatus = eventLabelWrap.createSpan({ cls: "dh-today-row-sub" });

    const eventControl = eventRow.createDiv({ cls: "dh-event-control" });
    const savedEvent = typeof note.\u0433\u043B\u0430\u0432\u043D\u043E\u0435_\u0441\u043E\u0431\u044B\u0442\u0438\u0435 === "string" ? note.\u0433\u043B\u0430\u0432\u043D\u043E\u0435_\u0441\u043E\u0431\u044B\u0442\u0438\u0435.trim() : "";
    const hasEventDraft = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(uiDrafts.inputs, "\u0433\u043B\u0430\u0432\u043D\u043E\u0435_\u0441\u043E\u0431\u044B\u0442\u0438\u0435");

    const eventInput = eventControl.createEl("input", {
      cls: "dh-event-input",
      attr: {

  const SOCIAL_LIMIT_MIN = 30; // \u043B\u0438\u043C\u0438\u0442 \u0434\u043E\u0444\u0430\u043C\u0438\u043D\u043E\u0432\u043E\u0433\u043E \u0441\u043A\u0440\u043E\u043B\u043B\u0438\u043D\u0433\u0430 \u0441\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0435\u0439 (\u043C\u0438\u043D/\u0434\u0435\u043D\u044C)
  const HABITS = [
    { key: "nofap", name: "NoFap", color: "#9c83e8" },
    { key: "\u0442\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0430", name: "\u0422\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0438", color: "#d69852" },
    { key: "\u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435", name: "\u0427\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435", color: "#599ed6" },
    { key: "\u0440\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C_\u0441\u043D\u0430", name: "\u0420\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C \u0441\u043D\u0430", color: "#69b5aa" },
    { key: "\u0434\u0438\u0435\u0442\u0430", name: "\u0414\u0438\u0435\u0442\u0430", color: "#8bac5e" },
    { key: "\u0431\u0435\u0437_\u0441\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0435\u0439", name: "\u0411\u0435\u0437 \u0441\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0435\u0439", color: "#e06c75" },

  const COLORS = [
    "#d85b57", "#d97354", "#d98c54", "#d9a554", "#c5ad55",

  const MONTHS = ["\u044F\u043D\u0432", "\u0444\u0435\u0432", "\u043C\u0430\u0440", "\u0430\u043F\u0440", "\u043C\u0430\u0439", "\u0438\u044E\u043D", "\u0438\u044E\u043B", "\u0430\u0432\u0433", "\u0441\u0435\u043D", "\u043E\u043A\u0442", "\u043D\u043E\u044F", "\u0434\u0435\u043A"];
  const WEEKDAYS = ["\u041F\u043D", "\u0412\u0442", "\u0421\u0440", "\u0427\u0442", "\u041F\u0442", "\u0421\u0431", "\u0412\u0441"];

  const empty = v => v == null || v === "";
  function asDate(v) {
    if (empty(v)) return null;
    try { const d = dv.date(v); return d && d.isValid ? d.startOf("day") : null; } catch { return null; }
  }
  const score = v => typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v) && v >= 1 && v <= 10 ? v : null;
  const average = a => a.length ? a.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0) / a.length : null;
  const fmt = (v, minDigits = 0, maxDigits = 1) => v == null ? "\u2014" : v.toLocaleString("ru-RU", {
    minimumFractionDigits: minDigits,
    maximumFractionDigits: maxDigits
  });
  const mtime = p => { try { return p.file.mtime?.toMillis?.() ?? 0; } catch { return 0; } };
  const today = dv.date("today").startOf("day");
  const todayISO = today.toISODate();
  const from30Date = today.minus({ days: 29 });

  const problems = [];
  const groups = new Map();
  for (const p of dv.pages(SOURCE)) {
    const d = asDate(p.\u0434\u0430\u0442\u0430);
    if (!d) { problems.push([p.file.link, "\u041D\u0435\u0442 \u043A\u043E\u0440\u0440\u0435\u043A\u0442\u043D\u043E\u0439 \u0434\u0430\u0442\u044B \u2014 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u044C \u043D\u0435 \u0443\u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0430."]); continue; }
    if (d > today) continue;
    const iso = d.toISODate();
    if (!groups.has(iso)) groups.set(iso, []);
    groups.get(iso).push(p);
  }
  const byDate = new Map();
  for (const [iso, list] of groups) {
    list.sort((a, b) => mtime(b) - mtime(a) || a.file.path.localeCompare(b.file.path, "ru"));
    byDate.set(iso, list[0]);
    if (list.length > 1) problems.push([list.map(p => p.file.link), \`\${dv.date(iso).toFormat("dd.MM.yyyy")}: \${list.length} \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0438 \u0437\u0430 \u043E\u0434\u0438\u043D \u0434\u0435\u043D\u044C. \u0423\u0447\u0438\u0442\u044B\u0432\u0430\u0435\u0442\u0441\u044F \u043F\u043E\u0441\u043B\u0435\u0434\u043D\u044F\u044F \u0438\u0437\u043C\u0435\u043D\u0451\u043D\u043D\u0430\u044F.\`]);
  }
  const entries = [...byDate.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[0].localeCompare(a[0]));
  for (const [, p] of entries) {
    for (const key of ["\u043E\u0446\u0435\u043D\u043A\u0430_\u0434\u043D\u044F", "\u044D\u043D\u0435\u0440\u0433\u0438\u044F"]) {
      if (!empty(p[key]) && score(p[key]) === null) problems.push([p.file.link, \`\${key}: \u043D\u0443\u0436\u043D\u043E \u0447\u0438\u0441\u043B\u043E \u043E\u0442 1 \u0434\u043E 10.\`]);
    }
    for (const h of HABITS) {
      if (!empty(p[h.key]) && typeof p[h.key] !== "boolean") problems.push([p.file.link, \`\${h.key}: \u043D\u0443\u0436\u0435\u043D \u0444\u043B\u0430\u0436\u043E\u043A true/false, \u0430 \u043D\u0435 \u0442\u0435\u043A\u0441\u0442.\`]);
    }
  }

  const days = n => Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => today.minus({ days: n - 1 - i }));
  const recent = days(30).map(d => byDate.get(d.toISODate())).filter(Boolean);
  const scores = recent.map(p => score(p.\u043E\u0446\u0435\u043D\u043A\u0430_\u0434\u043D\u044F)).filter(s => s !== null);
  const energies = recent.map(p => score(p.\u044D\u043D\u0435\u0440\u0433\u0438\u044F)).filter(s => s !== null);

  const periodCompletedScores = (startOffset, length) =>
    Array.from({ length }, (_, i) => byDate.get(today.minus({ days: startOffset + i }).toISODate()))
      .filter(Boolean)
      .map(p => score(p.\u043E\u0446\u0435\u043D\u043A\u0430_\u0434\u043D\u044F))
      .filter(s => s !== null);

  const week = periodCompletedScores(1, 7);
  const before = periodCompletedScores(8, 7);
  const weekMean = average(week), beforeMean = average(before);

  const range30Str = \`\${from30Date.toFormat("dd.MM.yyyy")}\u2013\${today.toFormat("dd.MM.yyyy")}\`;
  const curWeekRange = \`\${today.minus({ days: 7 }).toFormat("dd.MM")}\u2013\${today.minus({ days: 1 }).toFormat("dd.MM")}\`;
  const prevWeekRange = \`\${today.minus({ days: 14 }).toFormat("dd.MM")}\u2013\${today.minus({ days: 8 }).toFormat("dd.MM")}\`;

  const root = dv.container.createDiv({ cls: "dh" });

  function section(title, hint) {
    const s = root.createDiv({ cls: "dh-section" });
    s.createDiv({ cls: "dh-section-title", text: title });
    if (hint) s.createDiv({ cls: "dh-muted", text: hint });
    return s;
  }
  const open = p => app.workspace.openLinkText(p.file.path, dv.currentFilePath, false);
  function dayButton(parent, cls, p, label) {
    const b = parent.createEl("button", { cls, attr: { type: "button", title: label, "aria-label": label } });
    b.disabled = !p;
    if (p) b.onclick = () => open(p);
    return b;
  }

  const stats = root.createDiv({

      style: "display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(210px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; position: relative; z-index: 30;"

  let activePinnedCard = null;

  function createMinimalCard({ label, value, tone, accent, rows }) {
    const c = stats.createDiv({
      cls: "dh-card",
      attr: {
        tabindex: "0",

        \`
      }
    });

    c.onmousedown = e => e.preventDefault();
    c.createDiv({ cls: "dh-card-label", text: label });
    c.createDiv({ cls: \`dh-card-value\${tone ? " dh-" + tone : ""}\`, text: value });

    const popover = c.createDiv({
      attr: {
        style: \`
          position: absolute;
          left: 0;
          right: 0;
          top: calc(100% + 8px);
          z-index: 90;
          padding: 10px 12px;
          border-radius: 8px;
          background: var(--background-secondary);
          border: 1px solid \${accent}66;
          box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32);
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          gap: 6px;
          font-size: 0.75rem;
          line-height: 1.3;
          opacity: 0;
          visibility: hidden;
          transform: translateY(-4px);
          pointer-events: none;
          transition: opacity 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), visibility 0.18s;
        \`
      }
    });

    rows.forEach((r, idx) => {
      const rowEl = popover.createDiv({
        attr: {
          style: \`
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            \${idx > 0 ? "padding-top: 5px; border-top: 1px solid var(--background-modifier-border);" : ""}
          \`
        }
      });

      rowEl.createSpan({
        text: r.k,
        attr: { style: "color: var(--text-muted);" }
      });

      if (r.minMax) {
        const mmWrap = rowEl.createDiv({ attr: { style: "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;" } });
        mmWrap.createSpan({
          text: \`\u043C\u0438\u043D \${r.minMax.min}\`,
          attr: {
            style: "font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: #d85b571a; color: #d85b57;"
          }
        });
        mmWrap.createSpan({
          text: \`\u043C\u0430\u043A\u0441 \${r.minMax.max}\`,
          attr: {
            style: "font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: #4aab801a; color: #4aab80;"
          }
        });
      } else {
        rowEl.createSpan({
          text: r.v,
          attr: {
            style: \`font-weight: 600; color: \${r.vColor || "var(--text-normal)"}; text-align: right;\`
          }
        });
      }
    });

    const setVisualState = (isOpen) => {
      c.style.borderColor = isOpen ? accent : "var(--background-modifier-border)";
      c.style.borderTop = \`2px solid \${isOpen ? accent : accent + "88"}\`;
      c.style.boxShadow = isOpen ? "0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18)" : "none";
      c.style.transform = isOpen ? "translateY(-1px)" : "translateY(0)";

      popover.style.opacity = isOpen ? "1" : "0";
      popover.style.visibility = isOpen ? "visible" : "hidden";
      popover.style.transform = isOpen ? "translateY(0)" : "translateY(-4px)";
      c.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(isOpen));
    };

    c.onpointerenter = (e) => {
      if (e.pointerType === "mouse") setVisualState(true);
    };
    c.onpointerleave = (e) => {
      if (e.pointerType === "mouse" && activePinnedCard !== c) setVisualState(false);
    };

    c.onclick = (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (activePinnedCard === c) {
        activePinnedCard = null;
        setVisualState(false);
      } else {
        if (activePinnedCard) activePinnedCard._closePopover?.();
        activePinnedCard = c;
        setVisualState(true);
      }
    };

    c._closePopover = () => setVisualState(false);
  }

  root.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (activePinnedCard) {
      activePinnedCard._closePopover?.();
      activePinnedCard = null;
    }
  });

  // 1. \u0421\u0440\u0435\u0434\u043D\u044F\u044F \u043E\u0446\u0435\u043D\u043A\u0430 \xB7 30 \u0434\u043D\u0435\u0439
  const meanScore30 = average(scores);
  createMinimalCard({
    label: "\u0421\u0440\u0435\u0434\u043D\u044F\u044F \u043E\u0446\u0435\u043D\u043A\u0430 \xB7 30 \u0434\u043D\u0435\u0439",
    value: meanScore30 !== null ? fmt(meanScore30, 0, 1) : "\u2014",
    tone: null,
    accent: "#e5a158",
    rows: scores.length
      ? [
          { k: "\u041F\u0435\u0440\u0438\u043E\u0434", v: range30Str },
          { k: "\u0417\u0430\u043F\u043E\u043B\u043D\u0435\u043D\u043E", v: \`\${scores.length} \u0438\u0437 30 \u0434\u043D. \xB7 \u0448\u043A\u0430\u043B\u0430 1\u201310\` },
          { k: "\u0420\u0430\u0437\u0431\u0440\u043E\u0441", minMax: { min: fmt(Math.min(...scores)), max: fmt(Math.max(...scores)) } }
        ]
      : [
          { k: "\u041F\u0435\u0440\u0438\u043E\u0434", v: range30Str },
          { k: "\u0414\u0430\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0435", v: "\u041E\u0446\u0435\u043D\u043E\u043A \u043F\u043E\u043A\u0430 \u043D\u0435\u0442 (\u0448\u043A\u0430\u043B\u0430 1\u201310)", vColor: "var(--text-muted)" }
        ]
  });

  // 2. \u041E\u0446\u0435\u043D\u043A\u0430 \xB7 \u043D\u0435\u0434\u0435\u043B\u044F \u043A \u043D\u0435\u0434\u0435\u043B\u0435
  const hasEnoughWeekData = week.length >= MIN_WEEK_DAYS && before.length >= MIN_WEEK_DAYS;
  let weekDeltaText = "\u2014";
  let weekDeltaTone = null;

  if (hasEnoughWeekData) {
    const rawDelta = weekMean - beforeMean;
    const roundedDelta = Math.round(rawDelta * 10) / 10;
    if (Object.is(roundedDelta, -0) || Math.abs(roundedDelta) < 0.05) {
      weekDeltaText = "0,0";
      weekDeltaTone = "flat";
    } else if (roundedDelta > 0) {
      weekDeltaText = \`+\${fmt(roundedDelta, 1, 1)}\`;
      weekDeltaTone = "up";
    } else {
      weekDeltaText = \`\u2212\${fmt(Math.abs(roundedDelta), 1, 1)}\`;
      weekDeltaTone = "down";
    }
  }

  createMinimalCard({
    label: "\u041E\u0446\u0435\u043D\u043A\u0430 \xB7 \u043D\u0435\u0434\u0435\u043B\u044F \u043A \u043D\u0435\u0434\u0435\u043B\u0435",
    value: weekDeltaText,
    tone: weekDeltaTone,
    accent: "#599ed6",
    rows: hasEnoughWeekData
      ? [
          { k: \`\u0422\u0435\u043A\u0443\u0449\u0438\u0435 7 \u0434\u043D. (\${curWeekRange})\`, v: \`\${fmt(weekMean, 1, 1)} \xB7 \${week.length}/7 \u0434\u043D.\` },
          { k: \`\u041F\u0440\u0435\u0434. 7 \u0434\u043D. (\${prevWeekRange})\`, v: \`\${fmt(beforeMean, 1, 1)} \xB7 \${before.length}/7 \u0434\u043D.\` },
          { k: "\u0428\u043A\u0430\u043B\u0430", v: "1\u201310 \xB7 \u0437\u0430\u0432\u0435\u0440\u0448\u0451\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0435 \u0434\u043D\u0438" }
        ]
      : [
          { k: "\u0421\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0443\u0441", v: "\u041D\u0435\u0434\u043E\u0441\u0442\u0430\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043D\u043E \u0434\u0430\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0445 \u0434\u043B\u044F \u0441\u0440\u0430\u0432\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F", vColor: "#e5a158" },
          { k: \`\u0422\u0435\u043A\u0443\u0449\u0438\u0435 7 \u0434\u043D. (\${curWeekRange})\`, v: \`\${week.length}/7 \u0434\u043D. (\u043D\u0443\u0436\u043D\u043E \u2265\${MIN_WEEK_DAYS})\` },
          { k: \`\u041F\u0440\u0435\u0434. 7 \u0434\u043D. (\${prevWeekRange})\`, v: \`\${before.length}/7 \u0434\u043D. (\u043D\u0443\u0436\u043D\u043E \u2265\${MIN_WEEK_DAYS})\` }
        ]
  });

  // 3. \u0421\u0440\u0435\u0434\u043D\u044F\u044F \u044D\u043D\u0435\u0440\u0433\u0438\u044F \xB7 30 \u0434\u043D\u0435\u0439
  const meanEnergy30 = average(energies);
  createMinimalCard({
    label: "\u0421\u0440\u0435\u0434\u043D\u044F\u044F \u044D\u043D\u0435\u0440\u0433\u0438\u044F \xB7 30 \u0434\u043D\u0435\u0439",
    value: meanEnergy30 !== null ? fmt(meanEnergy30, 0, 1) : "\u2014",
    tone: null,
    accent: "#69b5aa",
    rows: energies.length
      ? [
          { k: "\u041F\u0435\u0440\u0438\u043E\u0434", v: range30Str },
          { k: "\u0417\u0430\u043F\u043E\u043B\u043D\u0435\u043D\u043E", v: \`\${energies.length} \u0438\u0437 30 \u0434\u043D. \xB7 \u0448\u043A\u0430\u043B\u0430 1\u201310\` },
          { k: "\u0420\u0430\u0437\u0431\u0440\u043E\u0441", minMax: { min: fmt(Math.min(...energies)), max: fmt(Math.max(...energies)) } }
        ]
      : [
          { k: "\u041F\u0435\u0440\u0438\u043E\u0434", v: range30Str },
          { k: "\u0414\u0430\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0435", v: "\u0417\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0435\u0439 \u043F\u043E\u043A\u0430 \u043D\u0435\u0442 (\u0448\u043A\u0430\u043B\u0430 1\u201310)", vColor: "var(--text-muted)" }
        ]
  });

  // \u041A\u0430\u043B\u0435\u043D\u0434\u0430\u0440\u044C
  {
    const cal = section("");
    cal.classList.add("dh-calendar-v2");

    const doc = cal.ownerDocument;
    const win = doc.defaultView;

    const style = cal.createEl("style");
    /* CSS \u043F\u0435\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0435\u0441\u0451\u043D \u0432 \u0433\u043B\u043E\u0431\u0430\u043B\u044C\u043D\u044B\u0439 styles.css \u043F\u043B\u0430\u0433\u0438\u043D\u0430 */

    const panel = cal.createDiv({ cls: "dhc-panel" });
    const monthsGrid = panel.createDiv({ cls: "dhc-months" });

    const tip = doc.body.createDiv({
      cls: "dhc-calendar-popover-v2",
      attr: {
        role: "dialog",
        "aria-label": "\u0421\u0432\u0435\u0434\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F \u043E \u0434\u043D\u0435",
        "aria-hidden": "true"
      }
    });

    tip.id = \`dhc-pop-\${Date.now()}-\${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}\`;

    let activeCell = null;
    let pinned = false;
    let closeTimer = null;
    let frame = null;

    function cancelClose() {
      if (closeTimer !== null) {
        win.clearTimeout(closeTimer);
        closeTimer = null;
      }
    }

    function hideTip() {
      cancelClose();
      if (activeCell) {
        activeCell.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      }
      tip.classList.remove("is-open");
      tip.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      activeCell = null;
      pinned = false;
    }

    function placeTip() {
      if (!activeCell || !activeCell.isConnected) {
        hideTip();
        return;
      }

      const cellRect = activeCell.getBoundingClientRect();
      const tipWidth = tip.offsetWidth;
      const tipHeight = tip.offsetHeight;
      const viewportWidth = win.innerWidth;
      const viewportHeight = win.innerHeight;
      const margin = 10;
      const gap = 8;

      if (
        cellRect.bottom < 0 ||
        cellRect.top > viewportHeight ||
        cellRect.right < 0 ||
        cellRect.left > viewportWidth
      ) {
        hideTip();
        return;
      }

      const centeredLeft = cellRect.left + cellRect.width / 2 - tipWidth / 2;
      const left = Math.max(margin, Math.min(centeredLeft, viewportWidth - tipWidth - margin));

      const above = cellRect.top - tipHeight - gap;
      const below = cellRect.bottom + gap;
      let top = above >= margin ? above : below;
      top = Math.max(margin, Math.min(top, viewportHeight - tipHeight - margin));

      tip.style.left = \`\${left}px\`;
      tip.style.top = \`\${top}px\`;
    }

    function requestPosition() {
      if (!activeCell || frame !== null) return;
      frame = win.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        frame = null;
        placeTip();
      });
    }

    function scheduleClose() {
      cancelClose();
      if (pinned) return;

      closeTimer = win.setTimeout(() => {
        closeTimer = null;
        if (pinned) return;
        if (tip.matches(":hover")) return;
        if (tip.contains(doc.activeElement)) return;
        if (activeCell?.matches(":hover")) return;
        if (activeCell?.matches(":focus-visible")) return;
        hideTip();
      }, 180);
    }

    function showTip(cell, date, p, s, event, pin = false) {
      cancelClose();
      if (pinned && activeCell !== cell && !pin) return;
      if (activeCell && activeCell !== cell) {
        activeCell.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      }

      activeCell = cell;
      pinned = pin;

      cell.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
      tip.replaceChildren();

      const accent = s !== null ? COLORS[Math.round(s) - 1] : "var(--text-muted)";
      tip.style.setProperty("--dhc-pop-accent", accent);

      tip.createDiv({
        cls: "dhc-pop-date",
        text: date.setLocale("ru").toFormat("d MMMM yyyy, cccc")
      });

      if (!p) {
        tip.createDiv({ cls: "dhc-pop-empty", text: "\u041D\u0435\u0442 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0438" });
      } else {
        const scoreRow = tip.createDiv({ cls: "dhc-pop-score" });
        scoreRow.createSpan({ cls: "dhc-pop-label", text: "\u041E\u0446\u0435\u043D\u043A\u0430 \u0434\u043D\u044F" });
        scoreRow.createSpan({
          cls: "dhc-pop-value",
          text: s !== null ? \`\${fmt(s)}/10\` : "\u041D\u0435 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u043E\u043B\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0430"
        });

        const eventBox = tip.createDiv({ cls: "dhc-pop-event" });
        eventBox.createDiv({ cls: "dhc-pop-event-label", text: "\u0413\u043B\u0430\u0432\u043D\u043E\u0435 \u0441\u043E\u0431\u044B\u0442\u0438\u0435" });
        eventBox.createDiv({
          cls: \`dhc-pop-event-text\${event ? "" : " dhc-pop-empty"}\`,
          text: event || "\u041D\u0435 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0430\u043D\u043E"
        });

        const openButton = tip.createEl("button", {
          cls: "dhc-open-note",
          text: "\u041E\u0442\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u044C \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u044C",
          attr: { type: "button" }
        });

        openButton.onclick = e => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          hideTip();
          open(p);
        };
      }

      tip.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
      placeTip();
      tip.classList.add("is-open");
    }

    tip.addEventListener("pointerenter", cancelClose);
    tip.addEventListener("pointerleave", scheduleClose);
    tip.addEventListener("focusin", cancelClose);
    tip.addEventListener("focusout", scheduleClose);

    dv.component.registerDomEvent(doc, "pointerdown", e => {
      if (activeCell && !activeCell.contains(e.target) && !tip.contains(e.target)) {
        hideTip();
      }
    });

    dv.component.registerDomEvent(doc, "keydown", e => {
      if (e.key !== "Escape" || !activeCell) return;
      const cell = activeCell;
      const focusWasInTip = tip.contains(doc.activeElement);
      hideTip();
      if (focusWasInTip) {
        cell.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        hideTip();
      }
    });

    dv.component.registerDomEvent(win, "resize", requestPosition);
    dv.component.registerDomEvent(doc, "scroll", requestPosition, true);

      cancelClose();
      if (frame !== null) win.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      tip.remove();

          if (activeCell === cell && pinned) {
            cancelClose();
            return;

        });

        cell.addEventListener("pointerleave", e => {
          if (e.pointerType === "mouse") scheduleClose();
        });

        cell.addEventListener("focus", () => {
          if (cell.matches(":focus-visible")) {
            showTip(cell, date, p, s, event);
          }
        });

        cell.addEventListener("blur", scheduleClose);

        cell.addEventListener("click", e => {
          const isMouseClick = e.detail > 0 && pointerType === "mouse";
          if (isMouseClick && p) {
            hideTip();
            open(p);
            return;
          }
          if (activeCell === cell && pinned) {
            hideTip();
          } else {
            showTip(cell, date, p, s, event, true);
          }
        });
      }

    const parseValidNum = (v, minVal, maxVal, allowZero = false) => {
      if (empty(v) || typeof v === "boolean") return null;
      const n = typeof v === "number" ? v : Number(String(v).trim().replace(",", "."));
      if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return null;
      if (!allowZero && n <= 0) return null;
      if (n < minVal || n > maxVal) return null;

    const formatSigned = (rawDiff, minD = 0, maxD = 1, unit = "") => {
      if (rawDiff == null || !Number.isFinite(rawDiff)) return "\u2014";
      const factor = 10 ** maxD;
      const rounded = Math.round(rawDiff * factor) / factor;
      const suffix = unit ? \` \${unit}\` : "";
      if (Object.is(rounded, -0) || Math.abs(rounded) < (maxD > 0 ? 0.05 : 0.5)) {
        return \`0\${minD > 0 ? "," + "0".repeat(minD) : ""}\${suffix}\`;
      }
      const sign = rounded > 0 ? "+" : "\u2212";
      return \`\${sign}\${fmt(Math.abs(rounded), minD, maxD)}\${suffix}\`;
