      { slots: getWindowSlot(1, 7),  label: \`\${today.minus({ days: 7 }).toFormat("dd.MM")}\u2013\${today.minus({ days: 1 }).toFormat("dd.MM")}\` }
    ];

    function buildHabitDetails(h, bestAllTime, totalAllTime) {
      const key = h.key;

      const evalSlots = (slotList) => {
        const marked = slotList.filter(s => state(s.page, key) !== null);
        const done = marked.filter(s => s.page[key] === true);
        const explicitMisses = marked.filter(s => s.page[key] === false && s.activeNote);
        const blankTemplateStubs = marked.filter(s => s.page[key] === false && !s.activeNote);
        const rate = marked.length > 0 ? Math.round((done.length / marked.length) * 100) : null;
        return { totalDays: slotList.length, marked, done, explicitMisses, blankTemplateStubs, rate };
      };

      const s30 = evalSlots(slots30);
      const wCur = evalSlots(slotsCur7);
      const wPrev = evalSlots(slotsPrev7);
      const weeks4 = fourWeeksSlots.map(w => ({ ...w, stats: evalSlots(w.slots) }));

      const runs30 = [];
      let curRun = null;
      for (const s of slots30) {
        if (state(s.page, key) === true) {
          if (!curRun) curRun = { len: 1, start: s.date, end: s.date };
          else { curRun.len++; curRun.end = s.date; }
        } else if (curRun) {
          runs30.push(curRun);
          curRun = null;
        }
      }
      if (curRun) runs30.push(curRun);

      const maxRun30 = runs30.reduce((bestR, r) => (!bestR || r.len > bestR.len ? r : bestR), null);
      const avgRun30 = runs30.length ? average(runs30.map(r => r.len)) : null;

      const findLastRecovery = () => {
        let lastExplicitFalseIdx = -1;
        for (let i = slots30.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
          const s = slots30[i];
          if (state(s.page, key) === false && s.activeNote) {
            const hasTrueAfter = slots30.slice(i + 1).some(x => state(x.page, key) === true);
            if (hasTrueAfter) {
              lastExplicitFalseIdx = i;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        if (lastExplicitFalseIdx === -1) return null;
        const missDate = slots30[lastExplicitFalseIdx].date;
        let streakAfter = 0;
        for (let j = lastExplicitFalseIdx + 1; j < slots30.length; j++) {
          if (state(slots30[j].page, key) === true) streakAfter++;
          else if (state(slots30[j].page, key) === false && slots30[j].activeNote) break;
        }
        return streakAfter > 0 ? { missDate, streakAfter } : null;
      };

      const getWeekdayWeekendDiff = () => {
        const wdMarked = s30.marked.filter(s => s.date.weekday <= 5);
        const weMarked = s30.marked.filter(s => s.date.weekday >= 6);
        if (wdMarked.length < HABIT_MIN_GROUP_SIZE * 2 || weMarked.length < HABIT_MIN_GROUP_SIZE) return null;
        const wdDone = wdMarked.filter(s => s.page[key] === true).length;
        const weDone = weMarked.filter(s => s.page[key] === true).length;
        const wdRate = Math.round((wdDone / wdMarked.length) * 100);
        const weRate = Math.round((weDone / weMarked.length) * 100);
        if (Math.abs(wdRate - weRate) < 20) return null;
        return { wdDone, wdTotal: wdMarked.length, wdRate, weDone, weTotal: weMarked.length, weRate };
      };

      const formatFlagWeekComparison = (labelPrefix = "\u0412\u044B\u043F\u043E\u043B\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435") => {
        if (wCur.marked.length < HABIT_MIN_WEEK_MARKED || wPrev.marked.length < HABIT_MIN_WEEK_MARKED) {
          return \`\u041C\u0430\u043B\u043E \u043E\u0442\u043C\u0435\u0447\u0435\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0445 \u0434\u043D\u0435\u0439 \u0434\u043B\u044F \u0441\u0440\u0430\u0432\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F \u043D\u0435\u0434\u0435\u043B\u044C (\${wCur.marked.length}/7 \u0438 \${wPrev.marked.length}/7, \u043D\u0443\u0436\u043D\u043E \u2265\${HABIT_MIN_WEEK_MARKED}).\`;
        }
        const curStr = \`\${wCur.done.length} \u0438\u0437 \${wCur.marked.length}\`;
        const prevStr = \`\${wPrev.done.length} \u0438\u0437 \${wPrev.marked.length}\`;
        const comparable = Math.abs(wCur.marked.length - wPrev.marked.length) <= HABIT_MAX_WEEK_GAP;
        if (comparable && wCur.rate !== null && wPrev.rate !== null) {
          const diffPP = wCur.rate - wPrev.rate;
          const ppText = diffPP === 0 ? "\u0431\u0435\u0437 \u0438\u0437\u043C\u0435\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0439 (0 \u043F.\u043F.)" : \`\${diffPP > 0 ? "+" : "\u2212"}\${Math.abs(diffPP)} \u043F.\u043F.\`;
          return \`\${labelPrefix}: \${curStr} \u0434\u043D. (\${curWeekRange}) \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0442\u0438\u0432 \${prevStr} \u0434\u043D. (\${prevWeekRange}) \xB7 \${ppText}.\`;
        }
        return \`\${labelPrefix}: \${curStr} \u043E\u0442\u043C. \u0434\u043D. (\${curWeekRange}) \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0442\u0438\u0432 \${prevStr} \u043E\u0442\u043C. \u0434\u043D. (\${prevWeekRange}).\`;
      };

      const keyMetrics = [];
      let whatChanged = "";
      const observations = [];

      if (key === "nofap") {
        keyMetrics.push({
          k: "\u0417\u0430 30 \u0437\u0430\u0432\u0435\u0440\u0448\u0451\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0445 \u0434\u043D.",
          v: s30.marked.length ? \`\${s30.done.length} \u0438\u0437 \${s30.marked.length} \u0434\u043D. (\${s30.rate}%)\` : "\u041D\u0435\u0442 \u0434\u0430\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0445"
        });
        keyMetrics.push({
          k: "\u041B\u0443\u0447\u0448\u0430\u044F \u0441\u0435\u0440\u0438\u044F (30 \u0434\u043D.)",
          v: maxRun30 ? \`\${maxRun30.len} \u0434\u043D. \u043F\u043E\u0434\u0440\u044F\u0434\` : "0 \u0434\u043D."
        });
        keyMetrics.push({
          k: "\u0421\u0440\u0435\u0434\u043D\u044F\u044F \u0441\u0435\u0440\u0438\u044F (30 \u0434\u043D.)",
          v: avgRun30 !== null ? \`\${fmt(avgRun30, 0, 1)} \u0434\u043D. (\u0441\u0435\u0440\u0438\u0439: \${runs30.length})\` : "\u2014"
        });

        whatChanged = formatFlagWeekComparison("\u0427\u0438\u0441\u0442\u044B\u0435 \u0434\u043D\u0438");

        if (s30.marked.length >= HABIT_MIN_MONTH_MARKED) {
          const recovery = findLastRecovery();
          if (recovery) {
            observations.push(
              \`\u041F\u043E\u0441\u043B\u0435 \u0434\u043D\u044F \u0431\u0435\u0437 \u043E\u0442\u043C\u0435\u0442\u043A\u0438 \u0432\u044B\u043F\u043E\u043B\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F (\${recovery.missDate.toFormat("dd.MM")}) \u0441\u0435\u0440\u0438\u044F \u0432\u043E\u0437\u043E\u0431\u043D\u043E\u0432\u043B\u0435\u043D\u0430: \${recovery.streakAfter} \u0434\u043D. \u043F\u043E\u0434\u0440\u044F\u0434.\`
            );
          }
          if (runs30.length >= 2) {
            const lastR = runs30[runs30.length - 1];
            const prevR = runs30[runs30.length - 2];
            if (lastR.len !== prevR.len) {
              observations.push(
                \`\u041F\u043E\u0441\u043B\u0435\u0434\u043D\u044F\u044F \u0441\u0435\u0440\u0438\u044F \u0432 30-\u0434\u043D\u0435\u0432\u043D\u043E\u043C \u043E\u043A\u043D\u0435 (\${lastR.len} \u0434\u043D.) \${lastR.len > prevR.len ? "\u0434\u043B\u0438\u043D\u043D\u0435\u0435" : "\u043A\u043E\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0435"} \u043F\u0440\u0435\u0434\u044B\u0434\u0443\u0449\u0435\u0439 (\${prevR.len} \u0434\u043D.).\`
              );
            }
          }
          if (observations.length < 2 && maxRun30 && maxRun30.len >= 3) {
            observations.push(
              \`\u0421\u0430\u043C\u0430\u044F \u0434\u043B\u0438\u043D\u043D\u0430\u044F \u0441\u0435\u0440\u0438\u044F \u0437\u0430 30 \u0434\u043D\u0435\u0439 \u2014 \${maxRun30.len} \u0434\u043D. (\${maxRun30.start.toFormat("dd.MM")}\u2013\${maxRun30.end.toFormat("dd.MM")}).\`
            );
          }
        }
      } else if (key === "\u0442\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0430") {
        const weekCounts = weeks4.map(w => w.stats.done.length);
        const pacePerWeek = (s30.done.length / 30) * 7;

        keyMetrics.push({
          k: \`\u041F\u043E\u0441\u043B\u0435\u0434\u043D\u0438\u0435 7 \u0434\u043D. (\${curWeekRange})\`,
          v: \`\${wCur.done.length} \u0442\u0440\u0435\u043D.\`
        });
        keyMetrics.push({
          k: "\u0417\u0430 30 \u0437\u0430\u0432\u0435\u0440\u0448\u0451\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0445 \u0434\u043D.",
          v: \`\${s30.done.length} \u0442\u0440\u0435\u043D. (~\${fmt(pacePerWeek, 1, 1)}/\u043D\u0435\u0434.)\`
        });
        keyMetrics.push({
          k: "\u041F\u043E 4 \u043D\u0435\u0434\u0435\u043B\u044F\u043C (\u0441\u0442. \u2192 \u043D\u043E\u0432.)",
          v: weekCounts.map(n => \`\${n}\`).join(" \u2192 ") + " \u0434\u043D."
        });

        if (wCur.marked.length >= HABIT_MIN_WEEK_MARKED && wPrev.marked.length >= HABIT_MIN_WEEK_MARKED) {
          const diffT = wCur.done.length - wPrev.done.length;
          const diffStr = diffT === 0 ? "\u0441\u0442\u043E\u043B\u044C\u043A\u043E \u0436\u0435, \u0441\u043A\u043E\u043B\u044C\u043A\u043E" : \`\${diffT > 0 ? "\u043D\u0430 +" + diffT : "\u043D\u0430 \u2212" + Math.abs(diffT)} \u0434\u043D. \u043A\`;
          whatChanged = \`\${wCur.done.length} \u0442\u0440\u0435\u043D. \u0437\u0430 \${curWeekRange} (\${diffStr} \u043D\u0435\u0434\u0435\u043B\u0435 \${prevWeekRange}: \${wPrev.done.length} \u0442\u0440\u0435\u043D.).\`;
        } else {
          whatChanged = \`\u0417\u0430 \${curWeekRange} \u043E\u0442\u043C\u0435\u0447\u0435\u043D\u043E \${wCur.done.length} \u0442\u0440\u0435\u043D. (\u0437\u0430\u043F\u043E\u043B\u043D\u0435\u043D\u043E \${wCur.marked.length}/7 \u0434\u043D. \u0434\u043D\u0435\u0432\u043D\u0438\u043A\u0430).\`;
        }

        if (s30.marked.length >= HABIT_MIN_MONTH_MARKED && s30.done.length > 0) {
          const activeWeeks = weekCounts.filter(c => c >= 3).length;
          const minW = Math.min(...weekCounts);
          const maxW = Math.max(...weekCounts);
          observations.push(
            \`\u0412 \${activeWeeks} \u0438\u0437 4 \u043F\u043E\u0441\u043B\u0435\u0434\u043D\u0438\u0445 \u043D\u0435\u0434\u0435\u043B\u044C \u0431\u044B\u043B\u043E \u043D\u0435 \u043C\u0435\u043D\u0435\u0435 3 \u0442\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043E\u043A (\u0440\u0430\u0437\u0431\u0440\u043E\u0441 \u043E\u0442 \${minW} \u0434\u043E \${maxW} \u0432 \u043D\u0435\u0434\u0435\u043B\u044E).\`
          );

          const bestWeekObj = weeks4.reduce((b, w) => (w.stats.done.length > b.stats.done.length ? w : b), weeks4[0]);
          if (bestWeekObj.stats.done.length >= 2) {
            observations.push(
              \`\u041D\u0430\u0438\u0431\u043E\u043B\u044C\u0448\u0435\u0435 \u0447\u0438\u0441\u043B\u043E \u0442\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043E\u043A \u0437\u0430 \u043C\u0435\u0441\u044F\u0446 \u2014 \${bestWeekObj.stats.done.length} \u0434\u043D. \u043D\u0430 \u043D\u0435\u0434\u0435\u043B\u0435 \${bestWeekObj.label}.\`
            );
          }
        }
      } else if (key === "\u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435") {
        const extractPages = (slotList) => slotList
          .map(s => ({ ...s, pages: getPagesRead(s.page) }))
          .filter(s => s.pages !== null && s.pages > 0);

        const pages30 = extractPages(slots30);
        const sumPages30 = pages30.reduce((acc, x) => acc + x.pages, 0);
        const avgPages30 = pages30.length ? sumPages30 / pages30.length : null;

        const pagesCur7 = extractPages(slotsCur7);
        const pagesPrev7 = extractPages(slotsPrev7);
        const sumCur7 = pagesCur7.reduce((a, x) => a + x.pages, 0);
        const sumPrev7 = pagesPrev7.reduce((a, x) => a + x.pages, 0);

        keyMetrics.push({
          k: "\u0414\u043D\u0438 \u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F (\u0444\u043B\u0430\u0436\u043E\u043A)",
          v: s30.marked.length ? \`\${s30.done.length} \u0438\u0437 \${s30.marked.length} \u043E\u0442\u043C. \u0434\u043D.\` : "\u041D\u0435\u0442 \u0434\u0430\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0445"
        });
        keyMetrics.push({
          k: "\u041F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E \u0437\u0430 30 \u0434\u043D.",
          v: pages30.length ? \`\${fmt(sumPages30, 0, 0)} \u0441\u0442\u0440. (\u0437\u0430 \${pages30.length} \u0434\u043D.)\` : "\u0421\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446\u044B \u043D\u0435 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0430\u043D\u044B"
        });
        keyMetrics.push({
          k: "\u0421\u0440\u0435\u0434\u043D\u0435\u0435 \u0432 \u0434\u0435\u043D\u044C \u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F",
          v: avgPages30 !== null ? \`\${fmt(avgPages30, 0, 1)} \u0441\u0442\u0440./\u0434\u0435\u043D\u044C\` : "\u2014"
        });

        if (pagesCur7.length >= 1 || pagesPrev7.length >= 1) {
          const diffPages = sumCur7 - sumPrev7;
          whatChanged = \`\u0417\u0430 \${curWeekRange}: \${fmt(sumCur7, 0, 0)} \u0441\u0442\u0440. (\${pagesCur7.length} \u0434\u043D. \u0441 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u044C\u044E \u0441\u0442\u0440., \u0444\u043B\u0430\u0436\u043E\u043A \${wCur.done.length}/\${wCur.marked.length}) \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0442\u0438\u0432 \${fmt(sumPrev7, 0, 0)} \u0441\u0442\u0440. (\${pagesPrev7.length} \u0434\u043D.) \u043D\u0430 \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0448\u043B\u043E\u0439 \u043D\u0435\u0434\u0435\u043B\u0435 (\${formatSigned(diffPages, 0, 0, "\u0441\u0442\u0440.")}).\`;
        } else {
          whatChanged = formatFlagWeekComparison("\u0414\u043D\u0438 \u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F");
        }

        if (pages30.length >= HABIT_MIN_MONTH_NUMERIC) {
          const first15 = extractPages(slots30.slice(0, 15));
          const last15 = extractPages(slots30.slice(15, 30));
          if (first15.length >= 2 && last15.length >= 2) {
            const sum1 = first15.reduce((a, x) => a + x.pages, 0);
            const sum2 = last15.reduce((a, x) => a + x.pages, 0);
            observations.push(
              \`\u0417\u0430 \u043F\u043E\u0441\u043B\u0435\u0434\u043D\u0438\u0435 15 \u0434\u043D. \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E \${fmt(sum2, 0, 0)} \u0441\u0442\u0440. (\${last15.length} \u0434\u043D.) \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0442\u0438\u0432 \${fmt(sum1, 0, 0)} \u0441\u0442\u0440. (\${first15.length} \u0434\u043D.) \u0432 \u043F\u0440\u0435\u0434\u044B\u0434\u0443\u0449\u0438\u0435 15 \u0434\u043D.\`
            );
          }
        }

        const flagWithoutPages = slots30.filter(s => state(s.page, key) === true && !(getPagesRead(s.page) > 0)).length;
        const pagesWithoutFlag = slots30.filter(s => state(s.page, key) !== true && (getPagesRead(s.page) > 0)).length;
        if (observations.length < 2 && (flagWithoutPages >= 2 || pagesWithoutFlag >= 2)) {
          if (flagWithoutPages >= 2) {
            observations.push(\`\u0412 \${flagWithoutPages} \u0434\u043D. \u0437\u0430 \u043C\u0435\u0441\u044F\u0446 \u043E\u0442\u043C\u0435\u0447\u0435\u043D \u0444\u043B\u0430\u0436\u043E\u043A \u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F \u0431\u0435\u0437 \u0443\u043A\u0430\u0437\u0430\u043D\u0438\u044F \u0447\u0438\u0441\u043B\u0430 \u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446.\`);
          } else {
            observations.push(\`\u0412 \${pagesWithoutFlag} \u0434\u043D. \u0437\u0430 \u043C\u0435\u0441\u044F\u0446 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0430\u043D\u044B \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0435 \u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446\u044B \u043F\u0440\u0438 \u043D\u0435\u043E\u0442\u043C\u0435\u0447\u0435\u043D\u043D\u043E\u043C \u0444\u043B\u0430\u0436\u043A\u0435.\`);
          }
        }

        const wdDiff = getWeekdayWeekendDiff();
        if (observations.length < 2 && wdDiff) {
          observations.push(
            \`\u0412 \u0431\u0443\u0434\u043D\u0438 \u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435 \u043E\u0442\u043C\u0435\u0447\u0435\u043D\u043E \u0432 \${wdDiff.wdDone} \u0438\u0437 \${wdDiff.wdTotal} \u0434\u043D. (\${wdDiff.wdRate}%), \u0432 \u0432\u044B\u0445\u043E\u0434\u043D\u044B\u0435 \u2014 \u0432 \${wdDiff.weDone} \u0438\u0437 \${wdDiff.weTotal} \u0434\u043D. (\${wdDiff.weRate}%).\`
          );
        }
      } else if (key === "\u0440\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C_\u0441\u043D\u0430") {
        const extractSleep = (slotList) => slotList
          .map(s => ({ ...s, hours: getSleepHours(s.page), flag: state(s.page, key) }))
          .filter(s => s.hours !== null);

        const sleep30 = extractSleep(slots30);
        const hoursList30 = sleep30.map(s => s.hours);
        const avgSleep30 = average(hoursList30);

        const sleepCur7 = extractSleep(slotsCur7).map(s => s.hours);
        const sleepPrev7 = extractSleep(slotsPrev7).map(s => s.hours);
        const avgCur7 = average(sleepCur7);
        const avgPrev7 = average(sleepPrev7);

        keyMetrics.push({
          k: "\u0421\u043E\u0431\u043B\u044E\u0434\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435 \u0440\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C\u0430",
          v: s30.marked.length ? \`\${s30.done.length} \u0438\u0437 \${s30.marked.length} \u0434\u043D. (\${s30.rate}%)\` : "\u041D\u0435\u0442 \u0434\u0430\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0445"
        });
        keyMetrics.push({
          k: "\u0421\u0440\u0435\u0434\u043D\u044F\u044F \u0434\u043B\u0438\u0442\u0435\u043B\u044C\u043D\u043E\u0441\u0442\u044C",
          v: avgSleep30 !== null ? \`\${fmt(avgSleep30, 1, 1)} \u0447 (\${sleep30.length} \u0434\u043D.)\` : "\u041D\u0435\u0442 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0435\u0439 \u0447\u0430\u0441\u043E\u0432"
        });
        keyMetrics.push({
          k: "\u0420\u0430\u0437\u0431\u0440\u043E\u0441 (30 \u0434\u043D.)",
          v: hoursList30.length >= HABIT_MIN_MONTH_NUMERIC
            ? \`\${fmt(Math.min(...hoursList30), 0, 1)}\u2013\${fmt(Math.max(...hoursList30), 0, 1)} \u0447\`
            : \`\u041C\u0430\u043B\u043E \u0434\u0430\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0445 (<\${HABIT_MIN_MONTH_NUMERIC} \u0434\u043D.)\`
        });

        if (sleepCur7.length >= HABIT_MIN_WEEK_NUMERIC && sleepPrev7.length >= HABIT_MIN_WEEK_NUMERIC) {
          const diffH = avgCur7 - avgPrev7;
          whatChanged = \`\u0420\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C: \${wCur.done.length}/\${wCur.marked.length} \u0434\u043D. \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0442\u0438\u0432 \${wPrev.done.length}/\${wPrev.marked.length} \xB7 \u0434\u043B\u0438\u0442\u0435\u043B\u044C\u043D\u043E\u0441\u0442\u044C: \u0441\u0440. \${fmt(avgCur7, 1, 1)} \u0447 (\${sleepCur7.length} \u0434\u043D.) \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0442\u0438\u0432 \${fmt(avgPrev7, 1, 1)} \u0447 (\${sleepPrev7.length} \u0434\u043D., \${formatSigned(diffH, 1, 1, "\u0447")}).\`;
        } else {
          whatChanged = formatFlagWeekComparison("\u0420\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C \u0441\u043D\u0430");
        }

        const sleepWhenTrue = sleep30.filter(s => s.flag === true).map(s => s.hours);
        const sleepWhenFalse = sleep30.filter(s => s.flag === false && s.activeNote).map(s => s.hours);
        if (sleepWhenTrue.length >= HABIT_MIN_GROUP_SIZE && sleepWhenFalse.length >= HABIT_MIN_GROUP_SIZE) {
          const mTrue = average(sleepWhenTrue);
          const mFalse = average(sleepWhenFalse);
          observations.push(
            \`\u0412 \u0434\u043D\u0438 \u0441 \u043E\u0442\u043C\u0435\u0447\u0435\u043D\u043D\u044B\u043C \u0440\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C\u043E\u043C \u0441\u0440\u0435\u0434\u043D\u044F\u044F \u0434\u043B\u0438\u0442\u0435\u043B\u044C\u043D\u043E\u0441\u0442\u044C \u0441\u043D\u0430 \u2014 \${fmt(mTrue, 1, 1)} \u0447 (n=\${sleepWhenTrue.length}), \u0431\u0435\u0437 \u043E\u0442\u043C\u0435\u0442\u043A\u0438 \u2014 \${fmt(mFalse, 1, 1)} \u0447 (n=\${sleepWhenFalse.length}).\`
          );
        }

        const sleepWd = sleep30.filter(s => s.date.weekday <= 5).map(s => s.hours);
        const sleepWe = sleep30.filter(s => s.date.weekday >= 6).map(s => s.hours);
        if (observations.length < 2 && sleepWd.length >= HABIT_MIN_GROUP_SIZE * 2 && sleepWe.length >= HABIT_MIN_GROUP_SIZE) {
          const mWd = average(sleepWd);
          const mWe = average(sleepWe);
          if (Math.abs(mWd - mWe) >= 0.4) {
            observations.push(
              \`\u0421\u0440\u0435\u0434\u043D\u0438\u0439 \u0441\u043E\u043D \u0432 \u0431\u0443\u0434\u043D\u0438 \u2014 \${fmt(mWd, 1, 1)} \u0447 (n=\${sleepWd.length}), \u0432 \u0432\u044B\u0445\u043E\u0434\u043D\u044B\u0435 \u2014 \${fmt(mWe, 1, 1)} \u0447 (n=\${sleepWe.length}).\`
            );
          }
        }

        const wdDiff = getWeekdayWeekendDiff();
        if (observations.length < 2 && wdDiff) {
          observations.push(
            \`\u0420\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C \u0441\u043D\u0430 \u0432 \u0431\u0443\u0434\u043D\u0438 \u043E\u0442\u043C\u0435\u0447\u0435\u043D \u0432 \${wdDiff.wdDone} \u0438\u0437 \${wdDiff.wdTotal} \u0434\u043D. (\${wdDiff.wdRate}%), \u0432 \u0432\u044B\u0445\u043E\u0434\u043D\u044B\u0435 \u2014 \u0432 \${wdDiff.weDone} \u0438\u0437 \${wdDiff.weTotal} \u0434\u043D. (\${wdDiff.weRate}%).\`
          );
        }
      } else if (key === "\u0434\u0438\u0435\u0442\u0430") {
        const extractCal = (slotList) => slotList
          .map(s => ({ ...s, cal: getCalories(s.page) }))
          .filter(s => s.cal !== null);

        const cal30 = extractCal(slots30).map(s => s.cal);
        const avgCal30 = average(cal30);

        const calCur7 = extractCal(slotsCur7).map(s => s.cal);
        const calPrev7 = extractCal(slotsPrev7).map(s => s.cal);
        const avgCalCur7 = average(calCur7);
        const avgCalPrev7 = average(calPrev7);

        const weekDietStr = weeks4
          .map(w => w.stats.marked.length ? \`\${w.stats.done.length}/\${w.stats.marked.length}\` : "\u2014")
          .join(" \u2192 ");

        keyMetrics.push({
          k: "\u0412\u044B\u043F\u043E\u043B\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435 (30 \u0434\u043D.)",
          v: s30.marked.length ? \`\${s30.done.length} \u0438\u0437 \${s30.marked.length} \u0434\u043D. (\${s30.rate}%)\` : "\u041D\u0435\u0442 \u0434\u0430\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0445"
        });
        keyMetrics.push({
          k: "\u041F\u043E 4 \u043D\u0435\u0434\u0435\u043B\u044F\u043C (\u0441\u0442. \u2192 \u043D\u043E\u0432.)",
          v: weekDietStr
        });
        keyMetrics.push({
          k: "\u041A\u0430\u043B\u043E\u0440\u0438\u0438 (\u0441\u043F\u0440\u0430\u0432\u043E\u0447\u043D\u043E, 30 \u0434\u043D.)",
          v: avgCal30 !== null ? \`\u0441\u0440. \${fmt(Math.round(avgCal30), 0, 0)} \u043A\u043A\u0430\u043B (\${cal30.length} \u0434\u043D.)\` : "\u041D\u0435 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0430\u043D\u044B"
        });

        const baseDietChange = formatFlagWeekComparison("\u0414\u0438\u0435\u0442\u0430");
        if (calCur7.length >= HABIT_MIN_WEEK_NUMERIC && calPrev7.length >= HABIT_MIN_WEEK_NUMERIC) {
          const diffCal = Math.round(avgCalCur7 - avgCalPrev7);
          whatChanged = \`\${baseDietChange.replace(/\\.$/, "")} \xB7 \u043A\u0430\u043B\u043E\u0440\u0438\u0438: \u0441\u0440. \${fmt(Math.round(avgCalCur7), 0, 0)} \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0442\u0438\u0432 \${fmt(Math.round(avgCalPrev7), 0, 0)} \u043A\u043A\u0430\u043B (\${formatSigned(diffCal, 0, 0, "\u043A\u043A\u0430\u043B")}).\`;
        } else {
          whatChanged = baseDietChange;
        }

        if (s30.marked.length >= HABIT_MIN_MONTH_MARKED) {
          const steadyWeeks = weeks4.filter(w => w.stats.done.length >= 5).length;
          const bestDietWeek = weeks4.reduce((b, w) => (w.stats.done.length > b.stats.done.length ? w : b), weeks4[0]);
          if (bestDietWeek.stats.marked.length > 0) {
            observations.push(
              \`\u041D\u0435\u0434\u0435\u043B\u044C \u0441 \u0432\u044B\u043F\u043E\u043B\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435\u043C \u22655 \u0434\u043D\u0435\u0439: \${steadyWeeks} \u0438\u0437 4 (\u043B\u0443\u0447\u0448\u0430\u044F \u2014 \${bestDietWeek.label}: \${bestDietWeek.stats.done.length} \u0438\u0437 \${bestDietWeek.stats.marked.length} \u0434\u043D.).\`
            );
          }

          const wdDiff = getWeekdayWeekendDiff();
          if (wdDiff) {
            observations.push(
              \`\u0412 \u0431\u0443\u0434\u043D\u0438 \u0434\u0438\u0435\u0442\u0430 \u043E\u0442\u043C\u0435\u0447\u0435\u043D\u0430 \u0432 \${wdDiff.wdDone} \u0438\u0437 \${wdDiff.wdTotal} \u0434\u043D. (\${wdDiff.wdRate}%), \u0432 \u0432\u044B\u0445\u043E\u0434\u043D\u044B\u0435 \u2014 \u0432 \${wdDiff.weDone} \u0438\u0437 \${wdDiff.weTotal} \u0434\u043D. (\${wdDiff.weRate}%).\`
            );
          } else {
            const recovery = findLastRecovery();
            if (recovery) {
              observations.push(
                \`\u041F\u043E\u0441\u043B\u0435 \u043F\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0440\u044B\u0432\u0430 (\${recovery.missDate.toFormat("dd.MM")}) \u0441\u043E\u0431\u043B\u044E\u0434\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435 \u0434\u0438\u0435\u0442\u044B \u0432\u043E\u0437\u043E\u0431\u043D\u043E\u0432\u043B\u0435\u043D\u043E: \${recovery.streakAfter} \u0434\u043D. \u043F\u043E\u0434\u0440\u044F\u0434.\`
              );
            }
          }
        }
      } else if (key === "\u0431\u0435\u0437_\u0441\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0435\u0439") {
        const socialList30 = slots30.map(s => getSocialMin(s.page)).filter(v => v !== null);
        const avgSocial30 = socialList30.length ? average(socialList30) : null;
        keyMetrics.push({
          k: "\u0412\u044B\u043F\u043E\u043B\u043D\u0435\u043D\u043E (30 \u0434\u043D.)",
          v: s30.marked.length ? \`\${s30.done.length} \u0438\u0437 \${s30.marked.length} \u0434\u043D. (\${s30.rate}%)\` : "\u2014"
        });
        keyMetrics.push({
          k: "\u0421\u0440\u0435\u0434\u043D\u0438\u0439 \u0441\u043A\u0440\u043E\u043B\u043B\u0438\u043D\u0433",
          v: avgSocial30 !== null ? \`\${Math.round(avgSocial30)} \u043C\u0438\u043D/\u0434\u0435\u043D\u044C\` : "\u2014"
        });
        keyMetrics.push({
          k: "\u041B\u0443\u0447\u0448\u0430\u044F \u0441\u0435\u0440\u0438\u044F (30 \u0434\u043D.)",
          v: maxRun30 ? \`\${maxRun30.len} \u0434\u043D.\` : "\u2014"
        });
        whatChanged = formatFlagWeekComparison("\u0411\u0435\u0437 \u0441\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0435\u0439");
        if (avgSocial30 !== null) {
          observations.push(
            avgSocial30 <= SOCIAL_LIMIT_MIN
              ? \`\u0412 \u0441\u0440\u0435\u0434\u043D\u0435\u043C \${Math.round(avgSocial30)} \u043C\u0438\u043D/\u0434\u0435\u043D\u044C \u2014 \u0434\u0435\u0440\u0436\u0438\u0448\u044C\u0441\u044F \u0432 \u043F\u0440\u0435\u0434\u0435\u043B\u0430\u0445 \u043B\u0438\u043C\u0438\u0442\u0430 \u2264\${SOCIAL_LIMIT_MIN} \u043C\u0438\u043D.\`
              : \`\u0412 \u0441\u0440\u0435\u0434\u043D\u0435\u043C \${Math.round(avgSocial30)} \u043C\u0438\u043D/\u0434\u0435\u043D\u044C \u2014 \u043F\u0440\u0435\u0432\u044B\u0448\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435 \u043B\u0438\u043C\u0438\u0442\u0430 \u043D\u0430 +\${Math.round(avgSocial30 - SOCIAL_LIMIT_MIN)} \u043C\u0438\u043D.\`
          );
        }
      }

      return {
        name: h.name,
        color: h.color,
        periodLabel: \`30 \u0437\u0430\u0432\u0435\u0440\u0448\u0451\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0445 \u0434\u043D. (\${completed30RangeStr})\`,
        keyMetrics: keyMetrics.slice(0, 3),
        whatChanged,
        observations: observations.slice(0, 2),
        bestAllTime,
        totalAllTime,
        blankStubsCount: s30.blankTemplateStubs.length
      };
    }

    const popover = doc.body.createDiv({
      cls: "dhhv-popover-v2",
      attr: {
        role: "region",
        "aria-label": "\u041F\u043E\u0434\u0440\u043E\u0431\u043D\u0430\u044F \u0441\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0438\u0441\u0442\u0438\u043A\u0430 \u043F\u0440\u0438\u0432\u044B\u0447\u043A\u0438",
        "aria-hidden": "true"
      }
    });

    popover.id = \`dhhv-\${Date.now()}-\${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}\`;

    let activeButton = null;
    let pinned = false;
    let closeTimer = null;
    let positionFrame = null;

    function cancelClose() {
      if (closeTimer !== null) {
        win.clearTimeout(closeTimer);
        closeTimer = null;
      }
    }

    function closePopover() {
      cancelClose();
      if (activeButton) {
        activeButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      }
      popover.classList.remove("is-open");
      popover.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      activeButton = null;
      pinned = false;
    }

    function positionPopover() {
      if (!activeButton || !activeButton.isConnected) {
        closePopover();
        return;
      }

      const rect = activeButton.getBoundingClientRect();
      const viewportWidth = win.innerWidth;
      const viewportHeight = win.innerHeight;

      if (
        rect.bottom < 0 ||
        rect.top > viewportHeight ||
        rect.right < 0 ||
        rect.left > viewportWidth
      ) {
        closePopover();
        return;
      }

      const margin = 10;
      const gap = 8;
      const width = popover.offsetWidth;
      const height = popover.offsetHeight;

      const left = Math.max(margin, Math.min(rect.left, viewportWidth - width - margin));
      const below = rect.bottom + gap;
      const above = rect.top - height - gap;
      let top = below + height <= viewportHeight - margin ? below : above;
      top = Math.max(margin, Math.min(top, viewportHeight - height - margin));

      popover.style.left = \`\${left}px\`;
      popover.style.top = \`\${top}px\`;
    }

    function requestPosition() {
      if (!activeButton || positionFrame !== null) return;
      positionFrame = win.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        positionFrame = null;
        positionPopover();
      });
    }

    function scheduleClose() {
      cancelClose();
      if (pinned) return;

      closeTimer = win.setTimeout(() => {
        closeTimer = null;
        if (pinned) return;
        if (popover.matches(":hover")) return;
        if (popover.contains(doc.activeElement)) return;
        if (activeButton?.matches(":hover")) return;
        if (activeButton?.matches(":focus-visible")) return;
        closePopover();
      }, 180);
    }

    function showPopover(button, data, pin = false) {
      cancelClose();
      if (pinned && activeButton !== button && !pin) return;
      if (activeButton && activeButton !== button) {
        activeButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      }

      activeButton = button;
      pinned = pin;
      button.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");

      popover.replaceChildren();
      popover.style.setProperty("--dhhv-accent", data.color);
      popover.setAttribute("aria-label", \`\${data.name}: \u043F\u043E\u0434\u0440\u043E\u0431\u043D\u0430\u044F \u0441\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0438\u0441\u0442\u0438\u043A\u0430\`);

      const headRow = popover.createDiv({ cls: "dhhv-pop-head" });
      headRow.createSpan({ cls: "dhhv-pop-title", text: data.name });
      headRow.createSpan({ cls: "dhhv-pop-period", text: data.periodLabel });

      const secA = popover.createDiv({ cls: "dhhv-pop-section" });
      secA.createDiv({ cls: "dhhv-pop-sec-title", text: "\u041A\u043B\u044E\u0447\u0435\u0432\u044B\u0435 \u043F\u043E\u043A\u0430\u0437\u0430\u0442\u0435\u043B\u0438" });
      data.keyMetrics.forEach(item => {
        const r = secA.createDiv({ cls: "dhhv-pop-row" });
        r.createSpan({ cls: "dhhv-pop-label", text: item.k });
        r.createSpan({ cls: "dhhv-pop-value", text: item.v });
      });

      const secB = popover.createDiv({ cls: "dhhv-pop-section" });
      secB.createDiv({ cls: "dhhv-pop-sec-title", text: "\u0427\u0442\u043E \u0438\u0437\u043C\u0435\u043D\u0438\u043B\u043E\u0441\u044C \xB7 7 \u0434\u043D. \u043A \u043F\u0440\u0435\u0434. 7 \u0434\u043D." });
      secB.createDiv({ cls: "dhhv-pop-change-box", text: data.whatChanged });

      const secC = popover.createDiv({ cls: "dhhv-pop-section" });
      secC.createDiv({ cls: "dhhv-pop-sec-title", text: "\u041D\u0430\u0431\u043B\u044E\u0434\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F \xB7 30 \u0434\u043D\u0435\u0439" });
      if (data.observations.length > 0) {
        const ul = secC.createEl("ul", { cls: "dhhv-pop-obs-list" });
        data.observations.forEach(obs => {
          ul.createEl("li", { cls: "dhhv-pop-obs-item", text: obs });
        });
      } else {
        secC.createDiv({ cls: "dhhv-pop-muted", text: "\u041F\u043E\u043A\u0430 \u043C\u0430\u043B\u043E \u0434\u0430\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0445 \u0434\u043B\u044F \u043D\u0430\u0431\u043B\u044E\u0434\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0439" });
      }

      const secFooter = popover.createDiv({ cls: "dhhv-pop-secondary" });
      secFooter.createSpan({ text: \`\u0417\u0430 \u0432\u0441\u0451 \u0432\u0440\u0435\u043C\u044F: \${data.totalAllTime} \u0434\u043D.\` });
      secFooter.createSpan({ text: \`\u0420\u0435\u043A\u043E\u0440\u0434 \u0441\u0435\u0440\u0438\u0438: \${data.bestAllTime} \u0434\u043D.\` });
      if (data.blankStubsCount > 0) {
        secFooter.createDiv({
          text: \`\u0412 30-\u0434\u043D\u0435\u0432\u043D\u043E\u043C \u043E\u043A\u043D\u0435 \u0435\u0441\u0442\u044C \${data.blankStubsCount} \u0434\u043D. \u0441 \u0441\u043E\u0437\u0434\u0430\u043D\u043D\u043E\u0439, \u043D\u043E \u043D\u0435 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u043E\u043B\u043D\u0435\u043D\u043D\u043E\u0439 \u0437\u0430\u043C\u0435\u0442\u043A\u043E\u0439 (\u0444\u043B\u0430\u0436\u043A\u0438 false \u043F\u043E \u0448\u0430\u0431\u043B\u043E\u043D\u0443).\`,
          attr: { style: "width: 100%; font-size: 0.67rem; color: var(--text-faint); margin-top: 2px;" }
        });
      }

      popover.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
      positionPopover();
      popover.classList.add("is-open");
    }

    popover.addEventListener("pointerenter", cancelClose);
    popover.addEventListener("pointerleave", scheduleClose);
    popover.addEventListener("focusin", cancelClose);
    popover.addEventListener("focusout", scheduleClose);

    dv.component.registerDomEvent(doc, "pointerdown", e => {
      if (activeButton && !activeButton.contains(e.target) && !popover.contains(e.target)) {
        closePopover();
      }
    });

    dv.component.registerDomEvent(doc, "keydown", e => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && activeButton) {
        closePopover();
      }
    });

    dv.component.registerDomEvent(win, "resize", requestPosition);
    dv.component.registerDomEvent(doc, "scroll", requestPosition, true);

    dv.component.register(() => {
      cancelClose();
      if (positionFrame !== null) {
        win.cancelAnimationFrame(positionFrame);
      }
      popover.remove();
    });

    for (const h of HABITS) {
      const done = new Set(
        entries
          .filter(([, p]) => p[h.key] === true)
          .map(([iso]) => iso)
      );

      const doneToday = done.has(todayISO);
      let cursor = doneToday ? today : today.minus({ days: 1 });
      let current = 0;

      while (done.has(cursor.toISODate())) {
        current++;
        cursor = cursor.minus({ days: 1 });
      }

      let best = 0;
      let run = 0;
      let prev = null;

      for (const iso of [...done].sort()) {
        run = prev && dv.date(prev).plus({ days: 1 }).toISODate() === iso ? run + 1 : 1;
        best = Math.max(best, run);
        prev = iso;
      }

      const c = cards.createDiv({ cls: "dh-card dh-habit" });
      c.style.setProperty("--habit-color", h.color);

      const top = c.createDiv({ cls: "dh-habit-top" });
      top.createDiv({ cls: "dh-habit-name", text: h.name });
      top.createDiv({
        cls: \`dh-badge\${doneToday ? " is-done" : ""}\`,
        text: doneToday ? "\u0441\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0434\u043D\u044F \u2713" : "\u0441\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0434\u043D\u044F \u2014"
      });

      c.createDiv({ cls: "dh-card-value", text: \`\${current} \u0434\u043D.\` });
      c.createDiv({
        cls: "dh-card-hint",
        text: current && !doneToday ? "\u043F\u043E\u0434\u0440\u044F\u0434 \u0434\u043E \u0432\u0447\u0435\u0440\u0430" : "\u043F\u043E\u0434\u0440\u044F\u0434"
      });

      const detailBox = c.createDiv({ cls: "dhhv-info" });

      if (h.key === "\u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435") {
        const pages = todayRecord && typeof todayRecord.\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446_\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E === "number"
          ? todayRecord.\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446_\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E
          : null;

        if (pages !== null && pages > 0) {
          detailBox.innerHTML = \`
            <span>\u{1F4D6} \u0421\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0434\u043D\u044F: <strong>\${pages} \u0441\u0442\u0440.</strong></span>
            <span style="color:var(--color-green);">\u2713 \u0446\u0435\u043B\u044C \u0437\u0430\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u0430</span>
          \`;
        } else {
          detailBox.innerHTML = \`
            <span style="color:var(--text-muted);">\u{1F4D6} \u0421\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0434\u043D\u044F \u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446: 0</span>
          \`;
        }
      } else if (h.key === "\u0440\u0435\u0436\u0438\u043C_\u0441\u043D\u0430") {
        const sleepH = todayRecord && typeof todayRecord.\u0441\u043E\u043D_\u0447\u0430\u0441\u043E\u0432 === "number"
          ? todayRecord.\u0441\u043E\u043D_\u0447\u0430\u0441\u043E\u0432
          : null;

        if (sleepH !== null && sleepH > 0) {
          let quality = "\u041E\u043F\u0442\u0438\u043C\u0430\u043B\u044C\u043D\u043E (7\u20138 \u0447)";
          let qColor = "var(--color-green)";
          let qIcon = "\u{1F319}";

          if (sleepH < 6) {
            quality = "\u041D\u0435\u0434\u043E\u0441\u044B\u043F";
            qColor = "var(--color-red, #d85b57)";
            qIcon = "\u26A0\uFE0F";
          } else if (sleepH < 7) {
            quality = "\u041D\u0438\u0436\u0435 \u043D\u043E\u0440\u043C\u044B";
            qColor = "var(--color-orange, #e5a158)";
            qIcon = "\u{1F634}";
          } else if (sleepH > 9) {
            quality = "\u041F\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0441\u044B\u043F";
            qColor = "var(--color-orange, #e5a158)";
            qIcon = "\u{1F6CC}";
          } else if (sleepH >= 8.5) {
            quality = "\u0425\u043E\u0440\u043E\u0448\u0438\u0439 \u043E\u0442\u0434\u044B\u0445";
            qColor = "var(--color-green)";
            qIcon = "\u{1F319}";
          }

          detailBox.innerHTML = \`
            <span>\${qIcon} <strong>\${sleepH} \u0447</strong></span>
            <span style="color:\${qColor}; font-weight:600;">\${quality}</span>
          \`;
        } else {
          detailBox.innerHTML = \`
            <span style="color:var(--text-muted);">\u{1F319} \u0421\u043E\u043D \u043D\u0435 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0430\u043D</span>
          \`;
        }
      } else if (h.key === "\u0434\u0438\u0435\u0442\u0430") {
        const cal = todayRecord && typeof todayRecord.\u043A\u0430\u043B\u043E\u0440\u0438\u0438_\u043A\u043A\u0430\u043B === "number"
          ? todayRecord.\u043A\u0430\u043B\u043E\u0440\u0438\u0438_\u043A\u043A\u0430\u043B
          : null;
        const w = todayRecord && typeof todayRecord.\u0432\u0435\u0441_\u043A\u0433 === "number"
          ? todayRecord.\u0432\u0435\u0441_\u043A\u0433
          : null;

        const calText = cal !== null ? \`\${cal} \u043A\u043A\u0430\u043B\` : "\u2014 \u043A\u043A\u0430\u043B";
        const wText = w !== null ? \`\${fmt(w)} \u043A\u0433\` : "\u2014 \u043A\u0433";

        detailBox.innerHTML = \`
          <span>\u{1F957} <strong>\${calText}</strong></span>
          <span style="color:var(--text-muted); font-size:0.72rem;">\u0412\u0435\u0441: \${wText}</span>
        \`;
      } else if (h.key === "\u0442\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0430") {
        const wasT = todayRecord && todayRecord.\u0442\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0430 === true;

        let trainingPage = dv.pages('"\u0417\u043D\u0430\u043D\u0438\u044F"').array().find(p => p.\u0442\u0438\u043F === "\u0422\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0430" && asDate(p.\u0434\u0430\u0442\u0430)?.toISODate() === todayISO);
        let isPastSession = false;

        if (!trainingPage) {
          const pastSessions = dv.pages('"\u0417\u043D\u0430\u043D\u0438\u044F"').array()
            .filter(p => p.\u0442\u0438\u043F === "\u0422\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0430" && asDate(p.\u0434\u0430\u0442\u0430) && asDate(p.\u0434\u0430\u0442\u0430) <= today)
            .sort((a, b) => asDate(b.\u0434\u0430\u0442\u0430).toMillis() - asDate(a.\u0434\u0430\u0442\u0430).toMillis());
          if (pastSessions.length > 0) {
            trainingPage = pastSessions[0];
            isPastSession = true;
          }
        }

        let totalReps = 0;
        let setsCount = 0;
        const exerciseReps = new Map();

        if (trainingPage) {
          const listItems = Array.from(trainingPage.file.lists ?? []);
          listItems.forEach(item => {
            const exName = item.\u0443\u043F\u0440\u0430\u0436\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435 ? String(item.\u0443\u043F\u0440\u0430\u0436\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435).trim() : "";
            const reps = typeof item.\u043F\u043E\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0440\u044B === "number" ? item.\u043F\u043E\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0440\u044B : Number(item.\u043F\u043E\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0440\u044B);
            if (exName && Number.isFinite(reps) && reps > 0) {
              totalReps += reps;
              setsCount++;
              exerciseReps.set(exName, (exerciseReps.get(exName) || 0) + reps);
            }
          });
        }

        const topExercises = [...exerciseReps.entries()]
          .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
          .slice(0, 2)
          .map(([name, reps]) => \`\${name}: \${reps}\`)
          .join(" \xB7 ");

        if (wasT && trainingPage && !isPastSession) {
          const sessionName = String(trainingPage.\u043D\u0430\u0437\u0432\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0435_\u0442\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0438 || trainingPage.file.name).replace(/^\u0422\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0430\\s*/i, "").trim() || "\u0421\u0438\u043B\u043E\u0432\u0430\u044F";
          const subInfo = topExercises ? \`(\${topExercises})\` : \`\${setsCount} \u043F\u043E\u0434\u0445.\`;
          detailBox.innerHTML = \`
            <span style="color:var(--color-green); font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;">\u{1F3CB}\uFE0F \${sessionName}</span>
            <span style="color:var(--text-muted); font-size:0.72rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;" title="\${topExercises}">\${totalReps > 0 ? totalReps + " \u043F\u043E\u0432\u0442." : setsCount + " \u043F\u043E\u0434\u0445."} \${subInfo}</span>
          \`;
        } else if (isPastSession && trainingPage) {
          const pastDateStr = asDate(trainingPage.\u0434\u0430\u0442\u0430)?.toFormat("dd.MM") || "";
          detailBox.innerHTML = \`
            <span style="color:var(--text-muted);">\u041E\u0442\u0434\u044B\u0445 (\u043F\u043E\u0441\u043B: \${pastDateStr})</span>
            <span style="color:var(--text-faint); font-size:0.72rem;">\${totalReps > 0 ? totalReps + " \u043F\u043E\u0432\u0442." : "\u2014"}</span>
          \`;
        } else {
          detailBox.innerHTML = \`
            <span style="color:var(--text-muted);">\u{1F3CB}\uFE0F \u0422\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0438 \u043D\u0435 \u0431\u044B\u043B\u043E</span>
            <span style="color:var(--text-faint); font-size:0.72rem;">0 \u043F\u043E\u0432\u0442.</span>
          \`;
        }
      } else if (h.key === "nofap") {
        detailBox.innerHTML = \`
          <span style="color:var(--text-muted);">\u{1F6E1}\uFE0F \u0427\u0438\u0441\u0442\u044B\u0439 \u0434\u0435\u043D\u044C: \${doneToday ? "\u0414\u0430 \u2713" : "\u0412 \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0446\u0435\u0441\u0441\u0435"}</span>
        \`;
      } else if (h.key === "\u0431\u0435\u0437_\u0441\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0435\u0439") {
        const socialMin = todayRecord ? getSocialMin(todayRecord) : null;
        if (socialMin !== null) {
          if (socialMin <= SOCIAL_LIMIT_MIN) {
            detailBox.innerHTML = \`
              <span style="color:var(--color-green); font-weight:600;">\u{1F6E1}\uFE0F \u041B\u0438\u043C\u0438\u0442 \u0443\u0434\u0435\u0440\u0436\u0430\u043D: \${socialMin} \u0438\u0437 \${SOCIAL_LIMIT_MIN} \u043C\u0438\u043D</span>
              <span style="color:var(--color-green); font-size:0.72rem; font-weight:600;">\u0432 \u043D\u043E\u0440\u043C\u0435 \u2713</span>
            \`;
          } else {
            const over = socialMin - SOCIAL_LIMIT_MIN;
            detailBox.innerHTML = \`
              <span style="color:var(--color-red, #d85b57); font-weight:600;">\u{1F4F1} \u041F\u0440\u0435\u0432\u044B\u0448\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435: \${socialMin} \u043C\u0438\u043D</span>
              <span style="color:var(--color-red, #d85b57); font-size:0.72rem; font-weight:600;">+\${over} \u043C\u0438\u043D</span>
            \`;
          }
        } else {
          const doneNS = todayRecord && todayRecord.\u0431\u0435\u0437_\u0441\u043E\u0446\u0441\u0435\u0442\u0435\u0439 === true;
          detailBox.innerHTML = doneNS
            ? \`<span style="color:var(--color-green); font-weight:600;">\u{1F6E1}\uFE0F \u0411\u0435\u0437 \u0441\u043A\u0440\u043E\u043B\u043B\u0438\u043D\u0433\u0430</span><span style="color:var(--text-muted); font-size:0.72rem;">\u043B\u0438\u043C\u0438\u0442 \u2264\${SOCIAL_LIMIT_MIN} \u043C\u0438\u043D</span>\`
            : \`<span style="color:var(--text-muted);">\u{1F4F1} \u0412\u0440\u0435\u043C\u044F \u043D\u0435 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0430\u043D\u043E</span><span style="color:var(--text-faint); font-size:0.72rem;">\u043B\u0438\u043C\u0438\u0442 \u2264\${SOCIAL_LIMIT_MIN} \u043C\u0438\u043D</span>\`;
        }
      }

      const seven = c.createDiv({ cls: "dh-seven" });

      for (const d of days(7)) {
        const p = byDate.get(d.toISODate());
        const s = state(p, h.key);

        const item = seven.createDiv({ cls: "dh-seven-day" });
        const status = s === true ? "\u043E\u0442\u043C\u0435\u0447\u0435\u043D\u043E" : s === false ? "\u043D\u0435 \u043E\u0442\u043C\u0435\u0447\u0435\u043D\u043E" : "\u043D\u0435\u0442 \u0434\u0430\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0445";

        const dot = dayButton(
          item,
          "dh-dot",
          p,
          \`\${d.toFormat("dd.MM")} \xB7 \${h.name}: \${status}\`
        );

        dot.classList.add(s === true ? "is-on" : s === false ? "is-off" : "is-unknown");

        if (d.toISODate() === todayISO) {
          dot.classList.add("is-today");
        }

        item.createSpan({
          cls: "dh-seven-label",
          text: WEEKDAYS[d.weekday - 1]
        });
      }

      const footer = c.createDiv({ cls: "dhhv-footer" });
      const more = footer.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dhhv-more",
        attr: {
          type: "button",
          "aria-label": \`\${h.name}: \u043F\u043E\u0434\u0440\u043E\u0431\u043D\u0435\u0435\`,
          "aria-expanded": "false",
          "aria-controls": popover.id
        }
      });

      more.onmousedown = e => e.preventDefault();
      more.createSpan({ text: "\u041F\u043E\u0434\u0440\u043E\u0431\u043D\u0435\u0435" });
      more.createSpan({ cls: "dhhv-chevron", text: "\u25BE", attr: { "aria-hidden": "true" } });

      const data = buildHabitDetails(h, best, done.size);

      more.addEventListener("pointerenter", e => {
        if (e.pointerType !== "mouse") return;
        if (activeButton === more && pinned) {
          cancelClose();
          return;
        }
        showPopover(more, data);
      });

      more.addEventListener("pointerleave", e => {
        if (e.pointerType === "mouse") {
          scheduleClose();
        }
      });

      more.addEventListener("focus", () => {
        if (more.matches(":focus-visible") && !(activeButton === more && pinned)) {
          showPopover(more, data);
        }
      });

      more.addEventListener("blur", scheduleClose);

      more.addEventListener("click", e => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (activeButton === more && pinned) {
          closePopover();
        } else {
          showPopover(more, data, true);
        }
      });
    }
  }
}

// ========================================================
// \u0427\u0410\u0421\u0422\u042C 2: \u041C\u042B\u0421\u041B\u0418, \u0418\u0414\u0415\u0418 \u0418 \u0417\u041D\u0410\u041D\u0418\u042F
// ========================================================
if (mode === "all" || mode === "thoughts") {
  const { Notice, normalizePath } = obsidian;

  const MARKER_PROP = "\u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u044C_\u043C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u0438";
  const DEFAULT_FOLDER = "\u0417\u043D\u0430\u043D\u0438\u044F/\u041C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u0438";
  const RECENT_LIMIT = 10;
  const MIN_DATE = dv.date("2020-01-01");
  const today = dv.date("today").startOf("day");
  const todayISO = today.toISODate();
  const CURRENT = dv.current().file.path;
  const STORAGE_KEY = "diary-thoughts-v2:" + app.vault.getName();

  let savedState = {};
  try { savedState = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || "{}"); } catch {}
  const state = {
    category: typeof savedState.category === "string" ? savedState.category : "",
    query: typeof savedState.query === "string" ? savedState.query : "",
    sortBy: typeof savedState.sortBy === "string" ? savedState.sortBy : "date-desc",
    showAll: Boolean(savedState.showAll),
    formOpen: Boolean(savedState.formOpen),
    editingPath: null
  };
  const persist = () => {
    try {
      sessionStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
        category: state.category,
        query: state.query,
        sortBy: state.sortBy,
        showAll: state.showAll,
        formOpen: state.formOpen
      }));
    } catch {}
  };

  const cleanStr = v => typeof v === "string" ? v.trim() : "";
  const validNum = v => {
    if (v === null || v === undefined || v === "" || typeof v === "boolean") return null;
    const n = typeof v === "number" ? v : Number(String(v).trim().replace(",", "."));
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
  };
  const parseDate = v => {
    if (v == null || v === "") return null;
    try { const d = dv.date(v); return d && d.isValid ? d.startOf("day") : null; } catch { return null; }
  };
  const cleanList = v => {
    const raw = v == null ? [] : Array.isArray(v) ? v : [v];
    return [...new Set(raw.flat().map(x => cleanStr(String(x))).filter(Boolean))];
  };

  function loadThoughts() {
    const items = [];
    for (const p of dv.pages()) {
      if (p.file.path === CURRENT) continue;
      const fileObj = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(p.file.path);
      const fm = (fileObj ? app.metadataCache.getFileCache(fileObj)?.frontmatter : null) || p;
      if (fm[MARKER_PROP] !== true && p[MARKER_PROP] !== true) continue;

      const d = parseDate(fm.\u0434\u0430\u0442\u0430 ?? p.\u0434\u0430\u0442\u0430) || parseDate(p.file.cday);
      if (!d || d < MIN_DATE || d > today) continue;

      const category = cleanStr(fm.\u043A\u0430\u0442\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0440\u0438\u044F ?? p.\u043A\u0430\u0442\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0440\u0438\u044F) || "\u041C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C";
      const essence = cleanStr(fm.\u0441\u0443\u0442\u044C ?? p.\u0441\u0443\u0442\u044C);
      const status = cleanStr(fm.\u0441\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0443\u0441 ?? p.\u0441\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0443\u0441);
      const source = cleanStr(fm.\u0438\u0441\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043D\u0438\u043A ?? p.\u0438\u0441\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043D\u0438\u043A);
      const pinned = (fm.\u0437\u0430\u043A\u0440\u0435\u043F\u043B\u0435\u043D\u043E ?? p.\u0437\u0430\u043A\u0440\u0435\u043F\u043B\u0435\u043D\u043E) === true;
      const importance = validNum(fm.\u0432\u0430\u0436\u043D\u043E\u0441\u0442\u044C ?? p.\u0432\u0430\u0436\u043D\u043E\u0441\u0442\u044C);
      const tags = cleanList(fm.\u0442\u0435\u0433\u0438 ?? p.\u0442\u0435\u0433\u0438);

      items.push({
        page: p,
        path: p.file.path,
        title: p.file.name,
        date: d,
        iso: d.toISODate(),
        category,
        essence,
        status,
        source,
        pinned,
        importance,
        tags,
        mtime: p.file.mtime?.toMillis?.() ?? 0
      });
    }
    return items;
  }

  async function ensureFolderExists(folderPath) {
    let acc = "";
    for (const part of normalizePath(folderPath).split("/")) {
      acc = acc ? \`\${acc}/\${part}\` : part;
      if (!app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(acc)) {
        await app.vault.createFolder(acc);
      }
    }
  }

  function buildCleanFilePath(folderPath, isoDate, categoryName, currentFilePath = null) {
    const safeCat = (cleanStr(categoryName) || "\u041C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C").replace(/[\\\\/:*?"<>|\\n\\r]/g, "").trim() || "\u041C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C";
    const baseName = \`\${isoDate} \u2014 \${safeCat}\`;
    let candidate = normalizePath(\`\${folderPath}/\${baseName}.md\`);
    let counter = 2;
    while (app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(candidate) && candidate !== currentFilePath) {
      candidate = normalizePath(\`\${folderPath}/\${baseName} \${counter++}.md\`);
    }
    return candidate;
  }

  function formatThoughtMarkdown({ iso, category, essence, tags, source, status, importance, pinned }) {
    return [
      "---",
      \`\${MARKER_PROP}: true\`,
      \`\u0434\u0430\u0442\u0430: "\${iso}"\`,
      \`\u043A\u0430\u0442\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0440\u0438\u044F: \${JSON.stringify(category)}\`,
      \`\u0441\u0443\u0442\u044C: \${JSON.stringify(essence)}\`,
      tags.length ? "\u0442\u0435\u0433\u0438:\\n" + tags.map(t => \`  - \${JSON.stringify(t)}\`).join("\\n") : "\u0442\u0435\u0433\u0438: []",
      \`\u0438\u0441\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043D\u0438\u043A: \${source ? JSON.stringify(source) : '""'}\`,
      \`\u0441\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0443\u0441: \${status ? JSON.stringify(status) : '""'}\`,
      \`\u0432\u0430\u0436\u043D\u043E\u0441\u0442\u044C: \${importance !== null ? importance : ""}\`,
      \`\u0437\u0430\u043A\u0440\u0435\u043F\u043B\u0435\u043D\u043E: \${pinned ? "true" : "false"}\`,
      "---",
      "",
      essence,
      ""
    ].join("\\n");
  }

  let busy = false;
  async function togglePin(item, btn) {
    if (busy) return;
    const file = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(item.path);
    if (!file) return;
    busy = true;
    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    try {
      const next = !item.pinned;
      await app.fileManager.processFrontMatter(file, fm => {
        fm.\u0437\u0430\u043A\u0440\u0435\u043F\u043B\u0435\u043D\u043E = next;
      });
      setTimeout(render, 80);
    } catch (e) {
      new Notice("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430: " + (e?.message || e));
    } finally {
      busy = false;
      if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  const root = dv.container.createDiv({ cls: "dh-thoughts" });

  const THOUGHTS_CSS = \`
  .dh-thoughts {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-top: 6px;
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-topbar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-pills {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 5px;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .dh-thoughts button.dht-pill {
    display: inline-flex;

  }

  .dh-thoughts input.dht-search {

  }
  .dh-thoughts select.dht-sort {
    height: 28px;
    font-size: 0.76rem;
    padding: 0 22px 0 8px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--background-primary);

  }
  .dh-thoughts button.dht-btn-primary {
    height: 28px;
    padding: 0 11px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: 0.77rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-form,
  .dh-thoughts .dht-edit-box {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--background-primary);

    border-top: 2px solid #e5a158;
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-form-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.3fr 0.7fr 1fr 1.2fr 1.2fr;

  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-input,
  .dh-thoughts .dht-textarea {
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    padding: 5px 8px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--background-secondary);
    border: 1px solid var(--background-modifier-border);
    color: var(--text-normal);
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-input {
    height: 30px;
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-textarea {
    resize: vertical;
    min-height: 54px;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-cat-hints {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 4px;
  }
  .dh-thoughts button.dht-mini-chip {
    height: 20px;
    padding: 0 7px;
    font-size: 0.69rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--background-secondary);
    border: 1px solid var(--background-modifier-border);
    color: var(--text-muted);
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-rows {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 10px;

    background: var(--background-primary);
    border: 1px solid var(--background-modifier-border);
    transition: border-color 0.14s ease;
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-row.is-pinned {
    border-left: 3px solid #e5a158;
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-row-main {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 8px;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-badge-cat {
    font-size: 0.69rem;
    font-weight: 650;
    padding: 1px 7px;
    border-radius: 5px;
    background: var(--background-secondary);
    border: 1px solid var(--background-modifier-border);
    color: var(--text-muted);
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-row-text {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    color: var(--text-normal);
    word-break: break-word;
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-row-meta {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-imp {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 1px 6px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: #e5a158;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, #e5a158 15%, transparent);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-status,
  .dh-thoughts .dht-tag,
  .dh-thoughts .dht-source {
    font-size: 0.69rem;
    padding: 1px 6px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: var(--background-secondary);
    color: var(--text-muted);
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-date {
    font-size: 0.71rem;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .dh-thoughts button.dht-icon-btn {
    height: 22px;
    min-width: 22px;
    padding: 0 5px;
    border-radius: 5px;
    font-size: 0.73rem;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  .dh-thoughts button.dht-icon-btn:hover {
    color: var(--text-normal);
    background: var(--background-secondary);
    border-color: var(--background-modifier-border);
  }
  .dh-thoughts button.dht-icon-btn.is-pinned {
    color: #e5a158;
  }
  .dh-thoughts .dht-empty {
    padding: 12px;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    background: var(--background-primary);
    border-radius: 7px;
    border: 1px dashed var(--background-modifier-border);
  }
  @media (max-width: 680px) {
    .dh-thoughts .dht-form-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    }
    .dh-thoughts .dht-row {
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .dh-thoughts .dht-row-meta {
      width: 100%;
      justify-content: flex-end;
    }
  }
  \`;

  function render() {
    root.replaceChildren();
    const styleEl = root.createEl("style");
    styleEl.textContent = THOUGHTS_CSS;

    const allItems = loadThoughts();

    const catCounts = new Map();
    for (const it of allItems) {
      catCounts.set(it.category, (catCounts.get(it.category) || 0) + 1);
    }
    const categories = [...catCounts.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1] || a[0].localeCompare(b[0], "ru"));
    if (state.category && !catCounts.has(state.category)) {
      state.category = "";
      persist();
    }

    const topBar = root.createDiv({ cls: "dht-topbar" });
    const pillsWrap = topBar.createDiv({ cls: "dht-pills" });

    const allBtn = pillsWrap.createEl("button", {
      cls: \`dht-pill\${!state.category ? " is-active" : ""}\`,
      attr: { type: "button" }
    });
    allBtn.onmousedown = e => e.preventDefault();
    allBtn.createSpan({ text: "\u0412\u0441\u0435" });
    allBtn.createSpan({ cls: "dht-pill-count", text: String(allItems.length) });
    allBtn.onclick = () => { state.category = ""; persist(); render(); };

    for (const [catName, count] of categories) {
      const btn = pillsWrap.createEl("button", {
        cls: \`dht-pill\${state.category === catName ? " is-active" : ""}\`,
        attr: { type: "button" }
      });
      btn.onmousedown = e => e.preventDefault();
      btn.createSpan({ text: catName });
      btn.createSpan({ cls: "dht-pill-count", text: String(count) });
      btn.onclick = () => {
        state.category = state.category === catName ? "" : catName;
        persist();
        render();
      };
    }

    const actionsWrap = topBar.createDiv({ cls: "dht-actions" });

    const searchInput = actionsWrap.createEl("input", {
      cls: "dht-search",
      attr: { type: "search", placeholder: "\u041F\u043E\u0438\u0441\u043A...", value: state.query }
    });
    searchInput.oninput = () => {
      state.query = searchInput.value;
      persist();
      renderListOnly();
    };

    const sortSelect = actionsWrap.createEl("select", {
      cls: "dropdown dht-sort",
      attr: { title: "\u0421\u043E\u0440\u0442\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u043A\u0430 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0435\u0439" }
    });
    [
      { value: "date-desc", label: "\u0421\u043D\u0430\u0447\u0430\u043B\u0430 \u043D\u043E\u0432\u044B\u0435" },
      { value: "imp-desc", label: "\u041F\u043E \u0432\u0430\u0436\u043D\u043E\u0441\u0442\u0438 (5 \u2192 1)" },
      { value: "imp-asc", label: "\u041F\u043E \u0432\u0430\u0436\u043D\u043E\u0441\u0442\u0438 (1 \u2192 5)" },
      { value: "date-asc", label: "\u0421\u043D\u0430\u0447\u0430\u043B\u0430 \u0441\u0442\u0430\u0440\u044B\u0435" }
    ].forEach(opt => {
      const o = sortSelect.createEl("option", { text: opt.label, value: opt.value });
      if (state.sortBy === opt.value) o.selected = true;
    });
    sortSelect.onchange = () => {
      state.sortBy = sortSelect.value;
      persist();
      renderListOnly();
    };

    const addBtn = actionsWrap.createEl("button", {
      cls: \`dht-btn-primary\${state.formOpen ? " is-open" : ""}\`,
      text: state.formOpen ? "\u2715" : "+ \u0417\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0430\u0442\u044C",
      attr: { type: "button" }
    });
    addBtn.onmousedown = e => e.preventDefault();
    addBtn.onclick = () => {
      state.formOpen = !state.formOpen;
      persist();
      render();
    };

    if (state.formOpen) {
      const form = root.createEl("form", { cls: "dht-form" });

      const essenceInput = form.createEl("textarea", {
        cls: "dht-textarea",
        attr: { rows: "2", placeholder: "\u0422\u0435\u043A\u0441\u0442 \u043C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u0438, \u0438\u0434\u0435\u0438 \u0438\u043B\u0438 \u0444\u0430\u043A\u0442\u0430 *" }
      });

      const metaGrid = form.createDiv({ cls: "dht-form-grid" });
      const catInput = metaGrid.createEl("input", {
        cls: "dht-input",
        attr: { type: "text", placeholder: "\u041A\u0430\u0442\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0440\u0438\u044F", value: state.category || "\u041C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C" }
      });
      const impInput = metaGrid.createEl("input", {
        cls: "dht-input",
        attr: { type: "number", min: "1", max: "5", placeholder: "\u26A1 1\u20135" }
      });
      const statusInput = metaGrid.createEl("input", {
        cls: "dht-input",
        attr: { type: "text", placeholder: "\u0421\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0443\u0441" }
      });
      const tagsInput = metaGrid.createEl("input", {
        cls: "dht-input",
        attr: { type: "text", placeholder: "\u0422\u0435\u0433\u0438 (\u0447\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0437 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u044F\u0442\u0443\u044E)" }
      });
      const srcInput = metaGrid.createEl("input", {
        cls: "dht-input",
        attr: { type: "text", placeholder: "\u0418\u0441\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043D\u0438\u043A" }
      });

      const bottomBar = form.createDiv({
        attr: { style: "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;" }
      });

      const leftHints = bottomBar.createDiv({ cls: "dht-cat-hints" });
      for (const [cName] of categories.slice(0, 6)) {
        const chip = leftHints.createEl("button", { cls: "dht-mini-chip", text: cName, attr: { type: "button" } });
        chip.onmousedown = e => e.preventDefault();
        chip.onclick = () => { catInput.value = cName; };
      }

      const rightControls = bottomBar.createDiv({ attr: { style: "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-left: auto;" } });
      const pinLabel = rightControls.createEl("label", {
        attr: { style: "display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer;" }
      });
      const pinCheck = pinLabel.createEl("input", { attr: { type: "checkbox" } });
      pinLabel.createSpan({ text: "\u2605 \u0417\u0430\u043A\u0440\u0435\u043F\u0438\u0442\u044C" });

      const submitBtn = rightControls.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dht-btn-primary mod-cta",
        text: "\u2713 \u0421\u043E\u0445\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0442\u044C",
        attr: { type: "submit" }
      });

      form.onsubmit = async e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (busy) return;
        const catVal = cleanStr(catInput.value) || "\u041C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C";
        const essenceVal = cleanStr(essenceInput.value);
        if (!essenceVal) {
          new Notice("\u0412\u0432\u0435\u0434\u0438 \u0442\u0435\u043A\u0441\u0442 \u043C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u0438.");
          essenceInput.focus();
          return;
        }

        const numImp = validNum(impInput.value);
        const validImp = numImp !== null && numImp >= 1 && numImp <= 5 ? Math.round(numImp) : null;
        const tagsArr = tagsInput.value.split(",").map(s => s.trim().replace(/^#/, "")).filter(Boolean);
        const srcVal = cleanStr(srcInput.value);
        const stVal = cleanStr(statusInput.value);

        busy = true;
        submitBtn.disabled = true;
        try {
          await ensureFolderExists(DEFAULT_FOLDER);
          const finalPath = buildCleanFilePath(DEFAULT_FOLDER, todayISO, catVal);
          const content = formatThoughtMarkdown({
            iso: todayISO,
            category: catVal,
            essence: essenceVal,
            tags: tagsArr,
            source: srcVal,
            status: stVal,
            importance: validImp,
            pinned: pinCheck.checked
          });

          await app.vault.create(finalPath, content);
          state.formOpen = false;
          persist();
          setTimeout(render, 100);
        } catch (err) {
          new Notice("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u0441\u043E\u0445\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F: " + (err?.message || err));
        } finally {
          busy = false;
          submitBtn.disabled = false;
        }
      };
    }

    const listHost = root.createDiv({ cls: "dht-list-host" });

    function renderListOnly() {
      listHost.replaceChildren();
      const q = state.query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase("ru");

      const filtered = allItems.filter(it => {
        if (state.category && it.category !== state.category) return false;
        if (!q) return true;
        const haystack = [it.essence, it.category, it.status, it.source, ...it.tags].join(" ").toLocaleLowerCase("ru");
        return haystack.includes(q);
      });

      filtered.sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.pinned !== b.pinned) return a.pinned ? -1 : 1;
        if (state.sortBy === "imp-desc") {
          const impA = a.importance ?? -1;
          const impB = b.importance ?? -1;
          if (impA !== impB) return impB - impA;
        } else if (state.sortBy === "imp-asc") {
          const impA = a.importance ?? 99;
          const impB = b.importance ?? 99;
          if (impA !== impB) return impA - impB;
        } else if (state.sortBy === "date-asc") {
          return a.iso.localeCompare(b.iso) || a.mtime - b.mtime;
        }
        return b.iso.localeCompare(a.iso) || b.mtime - a.mtime;
      });

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        listHost.createDiv({
          cls: "dht-empty",
          text: allItems.length === 0 ? "\u0417\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0435\u0439 \u043F\u043E\u043A\u0430 \u043D\u0435\u0442." : "\u041D\u0438\u0447\u0435\u0433\u043E \u043D\u0435 \u043D\u0430\u0439\u0434\u0435\u043D\u043E."
        });
        return;
      }

      const visibleRows = (state.showAll || state.category || q)
        ? filtered
        : filtered.slice(0, RECENT_LIMIT);

      const rowsBox = listHost.createDiv({ cls: "dht-rows" });

      for (const item of visibleRows) {
        if (state.editingPath === item.path) {
          const editBox = rowsBox.createDiv({ cls: "dht-edit-box" });

          const eText = editBox.createEl("textarea", {
            cls: "dht-textarea",
            attr: { rows: "2", placeholder: "\u0422\u0435\u043A\u0441\u0442 \u043C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u0438 *" }
          });
          eText.value = item.essence || item.title;

          const eGrid = editBox.createDiv({ cls: "dht-form-grid" });
          const eCat = eGrid.createEl("input", {
            cls: "dht-input",
            attr: { type: "text", placeholder: "\u041A\u0430\u0442\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0440\u0438\u044F", value: item.category }
          });
          const eImp = eGrid.createEl("input", {
            cls: "dht-input",
            attr: { type: "number", min: "1", max: "5", placeholder: "\u26A1 1\u20135", value: item.importance !== null ? String(item.importance) : "" }
          });
          const eStatus = eGrid.createEl("input", {
            cls: "dht-input",
            attr: { type: "text", placeholder: "\u0421\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0443\u0441", value: item.status }
          });
          const eTags = eGrid.createEl("input", {
            cls: "dht-input",
            attr: { type: "text", placeholder: "\u0422\u0435\u0433\u0438", value: item.tags.join(", ") }
          });
          const eSrc = eGrid.createEl("input", {
            cls: "dht-input",
            attr: { type: "text", placeholder: "\u0418\u0441\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043D\u0438\u043A", value: item.source }
          });

          const eActions = editBox.createDiv({
            attr: { style: "display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 6px;" }
          });
          const saveBtn = eActions.createEl("button", {
            cls: "dht-btn-primary mod-cta",
            text: "\u2713 \u0421\u043E\u0445\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0442\u044C",
            attr: { type: "button" }
          });
          const cancelBtn = eActions.createEl("button", {
            cls: "dht-icon-btn",
            text: "\u2715",
            attr: { type: "button", title: "\u041E\u0442\u043C\u0435\u043D\u0430" }
          });

          cancelBtn.onclick = () => {
            state.editingPath = null;
            renderListOnly();
          };

          saveBtn.onclick = async () => {
            if (busy) return;
            const nextEssence = cleanStr(eText.value);
            if (!nextEssence) {
              new Notice("\u0422\u0435\u043A\u0441\u0442 \u043C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u0438 \u043D\u0435 \u043C\u043E\u0436\u0435\u0442 \u0431\u044B\u0442\u044C \u043F\u0443\u0441\u0442\u044B\u043C.");
              return;
            }
            const nextCat = cleanStr(eCat.value) || "\u041C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C";
            const rawImp = validNum(eImp.value);
            const nextImp = rawImp !== null && rawImp >= 1 && rawImp <= 5 ? Math.round(rawImp) : null;
            const nextStatus = cleanStr(eStatus.value);
            const nextTags = eTags.value.split(",").map(s => s.trim().replace(/^#/, "")).filter(Boolean);
            const nextSrc = cleanStr(eSrc.value);

            const file = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(item.path);
            if (!file) return;

            busy = true;
            saveBtn.disabled = true;
            try {
              const newContent = formatThoughtMarkdown({
                iso: item.iso,
                category: nextCat,
                essence: nextEssence,
                tags: nextTags,
                source: nextSrc,
                status: nextStatus,
                importance: nextImp,
                pinned: item.pinned
              });
              await app.vault.modify(file, newContent);

              const folderPath = file.parent ? file.parent.path : DEFAULT_FOLDER;
              const desiredPrefix = \`\${item.iso} \u2014 \${nextCat}\`;
              if (!file.basename.startsWith(desiredPrefix) || file.basename.length > desiredPrefix.length + 4) {
                const cleanTarget = buildCleanFilePath(folderPath, item.iso, nextCat, file.path);
                if (cleanTarget !== file.path) {
                  await app.fileManager.renameFile(file, cleanTarget);
                }
              }

              state.editingPath = null;
              setTimeout(render, 100);
            } catch (err) {
              new Notice("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u043E\u0431\u043D\u043E\u0432\u043B\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F: " + (err?.message || err));
            } finally {
              busy = false;
              saveBtn.disabled = false;
            }
          };
          continue;
        }

        const row = rowsBox.createDiv({ cls: \`dht-row\${item.pinned ? " is-pinned" : ""}\` });
        const main = row.createDiv({ cls: "dht-row-main" });

        const catBadge = main.createSpan({ cls: "dht-badge-cat", text: item.category });
        catBadge.onclick = () => {
          state.category = state.category === item.category ? "" : item.category;
          persist();
          render();
        };

        main.createSpan({
          cls: "dht-row-text",
          text: item.essence || item.title
        });

        const meta = row.createDiv({ cls: "dht-row-meta" });
        if (item.importance !== null) {
          meta.createSpan({ cls: "dht-imp", text: \`\u26A1\${item.importance}\`, attr: { title: \`\u0412\u0430\u0436\u043D\u043E\u0441\u0442\u044C: \${item.importance}\` } });
        }

  function number(v) {\r
    if (typeof v === "number") return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : null;\r
    if (typeof v !== "string") return null;\r
    const s = v.trim().replace(",", ".");\r
    if (!s) return null;\r
    const num = Number(s);\r
    return Number.isFinite(num) ? num : null;\r
  }\r
\r
  function asDate(v) {\r
    if (empty(v)) return null;\r
    try { const d = dv.date(v); return d && d.isValid ? d.startOf("day") : null; } catch { return null; }\r
  }\r
\r
  function toISODateString(v) {\r
    if (empty(v)) return null;\r
    const d = asDate(v);\r
    if (d) return d.toISODate();\r
    const m = moment(String(v).trim(), ["YYYY-MM-DD", moment.ISO_8601], true);\r
    return m.isValid() ? m.format("YYYY-MM-DD") : null;\r
  }\r
\r
  function isValidTimeStr(v) {\r
    if (typeof v !== "string" || v.length !== 5 || v[2] !== ":") return false;\r
    const hh = Number(v.slice(0, 2));\r
    const mm = Number(v.slice(3, 5));\r
    return Number.isInteger(hh) && hh >= 0 && hh <= 23 && Number.isInteger(mm) && mm >= 0 && mm <= 59;\r
  }\r

  function readJsonStorage(key, fallback) {\r
    try {\r
      const raw = window.localStorage?.getItem(key);\r
      return raw ? { ...fallback, ...JSON.parse(raw) } : { ...fallback };\r
    } catch {\r
      return { ...fallback };\r
    }\r
  }\r
  function writeJsonStorage(key, value) {\r
    try { window.localStorage?.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value)); } catch {}\r
  }\r
\r
  if (!window.__dhWorkoutHubUi) {\r
    window.__dhWorkoutHubUi = readJsonStorage(UI_STORAGE_KEY, {\r

    });\r

  function saveHubUi(patch) {\r

  function parseSetsFromContent(content) {\r
    const sets = [];\r
    if (!content) return sets;\r
    content.split(/\\r?\\n/).forEach(line => {\r
      const m = line.match(SET_LINE_REGEX);\r
      if (!m) return;\r
      const name = m[1].trim();\r
      const field = m[2].trim();\r
      const val = Number(m[3].replace(",", "."));\r
      const weight = Number(m[4].replace(",", "."));\r
      const variant = m[5].trim() || "\u041E\u0441\u043D\u043E\u0432\u043D\u043E\u0439";\r
      if (Number.isFinite(val) && val > 0 && Number.isFinite(weight) && weight >= 0) {\r
        sets.push({ name, field, reps: val, weight, variant });\r
      }\r
    });\r
    return sets;\r
  }\r

const notify = msg => { try { new Notice(msg); } catch { console.log(msg); } };
const plural = (n, f) => {
  const a = Math.abs(n) % 100, b = a % 10;
  return a > 10 && a < 20 ? f[2] : b > 1 && b < 5 ? f[1] : b === 1 ? f[0] : f[2];
};

const normalizeSpaces = s => String(s ?? "").replace(/\\s+/g, " ").trim();
const today = dv.date("today").startOf("day");
