        attr: {
          type: "button",
          title: d.parentName ? "\u041F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442: " + d.parentName : "\u0424\u0430\u0439\u043B: " + d.path
        }
      });
      chip.onclick = () => {
        ui.selectedDeckPath = d.path;
        ui.singleDraft.isBi = d.defaultBi;
        ui.bulkDraft.defaultBi = d.defaultBi;
        renderCardsSection(cardsContainer, activeProjects);
      };
    });

    if (activeDeck) {
      const openDeckNoteLink = decksBar.createEl("a", {
        cls: "internal-link",
        text: "\u{1F4C4} " + activeDeck.fileName,
        attr: {
          href: activeDeck.path,
          style: "margin-left: auto; font-size: 0.74rem; color: var(--text-muted); text-decoration: none;"
        }
      });
      openDeckNoteLink.onclick = e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        app.workspace.openLinkText(activeDeck.path, dv.currentFilePath, e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey);
      };
    }
  } else {
    panel.createDiv({
      text: "\u0423\u0447\u0435\u0431\u043D\u044B\u0445 \u0442\u0435\u043C \u0441 \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043A\u0430\u043C\u0438 \u043F\u043E\u043A\u0430 \u043D\u0435\u0442. \u041D\u0430\u0436\u043C\u0438 \xAB+ \u0422\u0435\u043C\u0430\xBB \u0432 \u043F\u0440\u0430\u0432\u043E\u043C \u0432\u0435\u0440\u0445\u043D\u0435\u043C \u0443\u0433\u043B\u0443, \u0447\u0442\u043E\u0431\u044B \u0441\u043E\u0437\u0434\u0430\u0442\u044C \u043F\u0435\u0440\u0432\u0443\u044E \u0442\u0435\u043C\u0443.",
      attr: {
        style: "padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 10px; font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-muted); background: var(--background-primary); border-radius: 8px; border: 1px dashed var(--background-modifier-border);"
      }
    });
  }

  // 3. \u0421\u0432\u043E\u0434\u043D\u044B\u0435 \u043F\u043B\u0438\u0442\u043A\u0438 \u0438 \u0434\u0435\u0439\u0441\u0442\u0432\u0438\u044F
  const summaryGrid = panel.createDiv({ cls: "dsc-summary-grid" });

  const dueBox = summaryGrid.createDiv({
    cls: "dsc-stat-box",
    attr: { style: "border-top: 2px solid " + (scopedDue > 0 ? "#e5a158" : "#4aab80") + ";" }
  });
  dueBox.createDiv({ cls: "dsc-stat-label", text: activeDeck ? "\u041A \u043F\u043E\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044E \xB7 " + activeDeck.title : "\u041A \u043F\u043E\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044E" });
  const dueValRow = dueBox.createDiv({ cls: "dsc-stat-val-row" });
  dueValRow.createSpan({
    cls: "dsc-stat-val",
    text: String(scopedDue),
    attr: { style: "color: " + (scopedDue > 0 ? "#e5a158" : "#4aab80") + ";" }
  });
  dueValRow.createSpan({
    text: scopedDue === 0 ? "\u041E\u0447\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0434\u044C \u0437\u0430\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u0430 \u2713" : "\u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442. \u043F\u043E \u0440\u0430\u0441\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0430\u043D\u0438\u044E",
    attr: { style: "font-size: 0.71rem; color: var(--text-muted);" }
  });
  dueBox.createDiv({
    cls: "dsc-stat-hint",
    text: scopedNew > 0 ? "+ " + scopedNew + " \u043D\u043E\u0432\u044B\u0445 \u0432 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0430\u0441\u0435" : "\u0412\u043E\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0441\u043E\u0432 \u0432 \u0432\u044B\u0431\u043E\u0440\u043A\u0435: " + scopedEntries
  });

  const masteryPct = scopedDirections > 0 ? Math.round((scopedMature / scopedDirections) * 100) : 0;
  const mastBox = summaryGrid.createDiv({
    cls: "dsc-stat-box",
    attr: { style: "border-top: 2px solid #9c83e8;" }
  });
  mastBox.createDiv({ cls: "dsc-stat-label", text: "\u0423\u0441\u0432\u043E\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435 \u0438 \u0431\u0430\u0437\u0430" });
  const mastValRow = mastBox.createDiv({ cls: "dsc-stat-val-row" });
  mastValRow.createSpan({
    cls: "dsc-stat-val",
    text: scopedEntries + " \u0432\u043E\u043F\u0440."
  });
  mastValRow.createSpan({
    text: "\u0437\u0430\u043A\u0440\u0435\u043F\u043B\u0435\u043D\u043E " + masteryPct + "%",
    attr: { style: "font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; color: #4aab80;" }
  });
  mastBox.createDiv({
    cls: "dsc-stat-hint",
    text: "\u0417\u0430 \u0434\u0435\u043D\u044C: " + scopedReviewedToday + " \xB7 \u0421\u0442\u043E\u0440\u043E\u043D: " + scopedDirections
  });

  const actBox = summaryGrid.createDiv({ cls: "dsc-actions-box" });
  const actRow = actBox.createDiv({ cls: "dsc-actions-row" });

  const trainBtn = actRow.createEl("button", {
    cls: "dh-btn mod-cta dsc-btn-cta",
    text: scopedDue > 0 ? "\u25B6 \u0422\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u0430\u0442\u044C (" + scopedDue + ")" : "\u25B6 \u0422\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u0430\u0442\u044C",
    attr: {
      type: "button",
      title: "\u041E\u0442\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u044C \u0443\u0447\u0435\u0431\u043D\u044B\u0435 \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043A\u0438 \u0432 my-sr-trainer",
      "aria-label": "\u041E\u0442\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u044C \u0443\u0447\u0435\u0431\u043D\u044B\u0435 \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043A\u0438"
    }
  });
  trainBtn.onclick = () => {
    openStudyTrainer(scopedDue === 0 && scopedNew === 0 ? "CRAM_ALL" : "DUE_AND_NEW");
  };

  const addCardsBtn = actRow.createEl("button", {
    cls: "dsc-btn-sec" + (ui.isAddCardsOpen ? " is-active" : ""),
    text: ui.isAddCardsOpen ? "\u2715 \u0421\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u044C" : "+ \u0412\u043E\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0441\u044B",
    attr: { type: "button" }
  });
  addCardsBtn.onclick = () => {
    if (decks.length === 0) {
      ui.isNewDeckFormOpen = true;
      notify("\u0421\u043D\u0430\u0447\u0430\u043B\u0430 \u0443\u043A\u0430\u0436\u0438 \u043D\u0430\u0437\u0432\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0435 \u0442\u0435\u043C\u044B.");
    } else {
      ui.isAddCardsOpen = !ui.isAddCardsOpen;
      if (ui.isAddCardsOpen) focusQuestionAfterRender = true;
    }
    renderCardsSection(cardsContainer, activeProjects);
  };

  if (scopedEntries > 0) {
    const listManageBtn = actRow.createEl("button", {
      cls: "dsc-btn-sec" + (ui.isListManageOpen ? " is-active" : ""),
      text: ui.isListManageOpen ? "\u2715 \u0421\u043F\u0438\u0441\u043E\u043A" : "\u{1F4CB} (" + scopedEntries + ")",
      attr: { type: "button", title: "\u041F\u043E\u043A\u0430\u0437\u0430\u0442\u044C \u0432\u0441\u0435 \u0432\u043E\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0441\u044B \u0442\u0435\u043C\u044B \u0434\u043B\u044F \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0441\u043C\u043E\u0442\u0440\u0430 \u0438 \u043F\u0440\u0430\u0432\u043A\u0438" }
    });
    listManageBtn.onclick = () => {
      ui.isListManageOpen = !ui.isListManageOpen;
      renderCardsSection(cardsContainer, activeProjects);
    };
  }

  // 4. \u0424\u043E\u0440\u043C\u0430 \u0434\u043E\u0431\u0430\u0432\u043B\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F \u0432\u043E\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0441\u043E\u0432
  if (ui.isAddCardsOpen && decks.length > 0) {
    const addDrawer = panel.createDiv({ cls: "dsc-drawer" });

    const topAddBar = addDrawer.createDiv({
      attr: { style: "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px;" }
    });

    const leftTargetRow = topAddBar.createDiv({ attr: { style: "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;" } });
    leftTargetRow.createSpan({ text: "\u0422\u0435\u043C\u0430:", attr: { style: "font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted);" } });

    const targetDeckSel = leftTargetRow.createEl("select", {
      cls: "dropdown",
      attr: { style: "font-size: 0.82rem; height: 30px; font-weight: 600;" }
    });
    const effectiveTargetDeckPath = ui.selectedDeckPath !== "ALL" ? ui.selectedDeckPath : decks[0].path;
    decks.forEach(d => {
      const o = targetDeckSel.createEl("option", { text: d.title, value: d.path });
      if (d.path === effectiveTargetDeckPath) o.selected = true;
    });
    targetDeckSel.onchange = () => {
      ui.selectedDeckPath = targetDeckSel.value;
      renderCardsSection(cardsContainer, activeProjects);
    };

    if (ui.lastAddedBadge) {
      const badge = leftTargetRow.createSpan({
        text: "\u2713 " + ui.lastAddedBadge,
        attr: {
          style: "font-size: 0.73rem; font-weight: 600; color: #4aab80; background: #4aab8018; border: 1px solid #4aab8044; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 5px;"
        }
      });
      setTimeout(() => {
        ui.lastAddedBadge = null;
        if (badge.isConnected) badge.remove();
      }, 4500);
    }

    const modeTabs = topAddBar.createDiv({ cls: "dh-chips", attr: { style: "display: flex; gap: 5px;" } });
    [
      { id: "SINGLE", label: "\u270D\uFE0F \u041F\u043E \u043E\u0434\u043D\u043E\u0439" },
      { id: "BULK", label: "\u{1F4CB} \u0421\u043F\u0438\u0441\u043A\u043E\u043C" }
    ].forEach(tab => {
      const b = modeTabs.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dh-chip" + (ui.addMode === tab.id ? " is-active" : ""),
        text: tab.label,
        attr: { type: "button", style: "font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 3px 10px; cursor: pointer;" }
      });
      b.onclick = () => {
        ui.addMode = tab.id;
        renderCardsSection(cardsContainer, activeProjects);
      };
    });

    if (ui.addMode === "SINGLE") {
      const dirTypeRow = addDrawer.createDiv({
        attr: { style: "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;" }
      });
      dirTypeRow.createSpan({ text: "\u0424\u043E\u0440\u043C\u0430\u0442:", attr: { style: "font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--text-muted);" } });

      const singleDirBtn = dirTypeRow.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dh-chip" + (!ui.singleDraft.isBi ? " is-active" : ""),
        text: "\u2192 \u041E\u0434\u043D\u043E\u0441\u0442\u043E\u0440\u043E\u043D\u043D\u044F\u044F (:: \u0412\u043E\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0441 \u2192 \u041E\u0442\u0432\u0435\u0442)",
        attr: { type: "button", style: "font-size: 0.74rem; padding: 2px 10px; cursor: pointer;" }
      });
      const biDirBtn = dirTypeRow.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dh-chip" + (ui.singleDraft.isBi ? " is-active" : ""),
        text: "\u21C4 \u0414\u0432\u0443\u0441\u0442\u043E\u0440\u043E\u043D\u043D\u044F\u044F (::: \u0422\u0435\u0440\u043C\u0438\u043D \u21C4 \u041E\u043F\u0440\u0435\u0434\u0435\u043B\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435)",
        attr: { type: "button", style: "font-size: 0.74rem; padding: 2px 10px; cursor: pointer;" }
      });
      singleDirBtn.onclick = () => { ui.singleDraft.isBi = false; renderCardsSection(cardsContainer, activeProjects); };
      biDirBtn.onclick = () => { ui.singleDraft.isBi = true; renderCardsSection(cardsContainer, activeProjects); };

      const inputsRow = addDrawer.createDiv({
        attr: { style: "display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 8px;" }
      });

      const qInp = inputsRow.createEl("input", {
        attr: {
          type: "text",
          placeholder: ui.singleDraft.isBi ? "\u0422\u0435\u0440\u043C\u0438\u043D / \u041F\u043E\u043D\u044F\u0442\u0438\u0435 / \u0424\u043E\u0440\u043C\u0443\u043B\u0430 *" : "\u0412\u043E\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0441 \u0431\u0438\u043B\u0435\u0442\u0430 / \u0442\u0435\u0441\u0442\u0430 *",
          value: ui.singleDraft.q || "",
          style: "font-size: 0.84rem; height: 34px; padding: 4px 10px;"
        }
      });
      qInp.oninput = () => { ui.singleDraft.q = qInp.value; };

      const aInp = inputsRow.createEl("input", {
        attr: {
          type: "text",
          placeholder: ui.singleDraft.isBi ? "\u041E\u043F\u0440\u0435\u0434\u0435\u043B\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435 / \u0417\u043D\u0430\u0447\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435 *" : "\u041F\u0440\u0430\u0432\u0438\u043B\u044C\u043D\u044B\u0439 \u043E\u0442\u0432\u0435\u0442 *",
          value: ui.singleDraft.a || "",
          style: "font-size: 0.84rem; height: 34px; padding: 4px 10px;"
        }
      });
      aInp.oninput = () => { ui.singleDraft.a = aInp.value; };

      const bottomRow = addDrawer.createDiv({
        attr: { style: "display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;" }
      });

      const hintInp = bottomRow.createEl("input", {
        attr: {
          type: "text",
          placeholder: "\u041F\u043E\u044F\u0441\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435 \u043D\u0430 \u043E\u0431\u043E\u0440\u043E\u0442\u0435 (\u043D\u0435\u043E\u0431\u044F\u0437\u0430\u0442\u0435\u043B\u044C\u043D\u043E)",
          value: ui.singleDraft.hint || "",
          style: "flex: 1; min-width: 180px; font-size: 0.8rem; height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px;"
        }
      });
      hintInp.oninput = () => { ui.singleDraft.hint = hintInp.value; };

      const saveSingleBtn = bottomRow.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dh-btn mod-cta",
        text: "+ \u0421\u043E\u0445\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0442\u044C",
        attr: { type: "button", style: "font-size: 0.82rem; height: 32px; padding: 0 16px; white-space: nowrap;" }
      });

      const submitSingleCard = async () => {
        if (saveSingleBtn.disabled) return;
        const q = cleanLineText(qInp.value);
        const a = cleanLineText(aInp.value);
        const h = cleanLineText(hintInp.value);
        const targetDeck = deckByPath.get(targetDeckSel.value);

        if (!q || !a) {
          notify("\u0417\u0430\u043F\u043E\u043B\u043D\u0438 \u0438 \u0432\u043E\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0441, \u0438 \u043E\u0442\u0432\u0435\u0442.");
          return;
        }
        if (!targetDeck) {
          notify("\u0412\u044B\u0431\u0435\u0440\u0438 \u0442\u0435\u043C\u0443.");
          return;
        }

        saveSingleBtn.disabled = true;
        try {
          const sep = ui.singleDraft.isBi ? ":::" : "::";
          const frontStr = h ? q + HINT_SEP + h : q;
          const curContent = await app.vault.read(targetDeck.fileObj);
          const prefix = curContent.length > 0 && !curContent.endsWith("\\n") ? "\\n" : "";

          await enqueueDiskWrite(() => app.vault.append(targetDeck.fileObj, prefix + frontStr + " " + sep + " " + a + "\\n"));

          ui.lastAddedBadge = q.slice(0, 28) + (q.length > 28 ? "\u2026" : "");
          ui.singleDraft.q = "";
          ui.singleDraft.a = "";
          ui.singleDraft.hint = "";
          focusQuestionAfterRender = true;
          await renderCardsSection(cardsContainer, activeProjects);
        } catch (e) {
          notify("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u0441\u043E\u0445\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F: " + e.message);
          saveSingleBtn.disabled = false;
        }
      };

      saveSingleBtn.onclick = submitSingleCard;
      qInp.onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); aInp.focus(); } };
      aInp.onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); submitSingleCard(); } };
      hintInp.onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); submitSingleCard(); } };

      if (focusQuestionAfterRender) {
        focusQuestionAfterRender = false;
        setTimeout(() => { if (qInp.isConnected) qInp.focus(); }, 30);
      }
    } else {
      const bulkOptRow = addDrawer.createDiv({
        attr: { style: "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px;" }
      });
      bulkOptRow.createSpan({
        text: "\u041F\u043E \u043E\u0434\u043D\u043E\u0439 \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043A\u0435 \u043D\u0430 \u0441\u0442\u0440\u043E\u043A\u0443 \u0447\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0437 ::, :::, \xAB \u2014 \xBB \u0438\u043B\u0438 Tab:",
        attr: { style: "font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--text-muted);" }
      });

      const bulkTypeWrap = bulkOptRow.createDiv({ attr: { style: "display: flex; gap: 5px; align-items: center;" } });
      bulkTypeWrap.createSpan({ text: "\u0414\u043B\u044F \xAB\u2014\xBB:", attr: { style: "font-size: 0.73rem; color: var(--text-muted);" } });
      const bSingleBtn = bulkTypeWrap.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dh-chip" + (!ui.bulkDraft.defaultBi ? " is-active" : ""),
        text: "\u2192 ::",
        attr: { type: "button", style: "font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 2px 8px; cursor: pointer;" }
      });
      const bBiBtn = bulkTypeWrap.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dh-chip" + (ui.bulkDraft.defaultBi ? " is-active" : ""),
        text: "\u21C4 :::",
        attr: { type: "button", style: "font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 2px 8px; cursor: pointer;" }
      });
      bSingleBtn.onclick = () => { ui.bulkDraft.defaultBi = false; renderCardsSection(cardsContainer, activeProjects); };
      bBiBtn.onclick = () => { ui.bulkDraft.defaultBi = true; renderCardsSection(cardsContainer, activeProjects); };

      const bulkArea = addDrawer.createEl("textarea", {
        attr: {
          rows: "6",
          placeholder: "\u0427\u0442\u043E \u0442\u0430\u043A\u043E\u0435 \u041F\u0410-6? :: \u041F\u043E\u043B\u0438\u0430\u043C\u0438\u0434-6, \u043A\u043E\u043D\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0443\u043A\u0446\u0438\u043E\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0439 \u0442\u0435\u0440\u043C\u043E\u043F\u043B\u0430\u0441\u0442\u0438\u0447\u043D\u044B\u0439 \u043F\u043E\u043B\u0438\u043C\u0435\u0440\\n\u0421\u0444\u0435\u0440\u0438\u0447\u043D\u043E\u0441\u0442\u044C \u0447\u0430\u0441\u0442\u0438\u0446\u044B ::: \u0421\u0442\u0435\u043F\u0435\u043D\u044C \u043F\u0440\u0438\u0431\u043B\u0438\u0436\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F \u0444\u043E\u0440\u043C\u044B \u0447\u0430\u0441\u0442\u0438\u0446\u044B \u043A \u0448\u0430\u0440\u0443",
          style: "width: 100%; font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.4; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 6px; resize: vertical;"
        }
      });
      bulkArea.value = ui.bulkDraft.text || "";

      const bulkFooter = addDrawer.createDiv({
        attr: { style: "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;" }
      });
      const previewSpan = bulkFooter.createSpan({
        attr: { style: "font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 600;" }
      });

      const updateBulkPreview = () => {
        ui.bulkDraft.text = bulkArea.value;
        const list = parseBulkInputLines(bulkArea.value, ui.bulkDraft.defaultBi);
        const biCnt = list.filter(x => x.isBi).length;
        const singleCnt = list.length - biCnt;
        previewSpan.setText(
          list.length > 0
            ? "\u0420\u0430\u0441\u043F\u043E\u0437\u043D\u0430\u043D\u043E: " + list.length + " (:: \u2014 " + singleCnt + ", ::: \u2014 " + biCnt + ")"
            : "\u0412\u0441\u0442\u0430\u0432\u044C \u0441\u0442\u0440\u043E\u043A\u0438 \u0441 \u0432\u043E\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0441\u0430\u043C\u0438 \u0438 \u043E\u0442\u0432\u0435\u0442\u0430\u043C\u0438"
        );
      };
      bulkArea.oninput = updateBulkPreview;
      updateBulkPreview();

      const saveBulkBtn = bulkFooter.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dh-btn mod-cta",
        text: "\u0418\u043C\u043F\u043E\u0440\u0442\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u0430\u0442\u044C",
        attr: { type: "button", style: "font-size: 0.8rem; height: 32px; padding: 0 16px;" }
      });

      saveBulkBtn.onclick = async () => {
        if (saveBulkBtn.disabled) return;
        const list = parseBulkInputLines(bulkArea.value, ui.bulkDraft.defaultBi);
        const targetDeck = deckByPath.get(targetDeckSel.value);
        if (!list.length) {
          notify("\u041D\u0435 \u043D\u0430\u0439\u0434\u0435\u043D\u043E \u0441\u0442\u0440\u043E\u043A \u0432 \u0444\u043E\u0440\u043C\u0430\u0442\u0435 \xAB\u0412\u043E\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0441 :: \u041E\u0442\u0432\u0435\u0442\xBB \u0438\u043B\u0438 \xAB\u0412\u043E\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0441 \u2014 \u041E\u0442\u0432\u0435\u0442\xBB.");
          return;
        }
        if (!targetDeck) return;

        saveBulkBtn.disabled = true;
        try {
          const curContent = await app.vault.read(targetDeck.fileObj);
          const prefix = curContent.length > 0 && !curContent.endsWith("\\n") ? "\\n" : "";
          const formattedLines = list.map(item => {
            const sep = item.isBi ? ":::" : "::";
            const front = item.hint ? item.question + HINT_SEP + item.hint : item.question;
            return front + " " + sep + " " + item.answer;
          }).join("\\n");

          await enqueueDiskWrite(() => app.vault.append(targetDeck.fileObj, prefix + formattedLines + "\\n"));
          ui.bulkDraft.text = "";
          ui.lastAddedBadge = "\u0418\u043C\u043F\u043E\u0440\u0442\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u0430\u043D\u043E: " + list.length;
          notify("\u0414\u043E\u0431\u0430\u0432\u043B\u0435\u043D\u043E \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u0435\u043A \u0432 \xAB" + targetDeck.title + "\xBB: " + list.length);
          await renderCardsSection(cardsContainer, activeProjects);
        } catch (e) {
          notify("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u0438\u043C\u043F\u043E\u0440\u0442\u0430: " + e.message);
          saveBulkBtn.disabled = false;
        }
      };
    }
  }

  // 5. \u0421\u043F\u0438\u0441\u043E\u043A \u0432\u043E\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0441\u043E\u0432 \u0432\u044B\u0431\u0440\u0430\u043D\u043D\u043E\u0439 \u0442\u0435\u043C\u044B
  if (ui.isListManageOpen && scopedCards.length > 0) {
    const listDrawer = panel.createDiv({ cls: "dsc-drawer" });
    const listHead = listDrawer.createDiv({
      attr: { style: "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;" }
    });
    listHead.createSpan({
      text: "\u0412\u043E\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0441\u044B (" + scopedCards.length + ")",
      attr: { style: "font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-normal);" }
    });
    listHead.createSpan({
      text: "\u041A\u043B\u0438\u043A \u043F\u043E \xAB\u2192 ::\xBB / \xAB\u21C4 :::\xBB \u043F\u0435\u0440\u0435\u043A\u043B\u044E\u0447\u0430\u0435\u0442 \u0441\u0442\u043E\u0440\u043E\u043D\u044B \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043A\u0438",
      attr: { style: "font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-muted);" }
    });

    const listBox = listDrawer.createDiv({
      attr: { style: "display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-height: 340px; overflow-y: auto; padding-right: 4px;" }
    });

    scopedCards.forEach(c => {
      const isEditingThis = ui.editingCardKey === c.uidKey;
      const row = listBox.createDiv({
        attr: {
          style: "padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--background-secondary); border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--background-modifier-border); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px;"
        }
      });

      if (isEditingThis) {
        const editRow = row.createDiv({ attr: { style: "display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px;" } });
        const qInp = editRow.createEl("input", {
          attr: { type: "text", value: c.question, style: "flex: 1; min-width: 160px; font-size: 0.8rem; height: 28px; padding: 2px 8px;" }
        });
        const aInp = editRow.createEl("input", {
          attr: { type: "text", value: c.answer, style: "flex: 1; min-width: 160px; font-size: 0.8rem; height: 28px; padding: 2px 8px;" }
        });
        const hInp = editRow.createEl("input", {
          attr: { type: "text", value: c.hint || "", placeholder: "\u041F\u043E\u044F\u0441\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435", style: "width: 150px; font-size: 0.78rem; height: 28px; padding: 2px 8px;" }
        });
        const saveB = editRow.createEl("button", {
          cls: "dh-btn mod-cta",
          text: "\u2713",
          attr: { type: "button", style: "height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 0.76rem;" }
        });
        const cancelB = editRow.createEl("button", {
          cls: "dh-chip",
          text: "\u2715",
          attr: { type: "button", style: "height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; font-size: 0.76rem; cursor: pointer;" }
        });
        cancelB.onclick = () => { ui.editingCardKey = null; renderCardsSection(cardsContainer, activeProjects); };
        saveB.onclick = async () => {
          if (!qInp.value.trim() || !aInp.value.trim()) return;
          saveB.disabled = true;
          await modifyStudyCardLine(c, {
            newQuestion: qInp.value.trim(),
            newAnswer: aInp.value.trim(),
            newHint: hInp.value.trim(),
            newIsBi: c.isBidirectional
          });
          ui.editingCardKey = null;
          await renderCardsSection(cardsContainer, activeProjects);
        };
        return;
      }

      const mainLine = row.createDiv({
        attr: { style: "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px;" }
      });

      const leftText = mainLine.createDiv({ attr: { style: "flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-size: 0.81rem; line-height: 1.35;" } });

      const toggleBiBtn = leftText.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dh-chip",
        text: c.isBidirectional ? "\u21C4 :::" : "\u2192 ::",
        attr: {
          type: "button",
          style: "font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 1px 6px; margin-right: 6px; height: 20px; color: " + (c.isBidirectional ? "#9c83e8" : "#599ed6") + "; cursor: pointer;"
        }
      });
      toggleBiBtn.onclick = async () => {
        toggleBiBtn.disabled = true;
        await modifyStudyCardLine(c, {
          newQuestion: c.question,
          newAnswer: c.answer,
          newHint: c.hint,
          newIsBi: !c.isBidirectional
        });
        await renderCardsSection(cardsContainer, activeProjects);
      };

      leftText.createSpan({ text: c.question, attr: { style: "font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-normal);" } });
      leftText.createSpan({ text: " \u2014 " + c.answer, attr: { style: "color: var(--text-muted);" } });
      if (c.hint) {
        leftText.createSpan({ text: " (" + c.hint + ")", attr: { style: "font-size: 0.73rem; color: #e5a158; font-style: italic;" } });
      }

      const rightBtns = mainLine.createDiv({ attr: { style: "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; flex-shrink: 0;" } });
      if (ui.selectedDeckPath === "ALL") {
        rightBtns.createSpan({
          text: c.deckTitle,
          attr: { style: "font-size: 0.68rem; color: var(--text-faint); margin-right: 4px;" }
        });
      }

      const edBtn = rightBtns.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dh-chip",
        text: "\u270E",
        attr: { type: "button", title: "\u0420\u0435\u0434\u0430\u043A\u0442\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u0430\u0442\u044C \u0432\u043E\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0441", style: "font-size: 0.7rem; padding: 1px 6px; height: 20px; cursor: pointer;" }
      });
      edBtn.onclick = () => { ui.editingCardKey = c.uidKey; renderCardsSection(cardsContainer, activeProjects); };

      const delBtn = rightBtns.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dh-chip",
        text: "\u2715",
        attr: { type: "button", title: "\u0423\u0434\u0430\u043B\u0438\u0442\u044C \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043A\u0443", style: "font-size: 0.7rem; padding: 1px 6px; height: 20px; color: var(--text-faint); cursor: pointer;" }
      });
      delBtn.onclick = async () => {
        delBtn.disabled = true;
        await modifyStudyCardLine(c, { deleteCard: true });
        await renderCardsSection(cardsContainer, activeProjects);
      };
    });
  }
}

// =====================================================================
// \u0413\u041B\u0410\u0412\u041D\u0410\u042F \u0424\u0423\u041D\u041A\u0426\u0418\u042F \u041E\u0422\u0420\u0418\u0421\u041E\u0412\u041A\u0410 \u0412\u0418\u0422\u0420\u0418\u041D\u042B \u0423\u0427\u0401\u0411\u042B
// =====================================================================
async function renderAll() {
  try {
    root.empty();
    injectStudyStyles(root);

    const dataset = getDataset();
    const {
      cfg,
      byPath,
      link,
      descendants,
      getDeadlineISO,
      getStartISO,
      getFinishedISO,
      getDisplayName,
      works: ws,
      completedWorks: doneWs,
      orphans: inbox,
      materials: ms
    } = dataset;

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. \u0412\u0415\u0420\u0425\u041D\u042F\u042F \u041F\u0410\u041D\u0415\u041B\u042C \u0418 \u0421\u0415\u0422\u041A\u0410 \u0410\u041A\u0422\u0418\u0412\u041D\u042B\u0425 \u041F\u0420\u041E\u0415\u041A\u0422\u041E\u0412
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    const topBar = root.createDiv({ cls: "dh-sp-topbar" });

    const statsLine = topBar.createDiv({ cls: "dh-sp-topbar-left" });
    statsLine.createSpan({ cls: "dh-sp-heading", text: "\u0410\u043A\u0442\u0438\u0432\u043D\u044B\u0435 \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442\u044B" });
    statsLine.createSpan({
      cls: "dh-sp-summary",
      text: ws.length + " \u0432 \u0440\u0430\u0431\u043E\u0442\u0435 \xB7 " + ms.length + " " + plural(ms.length, ["\u043C\u0430\u0442\u0435\u0440\u0438\u0430\u043B", "\u043C\u0430\u0442\u0435\u0440\u0438\u0430\u043B\u0430", "\u043C\u0430\u0442\u0435\u0440\u0438\u0430\u043B\u043E\u0432"]) +
        (inbox.length ? " \xB7 " + inbox.length + " \u0431\u0435\u0437 \u0440\u043E\u0434\u0438\u0442\u0435\u043B\u044F" : "") +
        (doneWs.length ? " \xB7 " + doneWs.length + " \u0437\u0430\u0432\u0435\u0440\u0448\u0435\u043D\u043E" : "")
    });

    const topActions = topBar.createDiv({ cls: "dh-sp-topbar-actions" });

    const openCompilerTopBtn = topActions.createEl("button", {
      cls: "dh-sp-btn is-accent",
      text: "\u041A\u043E\u043D\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0443\u043A\u0442\u043E\u0440",
      attr: {
        type: "button",
        title: "\u041E\u0442\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u044C \u0440\u0430\u0431\u043E\u0447\u0435\u0435 \u0434\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0432\u043E \u0438 \u0433\u0440\u0430\u0444 \u0432 \u043F\u043B\u0430\u0433\u0438\u043D\u0435 \u041A\u043E\u043D\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0443\u043A\u0442\u043E\u0440 \u0443\u0447\u0435\u0431\u043D\u044B\u0445 \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442\u043E\u0432"
      }
    });
    openCompilerTopBtn.onclick = () => openStudyCompiler();

    const toggleNewBtn = topActions.createEl("button", {
      cls: "dh-sp-btn" + (uiState.showNewWorkBar ? " is-active" : ""),
      text: uiState.showNewWorkBar ? "\u2715 \u0417\u0430\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u044C" : "\uFF0B \u041F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442",
      attr: { type: "button", title: "\u0421\u043E\u0437\u0434\u0430\u0442\u044C \u043D\u043E\u0432\u044B\u0439 \u0443\u0447\u0435\u0431\u043D\u044B\u0439 \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442" }
    });
    toggleNewBtn.onclick = () => {
      uiState.showNewWorkBar = !uiState.showNewWorkBar;
      renderAll();
    };

    if (uiState.showNewWorkBar) {
      const nwContainer = root.createDiv({ cls: "dh-sp-new-box" });
      const nwBox = nwContainer.createDiv({ cls: "dh-sp-new-row" });

      let manualChosenIcon = null;

      const iconPreviewBtn = nwBox.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dh-sp-icon-pick-btn",
        text: "\u{1F4C1}",
        attr: { type: "button", title: "\u0412\u044B\u0431\u0440\u0430\u0442\u044C \u0438\u043A\u043E\u043D\u043A\u0443" }
      });

      const nwTypeInput = nwBox.createEl("input", {
        cls: "dh-sp-input",
        attr: {
          type: "text",
          value: "\u041F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442",
          placeholder: "\u0422\u0438\u043F (\u041F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442, \u0414\u0438\u0441\u0441\u0435\u0440\u0442\u0430\u0446\u0438\u044F, \u0421\u0442\u0430\u0442\u044C\u044F...)",
          list: "dh-study-work-types",
          style: "flex: 0 1 190px;"
        }
      });

      const typeDatalist = nwBox.createEl("datalist", { attr: { id: "dh-study-work-types" } });
      const existingWorkTypes = [...new Set([...PRESET_WORK_TYPES, ...ws.map(typeOf), ...doneWs.map(typeOf)])].filter(Boolean);
      existingWorkTypes.forEach(t => typeDatalist.createEl("option", { attr: { value: t } }));

      nwTypeInput.oninput = () => {
        if (!manualChosenIcon) {
          iconPreviewBtn.textContent = getWorkMeta(nwTypeInput.value).icon;
        }
      };
      nwTypeInput.onfocus = () => nwTypeInput.select();

      const nwName = nwBox.createEl("input", {
        cls: "dh-sp-input",
        attr: { type: "text", placeholder: "\u041D\u0430\u0437\u0432\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0435 \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442\u0430...", style: "flex: 1 1 180px;" }
      });
      const nwDays = nwBox.createEl("input", {
        cls: "dh-sp-input",
        attr: { type: "number", min: "1", placeholder: "\u0414\u043D\u0435\u0439 \u0434\u043E \u0441\u0440\u043E\u043A\u0430", style: "flex: 0 1 120px;" }
      });
      const nwCreate = nwBox.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dh-btn mod-cta",
        text: "\u0421\u043E\u0437\u0434\u0430\u0442\u044C",
        attr: { type: "button", style: "height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; font-size: 0.8rem; border-radius: 8px;" }
      });

      const iconPickerBar = nwContainer.createDiv({
        cls: "dh-sp-icons-bar",
        attr: { style: "display: none;" }
      });
      iconPickerBar.createSpan({ text: "\u0417\u043D\u0430\u0447\u043E\u043A:", attr: { style: "font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-right: 4px;" } });
      QUICK_ICONS.forEach(ic => {
        const ib = iconPickerBar.createEl("button", {
          cls: "dh-sp-icon-pick-btn",
          text: ic,
          attr: { type: "button" }
        });
        ib.onclick = () => {
          manualChosenIcon = ic;
          iconPreviewBtn.textContent = ic;
          iconPickerBar.style.display = "none";
        };
      });

      iconPreviewBtn.onclick = () => {
        iconPickerBar.style.display = iconPickerBar.style.display === "none" ? "flex" : "none";
      };

      const doCreateNewWork = async () => {
        if (nwCreate.disabled) return;
        const title = normalizeSpaces(nwName.value).replace(/[\\\\/:*?"<>|]/g, "");
        if (!title) { notify("\u0412\u0432\u0435\u0434\u0438 \u043D\u0430\u0437\u0432\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0435 \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442\u0430."); return; }
        const rawType = normalizeSpaces(nwTypeInput.value) || "\u041F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442";
        const daysVal = Number(nwDays.value);
        const deadlineISO = Number.isFinite(daysVal) && daysVal > 0 ? today.plus({ days: Math.round(daysVal) }).toISODate() : "";
        const folder = cfg.newNoteFolder.replace(/\\/+$/, "");
        const path = folder + "/" + title + ".md";
        if (app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(path)) { notify("\u0422\u0430\u043A\u0430\u044F \u0437\u0430\u043C\u0435\u0442\u043A\u0430 \u0443\u0436\u0435 \u0435\u0441\u0442\u044C."); return; }

        nwCreate.disabled = true;
        try {
          await ensureFolderExists(folder);
          const lines = [
            "---",
            KEYS.area + ": " + JSON.stringify(cfg.studyAreaName),
            KEYS.type + ": " + JSON.stringify(rawType)
          ];
          if (manualChosenIcon) {
            lines.push(KEYS.icon + ": " + JSON.stringify(manualChosenIcon));
          }
          lines.push(KEYS.status + ": " + JSON.stringify(ROOT_STATUS_ACTIVE));
          lines.push(KEYS.start + ': "' + todayISO + '"');
          if (deadlineISO) {
            lines.push(KEYS.deadline + ': "' + deadlineISO + '"');
          }
          lines.push("---", "", "# " + title, "");

          const f = await app.vault.create(path, lines.join("\\n"));
          localCreatedNotes.push({
            file: { name: title, path: f.path, ctime: dv.date("now"), mtime: dv.date("now") },
            [KEYS.area]: cfg.studyAreaName,
            [KEYS.type]: rawType,
            [KEYS.icon]: manualChosenIcon || undefined,
            [KEYS.status]: ROOT_STATUS_ACTIVE,
            [KEYS.start]: todayISO,
            [KEYS.deadline]: deadlineISO || undefined
          });
          uiState.showNewWorkBar = false;
          notify("\u0421\u043E\u0437\u0434\u0430\u043D \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442: \xAB" + title + "\xBB");
          renderAll();
        } catch (e) {
          nwCreate.disabled = false;
          notify("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430: " + e.message);
        }
      };

      nwCreate.onclick = doCreateNewWork;
      nwName.onkeydown = e => {
        if (e.key === "Enter") doCreateNewWork();
        if (e.key === "Escape") { uiState.showNewWorkBar = false; renderAll(); }
      };
    }

    if (ws.length === 0) {
      root.createDiv({
        text: "\u0410\u043A\u0442\u0438\u0432\u043D\u044B\u0445 \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442\u043E\u0432 \u0441\u0435\u0439\u0447\u0430\u0441 \u043D\u0435\u0442. \u041D\u0430\u0436\u043C\u0438 \xAB\uFF0B \u041F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442\xBB \u0432\u044B\u0448\u0435, \u0447\u0442\u043E\u0431\u044B \u0441\u043E\u0437\u0434\u0430\u0442\u044C \u043D\u043E\u0432\u044B\u0439 \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442.",
        attr: { style: "padding: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-muted); background: var(--background-secondary); border-radius: 12px; border: 1px dashed var(--background-modifier-border); text-align: center;" }
      });
    } else {
      const grid = root.createDiv({
        cls: "dh-sp-grid",
        attr: { "data-count": String(ws.length) }
      });

      ws.forEach(p => {
        const workMeta = getWorkMeta(typeOf(p), p[KEYS.icon]);
        const accent = workMeta.color;
        const iso = getDeadlineISO(p);
        const startIso = getStartISO(p);
        const isEditingDate = uiState.openDeadlineFor === p.file.path;
        const isRenaming = uiState.renamingWorkPath === p.file.path;
        const currentTitle = getDisplayName(p);
        const matCount = descendants(p.file.path).length;
        const activeDays = startIso ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(today.diff(dv.date(startIso), "days").days) + 1) : 1;

        const card = grid.createDiv({
          cls: "dh-sp-card",
          attr: { style: "--card-accent: " + accent + ";" }
        });

        const topWrap = card.createDiv({ cls: "dh-sp-card-top" });
        const headRow = topWrap.createDiv({ cls: "dh-sp-card-head" });

        const leftBadges = headRow.createDiv({ cls: "dh-sp-card-badges" });
        leftBadges.createSpan({ cls: "dh-sp-type-pill", text: workMeta.label });

        const disc = typeof p[KEYS.discipline] === "string" ? p[KEYS.discipline].trim() : "";
        if (disc) {
          leftBadges.createSpan({
            cls: "dh-sp-discipline",
            text: disc,
            attr: { title: disc }
          });
        }

        if (iso) {
          const tone = getDeadlineTone(iso, false);
          const toneCls = tone === "overdue" ? " is-overdue" : tone === "soon" ? " is-soon" : " is-far";
          const dlBtn = headRow.createEl("button", {
            cls: "dh-sp-deadline" + toneCls,
            text: formatDeadlineBadge(iso, false),
            attr: {
              type: "button",
              title: formatFullDateTooltip(iso) + " \xB7 \u043D\u0430\u0436\u043C\u0438, \u0447\u0442\u043E\u0431\u044B \u0438\u0437\u043C\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0442\u044C \u0441\u0440\u043E\u043A"
            }
          });
          dlBtn.onclick = e => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            uiState.openDeadlineFor = isEditingDate ? null : p.file.path;
            renderAll();
          };
        } else {
          const setDlBtn = headRow.createEl("button", {
            cls: "dh-sp-deadline is-empty",
            text: "\u0421\u0440\u043E\u043A",
            attr: { type: "button", title: "\u041D\u0430\u0437\u043D\u0430\u0447\u0438\u0442\u044C \u0441\u0440\u043E\u043A \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442\u0430" }
          });
          setDlBtn.onclick = e => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            uiState.openDeadlineFor = isEditingDate ? null : p.file.path;
            renderAll();
          };
        }

        if (!isRenaming) {
          const titleLink = topWrap.createEl("a", {
            cls: "internal-link dh-sp-title-link",
            text: currentTitle,
            attr: { href: p.file.path, title: currentTitle }
          });
          openNote(titleLink, p.file.path);
        } else {
          const renameRow = topWrap.createDiv({ cls: "dh-sp-new-row" });
          const rnInput = renameRow.createEl("input", {
            cls: "dh-sp-input",
            attr: { type: "text", value: currentTitle, style: "flex: 1 1 120px; font-weight: 600;" }
          });
          setTimeout(() => { rnInput.focus(); rnInput.select(); }, 20);

          const rnSave = renameRow.createEl("button", {
            cls: "dh-btn mod-cta",
            text: "\u2713",
            attr: { type: "button", title: "\u0421\u043E\u0445\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0442\u044C \u043D\u0430\u0437\u0432\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0435", style: "height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 0.78rem; border-radius: 8px;" }
          });
          const rnCancel = renameRow.createEl("button", {
            cls: "dh-sp-btn",
            text: "\u2715",
            attr: { type: "button", style: "padding: 0 8px !important;" }
          });

          const doRename = async () => {
            if (rnSave.disabled) return;
            const nextName = normalizeSpaces(rnInput.value).replace(/[\\\\/:*?"<>|]/g, "");
            if (!nextName || nextName === currentTitle) {
              uiState.renamingWorkPath = null;
              renderAll();
              return;
            }
            const f = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(p.file.path);
            if (!f) return;
            const folderPrefix = f.parent && f.parent.path !== "/" ? f.parent.path + "/" : "";
            const newPath = folderPrefix + nextName + ".md";
            if (app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(newPath)) {
              notify("\u0424\u0430\u0439\u043B \u0441 \u0442\u0430\u043A\u0438\u043C \u043D\u0430\u0437\u0432\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0435\u043C \u0443\u0436\u0435 \u0441\u0443\u0449\u0435\u0441\u0442\u0432\u0443\u0435\u0442.");
              return;
            }
            rnSave.disabled = true;
            try {
              const oldPath = p.file.path;
              await app.fileManager.renameFile(f, newPath);
              localOverrides.set(oldPath, { ...(localOverrides.get(oldPath) || {}), newName: nextName });
              uiState.renamingWorkPath = null;
              notify("\u041F\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0438\u043C\u0435\u043D\u043E\u0432\u0430\u043D\u043E \u0432 \xAB" + nextName + "\xBB");
              renderAll();
            } catch (e) {
              rnSave.disabled = false;
              notify("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u043F\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0438\u043C\u0435\u043D\u043E\u0432\u0430\u043D\u0438\u044F: " + e.message);
            }
          };

          rnSave.onclick = doRename;
          rnCancel.onclick = () => { uiState.renamingWorkPath = null; renderAll(); };
          rnInput.onkeydown = e => {
            if (e.key === "Enter") doRename();
            if (e.key === "Escape") { uiState.renamingWorkPath = null; renderAll(); }
          };
        }

        if (isEditingDate) {
          const datePopover = topWrap.createDiv({ cls: "dh-sp-date-popover" });

          const applyDeadline = async newIso => {
            await saveProp(p.file.path, fm => {
              if (newIso) {
                fm[KEYS.deadline] = newIso;
                if (KEYS.deadlineAlt in fm) delete fm[KEYS.deadlineAlt];
              } else {
                delete fm[KEYS.deadline];
                delete fm[KEYS.deadlineAlt];
              }
            });
            localOverrides.set(p.file.path, {
              ...(localOverrides.get(p.file.path) || {}),
              [KEYS.deadline]: newIso || null,
              [KEYS.deadlineAlt]: null
            });
            uiState.openDeadlineFor = null;
            renderAll();
          };

          const presets = datePopover.createDiv({ attr: { style: "display: flex; gap: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap;" } });
          [
            { label: "+3 \u0434\u043D.", d: 3 },
            { label: "+7 \u0434\u043D.", d: 7 },
            { label: "+14 \u0434\u043D.", d: 14 },
            { label: "+30 \u0434\u043D.", d: 30 }
          ].forEach(pr => {
            const b = presets.createEl("button", {
              cls: "dh-sp-btn",
              text: pr.label,
              attr: { type: "button", style: "height: 26px !important; min-height: 26px !important; padding: 0 8px !important; font-size: 0.72rem !important;" }
            });
            b.onclick = () => applyDeadline(today.plus({ days: pr.d }).toISODate());
          });

          const rightDate = datePopover.createDiv({ attr: { style: "display: flex; gap: 4px; align-items: center;" } });
          const dInp = rightDate.createEl("input", {
            attr: { type: "date", value: iso || "", style: "font-size: 0.72rem; height: 26px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 6px; min-width: 0;" }
          });
          dInp.onchange = () => applyDeadline(dInp.value);

          if (iso) {
            const clr = rightDate.createEl("button", {
              cls: "dh-sp-btn",
              text: "\u0421\u0431\u0440\u043E\u0441",
              attr: { type: "button", style: "height: 26px !important; min-height: 26px !important; padding: 0 8px !important; font-size: 0.72rem !important; color: var(--text-muted) !important;" }
            });
            clr.onclick = () => applyDeadline(null);
          }
        }

        const bottomWrap = card.createDiv({ cls: "dh-sp-card-bottom" });

        const metaRow = bottomWrap.createDiv({ cls: "dh-sp-meta-row" });
        metaRow.createSpan({
          cls: "dh-sp-meta-text",
          text: (matCount > 0 ? "\u041C\u0430\u0442\u0435\u0440\u0438\u0430\u043B\u043E\u0432: " + matCount : "\u041C\u0430\u0442\u0435\u0440\u0438\u0430\u043B\u043E\u0432 \u043F\u043E\u043A\u0430 \u043D\u0435\u0442") + " \xB7 \u0432 \u0440\u0430\u0431\u043E\u0442\u0435 " + activeDays + " \u0434\u043D."
        });

        const tools = metaRow.createDiv({ cls: "dh-sp-card-tools" });

        const editTitleBtn = tools.createEl("button", {
          cls: "dh-sp-icon-action" + (isRenaming ? " is-active" : ""),
          text: "\u270E",
          attr: {
            type: "button",
            title: "\u041F\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0438\u043C\u0435\u043D\u043E\u0432\u0430\u0442\u044C \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442",
            "aria-label": "\u041F\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0438\u043C\u0435\u043D\u043E\u0432\u0430\u0442\u044C \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442"
          }
        });
        editTitleBtn.onclick = e => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          uiState.renamingWorkPath = isRenaming ? null : p.file.path;
          renderAll();
        };

        const doneBtn = tools.createEl("button", {
          cls: "dh-sp-icon-action is-done",
          text: "\u2713",
          attr: {
            type: "button",
            title: "\u0417\u0430\u0432\u0435\u0440\u0448\u0438\u0442\u044C \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442",
            "aria-label": "\u0417\u0430\u0432\u0435\u0440\u0448\u0438\u0442\u044C \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442"
          }
        });
        doneBtn.onclick = async e => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (doneBtn.disabled) return;
          doneBtn.disabled = true;
          try {
            await saveProp(p.file.path, fm => {
              fm[KEYS.status] = ROOT_STATUS_DONE;
              if (!fm[KEYS.start]) fm[KEYS.start] = startIso;
              fm[KEYS.finishedAt] = todayISO;
            });
            localOverrides.set(p.file.path, {
              ...(localOverrides.get(p.file.path) || {}),
              [KEYS.status]: ROOT_STATUS_DONE,
              [KEYS.start]: startIso,
              [KEYS.finishedAt]: todayISO
            });
            uiState.completedSectionOpen = true;
            notify("\u041F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442 \xAB" + currentTitle + "\xBB \u043F\u0435\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0435\u0441\u0451\u043D \u0432 \u0437\u0430\u0432\u0435\u0440\u0448\u0451\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0435");
            renderAll();
          } catch (err) {
            doneBtn.disabled = false;
            notify("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u0437\u0430\u0432\u0435\u0440\u0448\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F: " + err.message);
          }
        };

        let confirmTrash = false;
        const delBtn = tools.createEl("button", {
          cls: "dh-sp-icon-action",
          text: "\u2715",
          attr: {
            type: "button",
            title: "\u0423\u0434\u0430\u043B\u0438\u0442\u044C \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442 \u0432 \u043A\u043E\u0440\u0437\u0438\u043D\u0443",
            "aria-label": "\u0423\u0434\u0430\u043B\u0438\u0442\u044C \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442 \u0432 \u043A\u043E\u0440\u0437\u0438\u043D\u0443"
          }
        });
        delBtn.onclick = async e => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (delBtn.disabled) return;
          if (!confirmTrash) {
            confirmTrash = true;
            delBtn.textContent = "\u0423\u0434\u0430\u043B\u0438\u0442\u044C?";
            delBtn.classList.add("is-danger");
            setTimeout(() => {
              if (delBtn.disabled || !delBtn.isConnected) return;
              confirmTrash = false;
              delBtn.textContent = "\u2715";
              delBtn.classList.remove("is-danger");
            }, 3000);
            return;
          }
          delBtn.disabled = true;
          try {
            const f = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(p.file.path);
            if (f) await app.vault.trash(f, true);
            localOverrides.set(p.file.path, { deleted: true });
            notify("\u0423\u0434\u0430\u043B\u0435\u043D\u043E: \xAB" + currentTitle + "\xBB");
            renderAll();
          } catch (err) {
            delBtn.disabled = false;
            notify("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u0443\u0434\u0430\u043B\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F: " + err.message);
          }
        };

        const footerRow = bottomWrap.createDiv({ cls: "dh-sp-card-footer" });
        const openInPluginBtn = footerRow.createEl("button", {
          cls: "dh-sp-open-btn",
          text: "\u041E\u0442\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u044C \u0432 \u043A\u043E\u043D\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0443\u043A\u0442\u043E\u0440\u0435",
          attr: {
            type: "button",
            title: "\u041E\u0442\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u044C \u0434\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0432\u043E \u0438 \u0433\u0440\u0430\u0444 \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442\u0430 \xAB" + currentTitle + "\xBB \u0432 \u043A\u043E\u043D\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0443\u043A\u0442\u043E\u0440\u0435"
          }
        });
        openInPluginBtn.onclick = e => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          openStudyCompiler({ rootPath: p.file.path });
        };

        const quickAddInPluginBtn = footerRow.createEl("button", {
          cls: "dh-sp-plus-btn",
          text: "\uFF0B",
          attr: {
            type: "button",
            title: "\u0414\u043E\u0431\u0430\u0432\u0438\u0442\u044C \u043C\u0430\u0442\u0435\u0440\u0438\u0430\u043B \u0432 \u044D\u0442\u043E\u0442 \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442",
            "aria-label": "\u0414\u043E\u0431\u0430\u0432\u0438\u0442\u044C \u043C\u0430\u0442\u0435\u0440\u0438\u0430\u043B \u0432 \u044D\u0442\u043E\u0442 \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442"
          }
        });
        quickAddInPluginBtn.onclick = e => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          openStudyCompiler({ rootPath: p.file.path, addUnder: p.file.path });
        };
      });
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. \u041C\u0410\u0422\u0415\u0420\u0418\u0410\u041B\u042B \u0411\u0415\u0417 \u0420\u041E\u0414\u0418\u0422\u0415\u041B\u042F (\u0415\u0421\u041B\u0418 \u0415\u0421\u0422\u042C)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (inbox.length > 0) {
      const inboxPanel = root.createDiv({ cls: "dh-sp-orphans" });
      const inboxHead = inboxPanel.createDiv({
        attr: { style: "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;" }
      });
      inboxHead.createSpan({
        text: "\u0411\u0435\u0437 \u0440\u043E\u0434\u0438\u0442\u0435\u043B\u044F \xB7 " + inbox.length,
        attr: { style: "font-size: 0.84rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-normal);" }
      });
      inboxHead.createSpan({
        text: "\u041F\u0440\u0438\u0432\u044F\u0436\u0438 \u043A \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442\u0443",
        attr: { style: "font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-muted);" }
      });

      inbox.slice(0, INBOX_LIMIT).forEach(p => {
        const row = inboxPanel.createDiv({ cls: "dh-sp-orphan-row" });
        const a = row.createEl("a", {
          cls: "internal-link",
          text: p.file.name,
          attr: { style: "text-decoration: none; color: var(--text-normal); flex: 1; min-width: 160px; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500;" }
        });
        openNote(a, p.file.path);

        const mMeta = getWorkMeta(typeOf(p) || cfg.defaultAutoNoteType, p[KEYS.icon]);
        row.createSpan({
          cls: "dh-sp-type-pill",
          text: mMeta.label,
          attr: { style: "--card-accent: " + mMeta.color + ";" }
        });

        const sel = row.createEl("select", {
          cls: "dropdown",
          attr: { style: "font-size: 0.76rem; height: 28px;" }
        });
        sel.createEl("option", { text: "\u0412\u044B\u0431\u0435\u0440\u0438 \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442...", value: "" });
        ws.forEach(w => sel.createEl("option", { text: getDisplayName(w), value: w.file.path }));

        sel.onchange = async () => {
          const target = byPath.get(sel.value);
          if (!target || sel.disabled) return;
          sel.disabled = true;
          try {
            const targetFile = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(target.file.path);
            const linkText = targetFile
              ? app.metadataCache.fileToLinktext(targetFile, p.file.path)
              : target.file.name;
            await saveProp(p.file.path, fm => {
              fm[KEYS.parent] = "[[" + linkText + "]]";
              if (!fm[KEYS.discipline] && typeof target[KEYS.discipline] === "string" && target[KEYS.discipline].trim()) {
                fm[KEYS.discipline] = target[KEYS.discipline].trim();
              }
            });
            localOverrides.set(p.file.path, { ...(localOverrides.get(p.file.path) || {}), parents: [target.file.path] });
            link(p.file.path, target.file.path);
            notify("\xAB" + p.file.name + "\xBB \u2192 \xAB" + getDisplayName(target) + "\xBB");
            renderAll();
          } catch (err) {
            sel.disabled = false;
            notify("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u043F\u0440\u0438\u0432\u044F\u0437\u043A\u0438: " + err.message);
          }
        };
      });
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. \u041A\u0410\u0420\u0422\u041E\u0427\u041A\u0418 (MY-SR-TRAINER)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    const cardsSectionContainer = root.createDiv({ cls: "dh dh-study-cards-hub" });
    await renderCardsSection(cardsSectionContainer, ws);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. \u0417\u0410\u0412\u0415\u0420\u0428\u0401\u041D\u041D\u042B\u0415 \u041F\u0420\u041E\u0415\u041A\u0422\u042B
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    const doneDetails = root.createEl("details", { cls: "dh-details dh-sp-done-details" });
    doneDetails.open = Boolean(uiState.completedSectionOpen);
    doneDetails.ontoggle = () => { uiState.completedSectionOpen = doneDetails.open; };

    doneDetails.createEl("summary", {
      text: "\u0417\u0430\u0432\u0435\u0440\u0448\u0451\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0435 \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442\u044B \xB7 " + doneWs.length,
      attr: { style: "font-size: 0.86rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text-normal); user-select: none;" }
    });

    if (!doneWs.length) {
      doneDetails.createDiv({
        text: "\u0417\u0430\u0432\u0435\u0440\u0448\u0451\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0445 \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442\u043E\u0432 \u043F\u043E\u043A\u0430 \u043D\u0435\u0442.",
        attr: { style: "font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 8px;" }
      });
    } else {
      const doneList = doneDetails.createDiv({
        attr: { style: "display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px;" }
      });

      doneWs.forEach(p => {
        const workMeta = getWorkMeta(typeOf(p), p[KEYS.icon]);
        const startIso = getStartISO(p);
        const endIso = getFinishedISO(p);
        const deadlineIso = getDeadlineISO(p);

        const startDate = dv.date(startIso) || today;
        const endDate = dv.date(endIso) || today;
        const daysTaken = Math.max(1, Math.round(endDate.diff(startDate, "days").days) + 1);

        let isOverdue = false;
        let timingNote = "\u0431\u0435\u0437 \u0441\u0440\u043E\u043A\u0430";
        if (deadlineIso) {
          const dDate = dv.date(deadlineIso);
          const diffFromDeadline = Math.round(endDate.diff(dDate, "days").days);
          if (diffFromDeadline > 0) {
            isOverdue = true;
            timingNote = "\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0441\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0435\u043D\u043E \u043D\u0430 " + pluralizeDays(diffFromDeadline);
          } else if (diffFromDeadline === 0) {
            timingNote = "\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043D\u043E \u0432 \u0441\u0440\u043E\u043A";
          } else {
            timingNote = "\u0434\u043E\u0441\u0440\u043E\u0447\u043D\u043E \u043D\u0430 " + pluralizeDays(Math.abs(diffFromDeadline));
          }
        }

        const statusColor = isOverdue ? "var(--text-error, #e06c75)" : "var(--color-green, #4aab80)";

        const row = doneList.createDiv({
          cls: "dh-sp-done-row",
          attr: { style: "border-left: 3px solid " + statusColor + ";" }
        });

        const leftPart = row.createDiv({ attr: { style: "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 180px; flex: 1;" } });
        leftPart.createSpan({ text: workMeta.icon, attr: { style: "font-size: 0.85rem;" } });

        const titleA = leftPart.createEl("a", {
          cls: "internal-link",
          text: getDisplayName(p),
          attr: { style: "font-size: 0.86rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-normal); text-decoration: none;" }
        });
        openNote(titleA, p.file.path);

        if (typeOf(p)) {
          leftPart.createSpan({
            text: "\xB7 " + typeOf(p),
            attr: { style: "font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-muted);" }
          });
        }

        const rightPart = row.createDiv({ attr: { style: "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;" } });

        rightPart.createSpan({
          text: startDate.toFormat("dd.MM") + " \u2192 " + endDate.toFormat("dd.MM.yyyy"),
          attr: { style: "font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;" }
        });

        rightPart.createSpan({
          text: daysTaken + " \u0434\u043D. \xB7 " + timingNote,
          attr: {
            style: "font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, " + statusColor + " 14%, transparent); color: " + statusColor + "; white-space: nowrap;"
          }
        });

        const openDoneInPluginBtn = rightPart.createEl("button", {
          cls: "dh-sp-btn",
          text: "\u0414\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0432\u043E",
          attr: {
            type: "button",
            title: "\u041E\u0442\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u044C \u0437\u0430\u0432\u0435\u0440\u0448\u0451\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0439 \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442 \u0432 \u043A\u043E\u043D\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0443\u043A\u0442\u043E\u0440\u0435",
            style: "height: 24px !important; min-height: 24px !important; padding: 0 8px !important; font-size: 0.72rem !important;"
          }
        });
        openDoneInPluginBtn.onclick = () => openStudyCompiler({ rootPath: p.file.path });

        const restoreBtn = rightPart.createEl("button", {
          cls: "dh-sp-btn",
          text: "\u21A9 \u0412\u0435\u0440\u043D\u0443\u0442\u044C",
          attr: {
            type: "button",
            title: "\u0412\u043E\u0437\u043E\u0431\u043D\u043E\u0432\u0438\u0442\u044C \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442 \u0438 \u0432\u0435\u0440\u043D\u0443\u0442\u044C \u0432 \u0430\u043A\u0442\u0438\u0432\u043D\u044B\u0435",
            style: "height: 24px !important; min-height: 24px !important; padding: 0 8px !important; font-size: 0.72rem !important; color: var(--text-muted) !important;"
          }
        });
        restoreBtn.onclick = async () => {
          if (restoreBtn.disabled) return;
          restoreBtn.disabled = true;
          try {
            await saveProp(p.file.path, fm => {
              fm[KEYS.status] = ROOT_STATUS_ACTIVE;
              delete fm[KEYS.finishedAt];
              delete fm[KEYS.finishedLegacy];
            });
            localOverrides.set(p.file.path, {
              ...(localOverrides.get(p.file.path) || {}),
              [KEYS.status]: ROOT_STATUS_ACTIVE,
              [KEYS.finishedAt]: null,
              [KEYS.finishedLegacy]: null
            });
            notify("\u041F\u0440\u043E\u0435\u043A\u0442 \xAB" + getDisplayName(p) + "\xBB \u0432\u043E\u0437\u0432\u0440\u0430\u0449\u0451\u043D \u0432 \u0440\u0430\u0431\u043E\u0442\u0443");
            renderAll();
          } catch (err) {
            restoreBtn.disabled = false;
            notify("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430: " + err.message);
          }
        };
      });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    root.createDiv({
      text: "\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u0432\u044B\u043F\u043E\u043B\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F \u0441\u043A\u0440\u0438\u043F\u0442\u0430: " + (err && err.stack ? err.stack : err),

function sourceText(value) {
  if (typeof value === "string") return value.trim();

function el(tag, parent, cls, text) {
  const node = parent
    ? (typeof parent.createEl === "function" ? parent.createEl(tag) : parent.appendChild(document.createElement(tag)))
    : document.createElement(tag);
  if (cls) node.className = cls;
  if (text != null) node.textContent = String(text);
  return node;
}

}

function openLink(node, path) {
  node.href = path;
  node.classList.add("internal-link");
  node.dataset.href = path;
  bindHoverPreview(node, path);
  node.addEventListener("click", e => {
    if (e.button !== 0) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    app.workspace.openLinkText(path, CURRENT, e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey);
  });
  node.addEventListener("auxclick", e => {
    if (e.button !== 1) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    app.workspace.openLinkText(path, CURRENT, true);
  });
}

function showSourceBadge(parent, text) {
  if (!text) return;
  const wrap = el("span", parent, "d3n-source");
  wrap.addEventListener("click", e => e.stopPropagation());
  if (text.startsWith("[[") && text.endsWith("]]") && !text.includes("\\n")) {
    const inner = text.slice(2, -2);
    const [path, ...alias] = inner.split("|");
    const a = el("a", wrap, "d3n-source-pill", "\u{1F4C4} " + (alias.join("|") || path));
    openLink(a, path);
    a.title = "\u0418\u0441\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043D\u0438\u043A: " + text;
    return;
  }
  let url;
  try { url = new URL(text); } catch {}
  if (url && ["https:", "http:"].includes(url.protocol)) {
    const host = url.hostname.replace(/^www\\./, "");
    const a = el("a", wrap, "d3n-source-pill external-link", "\u2197 " + host);
    a.href = url.href;
    a.target = "_blank";
    a.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
    a.title = text;
  } else {
    const span = el("span", wrap, "d3n-source-text", text);
    span.title = "\u0418\u0441\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043D\u0438\u043A: " + text;
  }
}

function isTemplate(file, fm) {

  return templateFiles.has(file.path) ||
    folders.some(folder => path.startsWith(folder + "/") || path.includes("/" + folder + "/")) ||
    fm.\u0448\u0430\u0431\u043B\u043E\u043D === true ||

    list(fm.tags).some(tag => ["template", "\u0448\u0430\u0431\u043B\u043E\u043D"].includes(tag.replace(/^#/, "").toLowerCase()));
}

}

function readNotes() {
  const result = [];
  for (const file of app.vault.getMarkdownFiles()) {
    if (file.path === CURRENT) continue;
    const cache = app.metadataCache.getFileCache(file);
    const fm = { ...(cache?.frontmatter || {}), ...(pending.get(file.path) || {}) };
    if (!list(fm.\u043D\u0430\u043F\u0440\u0430\u0432\u043B\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435).includes(AREA) || isTemplate(file, fm)) continue;
    const rawTopics = list(fm.\u0442\u0435\u043C\u044B);
    const topicPaths = [...new Set(rawTopics.map(value => USE_TOPIC_MAP
      ? mapTopic(value) : topicParts(value).join("/")).filter(Boolean))];
    const displayTopics = [...new Set(topicPaths.map(value => topicParts(value)[0]))];
    const hasImages = noteHasImages(cache);
    result.push({
      file,
      path: file.path,
      title: file.basename,
      programs: list(fm.\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0433\u0440\u0430\u043C\u043C\u044B),
      rawTopics,
      topics: displayTopics,
      topicPaths,
      hasImages,
      source: sourceText(fm.\u0438\u0441\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043D\u0438\u043A),
      pinned: fm.\u0437\u0430\u043A\u0440\u0435\u043F\u043B\u0435\u043D\u043E === true,
      mtime: file.stat.mtime
    });
  }
  return result;
}

// \u0423\u043F\u0440\u0430\u0432\u043B\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435 \u0437\u0430\u043A\u0440\u0435\u043F\u043B\u0451\u043D\u043D\u044B\u043C\u0438 \u0432\u0441\u043F\u043B\u044B\u0432\u0430\u044E\u0449\u0438\u043C\u0438 \u043F\u043E\u0434\u0441\u043A\u0430\u0437\u043A\u0430\u043C\u0438
let pinnedTile = null;
const closePinnedPopover = () => {
  if (pinnedTile) {
    pinnedTile.classList.remove("is-pinned-pop", "is-open-pop");
    pinnedTile = null;
  }
};
if (dv.component && typeof dv.component.registerDomEvent === "function") {
  dv.component.registerDomEvent(document, "click", e => {
    if (pinnedTile && !pinnedTile.contains(e.target)) closePinnedPopover();
  });
}

// \u0413\u043E\u0440\u044F\u0447\u0430\u044F \u043A\u043B\u0430\u0432\u0438\u0448\u0430 "/" \u0432\u043D\u0443\u0442\u0440\u0438 \u043F\u0430\u043D\u0435\u043B\u0438 \u0434\u043B\u044F \u043C\u0433\u043D\u043E\u0432\u0435\u043D\u043D\u043E\u0433\u043E \u0444\u043E\u043A\u0443\u0441\u0430 \u043D\u0430 \u043F\u043E\u0438\u0441\u043A\u0435
root.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  if (e.key === "Escape") {
    closePinnedPopover();
    if (document.activeElement === searchInput && searchInput.value) {
      searchInput.value = "";
      state.query = "";
      persist();
      renderResults();
    }
    return;
  }
  const inInput = ["INPUT", "TEXTAREA", "SELECT"].includes(document.activeElement?.tagName);
  if (!inInput && e.key === "/") {
    e.preventDefault();
    searchInput.focus();
    searchInput.select();
  }
});
