  try { window.localStorage?.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(val)); } catch {}
};

function bookEffectivePages(b) {
  const total = b.totalPages !== null && b.totalPages > 0 ? b.totalPages : null;
  const read = b.readPages !== null && b.readPages >= 0 ? b.readPages : null;
  const finished = b.status === "\u041F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E" || (total !== null && read !== null && read >= total);
  if (finished && total !== null) return { pages: total, finished: true };
  return { pages: read, finished };
}

// \u0421\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446\u044B \u0437\u0430 \u0441\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0434\u043D\u044F = \u0441\u0443\u043C\u043C\u0430 \u043F\u0440\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0441\u0442\u0430 \xAB\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E\xBB \u043F\u043E \u043A\u0430\u0436\u0434\u043E\u0439 \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0435 \u043E\u0442\u043D\u043E\u0441\u0438\u0442\u0435\u043B\u044C\u043D\u043E \u0443\u0442\u0440\u0435\u043D\u043D\u0435\u0439 \u0431\u0430\u0437\u044B.
// \u0411\u0430\u0437\u0430 \u0431\u0435\u0440\u0451\u0442\u0441\u044F \u0438\u0437 \u0432\u0447\u0435\u0440\u0430\u0448\u043D\u0435\u0433\u043E \u0441\u043D\u0438\u043C\u043A\u0430, \u0430 \u0435\u0441\u043B\u0438 \u0435\u0433\u043E \u043D\u0435\u0442 \u2014 \u0438\u0437 \u0442\u0435\u043A\u0443\u0449\u0438\u0445 \u0437\u043D\u0430\u0447\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0439 (\u0441\u0442\u0430\u0440\u044B\u0435 \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0438 \u043D\u0435 \u0437\u0430\u0441\u0447\u0438\u0442\u044B\u0432\u0430\u044E\u0442\u0441\u044F).
function computeReadPagesToday(books, todayDate) {
  const todayISO = todayDate.toISODate();
  const yesterdayISO = todayDate.minus({ days: 1 }).toISODate();
  const dayStartMs = todayDate.toMillis();

  const current = {};
  const finishedMap = {};
  books.forEach(b => {
    const e = bookEffectivePages(b);
    if (e.pages === null) return;
    current[b.path] = e.pages;
    finishedMap[b.path] = e.finished;
  });

  const baseKey = PAGES_BASE_PREFIX + todayISO;
  let base = readLsJson(baseKey);
  let dirty = false;

  if (!base || typeof base !== "object" || Array.isArray(base)) {
    const last = readLsJson(PAGES_LAST_KEY);
    base = last && last.date === yesterdayISO && last.values && typeof last.values === "object"
      ? { ...last.values }
      : { ...current };
    dirty = true;
  }

  let total = 0;
  for (const [path, cur] of Object.entries(current)) {
    const b0 = base[path];
    if (typeof b0 !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(b0)) {
      let createdToday = false;
      try {
        const f = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(path);
        createdToday = Boolean(f?.stat && f.stat.ctime >= dayStartMs);
      } catch {}
      base[path] = !finishedMap[path] && createdToday ? 0 : cur;
      dirty = true;
    } else if (cur < b0) {
      base[path] = cur;
      dirty = true;
    }
    total += Math.max(0, cur - base[path]);
  }

  if (dirty) writeLsJson(baseKey, base);
  writeLsJson(PAGES_LAST_KEY, { date: todayISO, values: current });

  try {
    const ls = window.localStorage;
    for (let i = ls.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const k = ls.key(i);
      if (k && k.startsWith(PAGES_BASE_PREFIX) && k.slice(PAGES_BASE_PREFIX.length) < yesterdayISO) ls.removeItem(k);
    }
  } catch {}

  return total;
}

// true \u2014 \u043F\u043E\u043B\u044C\u0437\u043E\u0432\u0430\u0442\u0435\u043B\u044C \u0443\u0436\u0435 \u0432\u0440\u0443\u0447\u043D\u0443\u044E \u0442\u0440\u043E\u0433\u0430\u043B \u043F\u0440\u0438\u0432\u044B\u0447\u043A\u0443 \xAB\u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435\xBB \u0441\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0434\u043D\u044F (\u043A\u043B\u044E\u0447 \u0432\u0435\u0434\u0443 \u043D\u0435 \u044F, \u0444\u043E\u0440\u043C\u0430\u0442 \u0440\u0430\u0437\u0431\u0438\u0440\u0430\u044E \u0441 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0430\u0441\u043E\u043C)
function isReadingHabitHandledManually(iso) {
  let raw = null;
  try { raw = window.localStorage?.getItem(MANUAL_HABITS_PREFIX + iso); } catch { return false; }
  if (raw === null || raw === "") return false;

  let v = raw;
  try { v = JSON.parse(raw); } catch {}

  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.includes(DIARY_READING_FIELD);
  if (v && typeof v === "object") {
    if (!(DIARY_READING_FIELD in v)) return false;
    const x = v[DIARY_READING_FIELD];
    return !(x === true || x === "true" || x === 1);
  }
  return String(v).includes(DIARY_READING_FIELD);
}

const hasAutoReadingMark = iso => {
  try { return window.localStorage?.getItem(AUTO_READING_PREFIX + iso) === "1"; } catch { return false; }
};
const setAutoReadingMark = iso => {
  try { window.localStorage?.setItem(AUTO_READING_PREFIX + iso, "1"); } catch {}
};

async function openFileAtLine(filePath, lineIndex) {
  await app.workspace.openLinkText(filePath, dv.currentFilePath, false);
  setTimeout(() => {
    try {
      const view = app.workspace.activeLeaf?.view;
      if (view && view.file?.path === filePath && view.editor) {
        const safeLine = Math.max(0, Number(lineIndex) || 0);
        view.editor.setCursor({ line: safeLine, ch: 0 });
        view.editor.scrollIntoView({ from: { line: safeLine, ch: 0 }, to: { line: safeLine, ch: 0 } }, true);
        view.editor.focus();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.log(e);
    }
  }, 120);
}


async function ensureFolderExists(folderPath) {
  const parts = folderPath.split("/").filter(Boolean);
  let current = "";
  for (const part of parts) {
    current = current ? current + "/" + part : part;
    if (!(await app.vault.adapter.exists(current))) {
      await app.vault.createFolder(current);
    }
  }
}

async function ensureQuotesFile() {
  let file = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(QUOTES_FILE_PATH);
  if (!file) {
    const folder = QUOTES_FILE_PATH.includes("/") ? QUOTES_FILE_PATH.slice(0, QUOTES_FILE_PATH.lastIndexOf("/")) : "";
    if (folder) await ensureFolderExists(folder);
    const initialContent = "---\\n\u0442\u0438\u043F: \u0426\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442\u043D\u0438\u043A\\n\u043D\u0430\u043F\u0440\u0430\u0432\u043B\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435: \u0414\u043E\u0441\u0443\u0433\\n---\\n\\n# \u{1F4DA} \u0426\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442\u044B, \u043C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u0438 \u0438 \u043F\u0440\u0438\u043D\u0446\u0438\u043F\u044B\\n\\n";
    file = await app.vault.create(QUOTES_FILE_PATH, initialContent);
  }
  return file;
}

function loadBooks() {
  let rawPages = [];
  try {
    rawPages = dv.pages('"' + BOOKS_FOLDER + '"').array();
  } catch {
    rawPages = [];
  }

  const merged = [...rawPages];
  ui.localCreatedBooks.forEach(cb => {
    if (!merged.some(p => p.file.path === cb.file.path)) merged.push(cb);
  });

  const books = [];
  const byPath = new Map();

  merged.forEach(p => {
    const fileObj = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(p.file.path);
    const fmCache = fileObj ? (app.metadataCache.getFileCache(fileObj)?.frontmatter || {}) : {};
    const ov = ui.localBookOverrides.get(p.file.path) || {};

    const pick = (key, fallback) => {
      if (key in ov) return ov[key];
      if (key in fmCache && fmCache[key] !== undefined) return fmCache[key];
      if (p[key] !== undefined) return p[key];
      return fallback;
    };

    const title = String(pick("\u043D\u0430\u0437\u0432\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0435", p.file.name) || p.file.name).trim();
    const author = String(pick("\u0430\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0440", "") || "").trim();
    const genre = String(pick("\u0436\u0430\u043D\u0440", "") || "").trim();
    const rawStatus = String(pick("\u0441\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0443\u0441", "\u0412 \u043F\u043B\u0430\u043D\u0430\u0445") || "\u0412 \u043F\u043B\u0430\u043D\u0430\u0445").trim();
    const status = BOOK_STATUSES.includes(rawStatus) ? rawStatus : rawStatus;

    const totalPagesRaw = parseOptionalNumber(pick("\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446", null));
    const totalPages = totalPagesRaw !== null && totalPagesRaw > 0 ? Math.round(totalPagesRaw) : null;

    const readPagesRaw = parseOptionalNumber(pick("\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E", null));
    const readPages = readPagesRaw !== null && readPagesRaw >= 0 ? Math.round(readPagesRaw) : null;

    const progressPctRaw = parseOptionalNumber(pick("\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0433\u0440\u0435\u0441\u0441", null));
    const progressPct = progressPctRaw !== null && progressPctRaw >= 0
      ? Math.min(100, Math.round(progressPctRaw))
      : null;

    const rawLastRead = pick("\u043F\u043E\u0441\u043B\u0435\u0434\u043D\u0435\u0435_\u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435", "");
    let lastReadISO = "";
    if (rawLastRead) {
      const dt = dv.date(rawLastRead);
      lastReadISO = dt && dt.isValid ? dt.toISODate() : String(rawLastRead).trim();
    }

    const rawFinished = pick("\u0434\u0430\u0442\u0430_\u0437\u0430\u0432\u0435\u0440\u0448\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F", "");
    let finishedISO = "";
    if (rawFinished) {
      const fdt = dv.date(rawFinished);
      finishedISO = fdt && fdt.isValid ? fdt.toISODate() : String(rawFinished).trim();
    }

    const rawFav = pick("\u043B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u043E\u0435", false);
    const isFavorite = rawFav === true || /^(\u0434\u0430|true|yes|1)$/i.test(String(rawFav ?? "").trim());

    const rawEpubLink = pick("\u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430", null);
    let epubPath = null;
    const epubTarget = extractLinkTarget(rawEpubLink);
    if (epubTarget) {
      const dest = app.metadataCache.getFirstLinkpathDest(epubTarget, p.file.path);
      epubPath = dest ? dest.path : epubTarget;
    }

    const bookObj = {
      path: p.file.path,
      fileName: p.file.name,
      title,
      author,
      genre,
      status,
      totalPages,
      readPages,
      progressPct,
      lastReadISO,
      finishedISO,
      isFavorite,
      epubPath
    };

    books.push(bookObj);
    byPath.set(bookObj.path, bookObj);
  });

  function resolveByTarget(targetStr) {
    if (!targetStr) return null;
    const clean = String(targetStr).trim();
    if (byPath.has(clean)) return byPath.get(clean);
    if (byPath.has(clean + ".md")) return byPath.get(clean + ".md");
    if (byPath.has(BOOKS_FOLDER + "/" + clean + ".md")) return byPath.get(BOOKS_FOLDER + "/" + clean + ".md");
    const dest = app.metadataCache.getFirstLinkpathDest(clean, QUOTES_FILE_PATH);
    if (dest && byPath.has(dest.path)) return byPath.get(dest.path);
    const byName = books.filter(b => normStr(b.fileName) === normStr(clean) || normStr(b.title) === normStr(clean));
    return byName.length === 1 ? byName[0] : null;
  }

  function resolveBookForQuote(q) {
    const linkTarget = q.rawBookLink || extractLinkTarget(q.rawBookField);
    if (linkTarget) {
      const resolved = resolveByTarget(linkTarget);
      if (resolved) return { book: resolved, ambiguous: false, matchType: "link" };
    }

    const qTitleNorm = normStr(q.legacyTitle);
    const qAuthorNorm = normStr(q.legacyAuthor);
    if (!qTitleNorm) return { book: null, ambiguous: false, matchType: "none" };

    const titleMatches = books.filter(b => normStr(b.title) === qTitleNorm || normStr(b.fileName) === qTitleNorm);
    if (titleMatches.length === 0) return { book: null, ambiguous: false, matchType: "none" };

    if (qAuthorNorm && qAuthorNorm !== "\u2014" && qAuthorNorm !== "\u043D\u0435 \u0443\u043A\u0430\u0437\u0430\u043D") {
      const exactBoth = titleMatches.filter(b => normStr(b.author) === qAuthorNorm);
      if (exactBoth.length === 1) return { book: exactBoth[0], ambiguous: false, matchType: "legacy-exact" };
      if (exactBoth.length > 1) return { book: null, ambiguous: true, matchType: "ambiguous" };
    }

    if (titleMatches.length === 1) {
      const candidate = titleMatches[0];
      if (qAuthorNorm && qAuthorNorm !== "\u2014" && qAuthorNorm !== "\u043D\u0435 \u0443\u043A\u0430\u0437\u0430\u043D" && candidate.author && normStr(candidate.author) !== qAuthorNorm) {
        return { book: null, ambiguous: false, matchType: "none" };
      }
      return { book: candidate, ambiguous: false, matchType: "legacy-title" };
    }

    return { book: null, ambiguous: true, matchType: "ambiguous" };
  }

  return { books, byPath, resolveByTarget, resolveBookForQuote };
}

function stripOuterWikiBrackets(str) {
  let s = String(str || "").trim();
  if (s.startsWith("[[")) s = s.slice(2);
  if (s.endsWith("]]")) s = s.slice(0, -2);
  return s;
}

async function loadQuotes(bookRegistry) {
  const file = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(QUOTES_FILE_PATH);
  if (!file) return [];
  const content = await app.vault.read(file);
  const quotes = [];
  const seenNormalizedTexts = new Map();

  content.split(/\\r?\\n/).forEach((line, idx) => {
    const trimmed = line.trim();
    if (!trimmed.startsWith("-") || !trimmed.includes("\u0446\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0430::")) return;

    const fields = {};
    const fieldRegex = /\\(([\u0430-\u044F\u0410-\u042Fa-zA-Z0-9_]+)::\\s*([^)]+)\\)/g;
    for (const match of trimmed.matchAll(fieldRegex)) {
      fields[match[1].trim()] = match[2].trim();
    }

    if (!fields.\u0446\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0430) return;

    const rawCat = decodeInline(fields.\u043A\u0430\u0442\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0440\u0438\u044F || "\u041A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430");
    let category = rawCat;
    if (rawCat === "\u041C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C / \u041F\u0440\u0438\u043D\u0446\u0438\u043F") category = "\u041C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C";

    const isArchivedCategory = category !== "\u041A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430" && category !== "\u041C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C";
    const rawBookField = fields.\u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430_\u0441\u0441\u044B\u043B\u043A\u0430 || fields.\u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430 || fields.\u0438\u0441\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043D\u0438\u043A || "";
    const rawBookLink = extractLinkTarget(fields.\u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430_\u0441\u0441\u044B\u043B\u043A\u0430) || extractLinkTarget(fields.\u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430);
    const quoteCfi = fields.\u043F\u043E\u0437\u0438\u0446\u0438\u044F ? decodeInline(fields.\u043F\u043E\u0437\u0438\u0446\u0438\u044F).trim() : null;

    const legacyTitle = stripOuterWikiBrackets(decodeInline(fields.\u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430 || fields.\u0438\u0441\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043D\u0438\u043A || "")).split("|").pop().trim();
    const legacyAuthor = decodeInline(fields.\u0430\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0440 || "");
    const legacyStatus = decodeInline(fields.\u0441\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0443\u0441 || (category === "\u041C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C" ? "\u041F\u0440\u0438\u043D\u0446\u0438\u043F" : "\u0427\u0438\u0442\u0430\u044E"));
    const dateStr = decodeInline(fields.\u0434\u0430\u0442\u0430 || "");
    const quoteText = decodeInline(fields.\u0446\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0430);
    const isFavorite = /^(\u0434\u0430|true|yes|1)$/i.test(decodeInline(fields.\u043B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u043E\u0435 || ""));

    let resolvedBook = null;
    let isAmbiguousLegacy = false;
    let isLegacyUnlinkedBookQuote = false;

    if (category === "\u041A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430") {
      const res = bookRegistry.resolveBookForQuote({
        rawBookField,
        rawBookLink,
        legacyTitle,
        legacyAuthor
      });
      resolvedBook = res.book;
      isAmbiguousLegacy = res.ambiguous;
      isLegacyUnlinkedBookQuote = !rawBookLink && res.book !== null;
    }

    const displayTitle = category === "\u041A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430"
      ? (resolvedBook ? resolvedBook.title : (legacyTitle || "\u0411\u0435\u0437 \u043D\u0430\u0437\u0432\u0430\u043D\u0438\u044F"))
      : (legacyTitle || (category === "\u041C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C" ? "\u041B\u0438\u0447\u043D\u0430\u044F \u043C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C" : "\u0411\u0435\u0437 \u043D\u0430\u0437\u0432\u0430\u043D\u0438\u044F"));

    const displayAuthor = category === "\u041A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430"
      ? (resolvedBook ? resolvedBook.author : legacyAuthor)
      : legacyAuthor;

    const displayStatus = category === "\u041A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430"
      ? (resolvedBook ? resolvedBook.status : legacyStatus)
      : legacyStatus;

    const bookFilterKey = category === "\u041A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430"
      ? (resolvedBook ? "BOOK:" + resolvedBook.path : "LEGACY:" + normStr(displayTitle) + "|" + normStr(displayAuthor))
      : "";

    const normQuoteKey = normText(quoteText);
    const duplicateOfLine = seenNormalizedTexts.has(normQuoteKey) ? seenNormalizedTexts.get(normQuoteKey) : null;
    if (!seenNormalizedTexts.has(normQuoteKey) && normQuoteKey.length > 10) {
      seenNormalizedTexts.set(normQuoteKey, idx + 1);
    }

    quotes.push({
      lineIndex: idx,
      lineNumber: idx + 1,
      rawLine: line,
      fields,
      category,
      isArchivedCategory,
      resolvedBook,
      quoteCfi,
      isAmbiguousLegacy,
      isLegacyUnlinkedBookQuote,
      hasDirectLink: Boolean(rawBookLink),
      bookFilterKey,
      displayTitle,
      displayAuthor,
      displayStatus,
      date: dateStr,
      text: quoteText,
      isFavorite,
      duplicateOfLine
    });
  });

  return quotes.reverse();
}

async function updateQuoteEntry(lineIndex, { category, book, legacyTitle, topic, status, text }) {
  const file = await ensureQuotesFile();
  const content = await app.vault.read(file);
  const lines = content.split(/\\r?\\n/);
  const targetLine = lines[lineIndex];
  if (!targetLine || !targetLine.includes("\u0446\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0430::")) {
    throw new Error("\u0421\u0442\u0440\u043E\u043A\u0430 \u043D\u0435 \u043D\u0430\u0439\u0434\u0435\u043D\u0430 \u2014 \u0432\u043E\u0437\u043C\u043E\u0436\u043D\u043E, \u0444\u0430\u0439\u043B \u0431\u044B\u043B \u0438\u0437\u043C\u0435\u043D\u0451\u043D \u0438\u0437\u0432\u043D\u0435.");
  }

  const fields = {};
  const fieldRegex = /\\(([\u0430-\u044F\u0410-\u042Fa-zA-Z0-9_]+)::\\s*([^)]+)\\)/g;
  for (const m of targetLine.matchAll(fieldRegex)) {
    fields[m[1].trim()] = m[2].trim();
  }

  fields.\u043A\u0430\u0442\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0440\u0438\u044F = encodeInline(category);
  fields.\u0446\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0430 = encodeInline(text);

  if (category === "\u041A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430") {
    if (book) {
      fields.\u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430_\u0441\u0441\u044B\u043B\u043A\u0430 = encodeInline("[[" + book.path + "]]");
      fields.\u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430 = encodeInline(book.title);
    } else if (legacyTitle) {
      fields.\u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430 = encodeInline(legacyTitle);
    }
  } else if (category === "\u041C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C") {
    fields.\u0438\u0441\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043D\u0438\u043A = encodeInline(topic || "\u041B\u0438\u0447\u043D\u0430\u044F \u043C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C");
    fields.\u0441\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0443\u0441 = encodeInline(status || "\u041F\u0440\u0438\u043D\u0446\u0438\u043F");
  }

  const orderedKeys = ["\u043A\u0430\u0442\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0440\u0438\u044F", "\u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430_\u0441\u0441\u044B\u043B\u043A\u0430", "\u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430", "\u0430\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0440", "\u0438\u0441\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043D\u0438\u043A", "\u0441\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0443\u0441", "\u0434\u0430\u0442\u0430", "\u043F\u043E\u0437\u0438\u0446\u0438\u044F", "\u0446\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0430"];
  const allKeys = [...new Set([...orderedKeys, ...Object.keys(fields)])];
  lines[lineIndex] = "- " + allKeys
    .filter(k => fields[k] !== undefined && String(fields[k]).trim() !== "")
    .map(k => "(" + k + ":: " + fields[k] + ")")
    .join(" ");

  await app.vault.modify(file, lines.join("\\n"));
}

async function toggleQuoteFavorite(lineIndex) {
  return enqueueDiskWrite(async () => {
    const file = await ensureQuotesFile();
    const content = await app.vault.read(file);
    const rows = content.split(/\\r?\\n/);
    const target = rows[lineIndex];
    if (!target || !target.includes("\u0446\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0430::")) {
      throw new Error("\u0421\u0442\u0440\u043E\u043A\u0430 \u043D\u0435 \u043D\u0430\u0439\u0434\u0435\u043D\u0430 \u2014 \u0432\u043E\u0437\u043C\u043E\u0436\u043D\u043E, \u0444\u0430\u0439\u043B \u0431\u044B\u043B \u0438\u0437\u043C\u0435\u043D\u0451\u043D \u0438\u0437\u0432\u043D\u0435.");
    }

    const favRegex = /\\s*\\(\u043B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u043E\u0435::\\s*[^)]*\\)/;
    if (favRegex.test(target)) {
      rows[lineIndex] = target.replace(new RegExp(favRegex.source, "g"), "");
      await app.vault.modify(file, rows.join("\\n"));
      return false;
    }

    const pos = target.indexOf("(\u0446\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0430::");
    rows[lineIndex] = pos >= 0
      ? target.slice(0, pos) + "(\u043B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u043E\u0435:: \u0434\u0430) " + target.slice(pos)
      : target + " (\u043B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u043E\u0435:: \u0434\u0430)";
    await app.vault.modify(file, rows.join("\\n"));
    return true;
  });
}

async function toggleBookFavorite(book) {
  const f = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(book.path);
  if (!f) throw new Error("\u0424\u0430\u0439\u043B \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0438 \u043D\u0435 \u043D\u0430\u0439\u0434\u0435\u043D.");
  const next = !book.isFavorite;
  await app.fileManager.processFrontMatter(f, fm => {
    if (next) fm["\u043B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u043E\u0435"] = true;
    else delete fm["\u043B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u043E\u0435"];
  });
  ui.localBookOverrides.set(book.path, {
    ...(ui.localBookOverrides.get(book.path) || {}),
    \u043B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u043E\u0435: next
  });
  return next;
}

function createBookFavButton(parentEl, book) {
  const btn = parentEl.createEl("button", {
    cls: "dh-chip",
    text: book.isFavorite ? "\u2665\\uFE0E" : "\u2661\\uFE0E",
    attr: {
      type: "button",
      title: book.isFavorite ? "\u0423\u0431\u0440\u0430\u0442\u044C \u0438\u0437 \u043B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u044B\u0445" : "\u0414\u043E\u0431\u0430\u0432\u0438\u0442\u044C \u0432 \u043B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u044B\u0435",
      "aria-pressed": String(Boolean(book.isFavorite)),
      style: "font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 1px 6px; height: 20px; cursor: pointer; border-color: transparent; background: transparent; color: " +
        (book.isFavorite ? STATUS_COLORS["\u041B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u043E\u0435"] : "var(--text-muted)") + ";"
    }
  });
  btn.onclick = async () => {
    btn.disabled = true;
    try {
      await toggleBookFavorite(book);
      await renderHub();
    } catch (err) {
      notify("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430: " + err.message);
      btn.disabled = false;
    }
  };
  return btn;
}

async function createBookNote({ title, author, genre, status, totalPages, readPages }) {
  await ensureFolderExists(BOOKS_FOLDER);
  const safeBaseName = title.replace(/[\\\\/:*?"<>|#^\\[\\]]/g, "").trim();
  if (!safeBaseName) throw new Error("\u041D\u0435\u043A\u043E\u0440\u0440\u0435\u043A\u0442\u043D\u043E\u0435 \u043D\u0430\u0437\u0432\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0435 \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0438.");

  let targetPath = BOOKS_FOLDER + "/" + safeBaseName + ".md";
  if (app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(targetPath)) {
    const safeAuthor = author ? author.replace(/[\\\\/:*?"<>|#^\\[\\]]/g, "").trim() : "";
    if (safeAuthor) {
      targetPath = BOOKS_FOLDER + "/" + safeBaseName + " (" + safeAuthor + ").md";
    }
    if (app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(targetPath)) {
      throw new Error("\u0417\u0430\u043C\u0435\u0442\u043A\u0430 \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0438 \xAB" + targetPath + "\xBB \u0443\u0436\u0435 \u0441\u0443\u0449\u0435\u0441\u0442\u0432\u0443\u0435\u0442.");
    }
  }

  const yamlLines = [
    "---",
    "\u043D\u0430\u0437\u0432\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0435: " + JSON.stringify(title),
    "\u0430\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0440: " + JSON.stringify(author || ""),
    "\u0436\u0430\u043D\u0440: " + JSON.stringify(genre || ""),
    "\u0441\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0443\u0441: " + JSON.stringify(status || "\u0427\u0438\u0442\u0430\u044E"),
    "\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446: " + (totalPages !== null ? totalPages : ""),
    "\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E: " + (readPages !== null ? readPages : ""),
    "---",
    "",
    "# " + title,
    ""
  ];

  const createdFile = await app.vault.create(targetPath, yamlLines.join("\\n"));
  ui.localCreatedBooks.push({
    file: { path: createdFile.path, name: createdFile.basename },
    \u043D\u0430\u0437\u0432\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0435: title,
    \u0430\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0440: author || "",
    \u0436\u0430\u043D\u0440: genre || "",
    \u0441\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0443\u0441: status || "\u0427\u0438\u0442\u0430\u044E",
    \u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446: totalPages,
    \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E: readPages
  });
  ui.localBookOverrides.set(createdFile.path, {
    \u043D\u0430\u0437\u0432\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0435: title,
    \u0430\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0440: author || "",
    \u0436\u0430\u043D\u0440: genre || "",
    \u0441\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0443\u0441: status || "\u0427\u0438\u0442\u0430\u044E",
    \u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446: totalPages,
    \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E: readPages
  });

  return createdFile;
}

function renderNewBookForm(parentEl, onCreated) {
  const box = parentEl.createDiv({
    cls: "dhe-panel",
    attr: {
      style: "padding: 12px 14px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px; background: var(--background-primary); border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--background-modifier-border); border-left: 3px solid #e5a158;"
    }
  });

  const head = box.createDiv({
    attr: { style: "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 10px;" }
  });
  head.createSpan({ text: "\u{1F4D6} \u041D\u043E\u0432\u0430\u044F \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430", attr: { style: "font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-normal);" } });

  const closeBtn = head.createEl("button", {
    cls: "dh-chip",
    text: "\u2715 \u041E\u0442\u043C\u0435\u043D\u0430",
    attr: { type: "button", style: "font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 2px 8px; cursor: pointer;" }
  });
  closeBtn.onclick = () => {
    ui.isNewBookDrawerOpen = false;
    renderHub();
  };

  const grid = box.createDiv({
    attr: { style: "display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px;" }
  });

  const titleInp = grid.createEl("input", {
    attr: { type: "text", placeholder: "\u041D\u0430\u0437\u0432\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0435 \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0438 *", style: "font-size: 0.82rem; height: 30px; padding: 2px 8px;" }
  });
  const authorInp = grid.createEl("input", {
    attr: { type: "text", placeholder: "\u0410\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0440", style: "font-size: 0.82rem; height: 30px; padding: 2px 8px;" }
  });
  const genreInp = grid.createEl("input", {
    attr: { type: "text", placeholder: "\u0416\u0430\u043D\u0440 (\u043D\u0435\u043E\u0431\u044F\u0437\u0430\u0442\u0435\u043B\u044C\u043D\u043E)", style: "font-size: 0.82rem; height: 30px; padding: 2px 8px;" }
  });

  const statusSel = grid.createEl("select", {
    cls: "dropdown",
    attr: { style: "font-size: 0.8rem; height: 30px;" }
  });
  BOOK_STATUSES.forEach(st => {
    const opt = statusSel.createEl("option", { text: st, value: st });
    if (st === "\u0427\u0438\u0442\u0430\u044E") opt.selected = true;
  });

  const pagesInp = grid.createEl("input", {
    attr: { type: "number", min: "1", step: "1", placeholder: "\u0412\u0441\u0435\u0433\u043E \u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446", style: "font-size: 0.82rem; height: 30px; padding: 2px 8px;" }
  });
  const readInp = grid.createEl("input", {
    attr: { type: "number", min: "0", step: "1", placeholder: "\u041F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E \u0441\u0442\u0440.", style: "font-size: 0.82rem; height: 30px; padding: 2px 8px;" }
  });

  const actRow = box.createDiv({ attr: { style: "display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; align-items: center;" } });
  const saveBookBtn = actRow.createEl("button", {
    cls: "dh-btn mod-cta",
    text: "\u0421\u043E\u0437\u0434\u0430\u0442\u044C \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0443",
    attr: { type: "button", style: "font-size: 0.8rem; height: 30px; padding: 0 14px;" }
  });

  saveBookBtn.onclick = async () => {
    if (saveBookBtn.disabled) return;
    const title = titleInp.value.trim();
    const author = authorInp.value.trim();
    const genre = genreInp.value.trim();
    const status = statusSel.value;

    if (!title) {
      notify("\u0423\u043A\u0430\u0436\u0438 \u043D\u0430\u0437\u0432\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0435 \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0438.");
      return;
    }

    const totalRaw = pagesInp.value.trim();
    const readRaw = readInp.value.trim();
    let totalPages = null;
    let readPages = null;

    if (totalRaw !== "") {
      totalPages = parseOptionalNumber(totalRaw);
      if (totalPages === null || totalPages <= 0 || !Number.isInteger(totalPages)) {
        notify("\u041E\u0431\u0449\u0435\u0435 \u043A\u043E\u043B\u0438\u0447\u0435\u0441\u0442\u0432\u043E \u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446 \u0434\u043E\u043B\u0436\u043D\u043E \u0431\u044B\u0442\u044C \u0446\u0435\u043B\u044B\u043C \u0447\u0438\u0441\u043B\u043E\u043C \u0431\u043E\u043B\u044C\u0448\u0435 \u043D\u0443\u043B\u044F.");
        return;
      }
    }

    if (readRaw !== "") {
      readPages = parseOptionalNumber(readRaw);
      if (readPages === null || readPages < 0 || !Number.isInteger(readPages)) {
        notify("\u041F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0435 \u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446\u044B \u0434\u043E\u043B\u0436\u043D\u044B \u0431\u044B\u0442\u044C \u043D\u0435\u043E\u0442\u0440\u0438\u0446\u0430\u0442\u0435\u043B\u044C\u043D\u044B\u043C \u0446\u0435\u043B\u044B\u043C \u0447\u0438\u0441\u043B\u043E\u043C.");
        return;
      }
    }

    if (totalPages !== null && readPages !== null && readPages > totalPages) {
      notify("\u041F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043D\u043E\u0435 (" + readPages + ") \u043D\u0435 \u043C\u043E\u0436\u0435\u0442 \u043F\u0440\u0435\u0432\u044B\u0448\u0430\u0442\u044C \u043E\u0431\u0449\u0435\u0435 \u0447\u0438\u0441\u043B\u043E \u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446 (" + totalPages + ").");
      return;
    }

    saveBookBtn.disabled = true;
    try {
      const created = await createBookNote({ title, author, genre, status, totalPages, readPages });
      notify("\u041A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430 \xAB" + title + "\xBB \u0441\u043E\u0437\u0434\u0430\u043D\u0430.");
      ui.isNewBookDrawerOpen = false;
      if (onCreated) onCreated(created.path);
      await renderHub();
    } catch (e) {
      notify("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430: " + e.message);
    } finally {
      saveBookBtn.disabled = false;
    }
  };
}

let focusWordInputAfterRender = false;
let scrollWordFormAfterRender = false;
let focusQuoteInputAfterRender = false;
let scrollQuoteFormAfterRender = false;

async function renderHub() {
  try {
    ensureHubState();

    const prevHeight = root.offsetHeight;
    if (prevHeight > 0) root.style.minHeight = prevHeight + "px";

    const todayDate = dv.date("today").startOf("day");
    const todayISO = todayDate.toISODate();
    const currentTarget = ui.dailyTarget || DEFAULT_DAILY_TARGET;

    // 1. \u0417\u0430\u0433\u0440\u0443\u0437\u043A\u0430 \u0440\u0435\u0435\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430 \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433 (\u0441\u0438\u043D\u0445\u0440\u043E\u043D\u043D\u043E)
    const bookRegistry = loadBooks();
    const { books } = bookRegistry;

    // 2. \u0417\u0430\u0433\u0440\u0443\u0437\u043A\u0430 \u0446\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442 \u0438 \u0441\u043B\u043E\u0432 (\u043F\u0430\u0440\u0430\u043B\u043B\u0435\u043B\u044C\u043D\u043E)
    const wordsPage = dv.page(FILE);
    const wordsFile = wordsPage
      ? app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(wordsPage.file.path)
      : app.metadataCache.getFirstLinkpathDest(FILE, dv.currentFilePath || "");

    const [allQuotes, wordsContent] = await Promise.all([
      loadQuotes(bookRegistry).catch(e => {
        console.log("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F \u0446\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442:", e);
        return [];
      }),
      wordsFile
        ? app.vault.read(wordsFile).catch(e => {
            console.log("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F Words Cards:", e);
            return null;
          })
        : Promise.resolve(null)
    ]);

    const wordsData = wordsContent !== null
      ? analyzeWordsFile(wordsContent, bookRegistry, todayISO)
      : null;

    root.empty();
    injectEnglishHubStyles(root);

    // 3. \u0427\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0435\u043C \u0441\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0438\u0441\u0442\u0438\u043A\u0443. \u041F\u043E\u043B\u0435 \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u0435\u043A_\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0439\u0434\u0435\u043D\u043E \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u044B\u0432\u0430\u0435\u0442 \u0442\u043E\u043B\u044C\u043A\u043E my-sr-trainer.
    const diaryByISO = new Map();
    try {
      dv.pages(DIARY_FOLDER).array().forEach(d => {
        const dt = d.\u0434\u0430\u0442\u0430 ? dv.date(d.\u0434\u0430\u0442\u0430) : null;
        if (dt && dt.isValid) diaryByISO.set(dt.toISODate(), d);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.log("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F \u0415\u0436\u0435\u0434\u043D\u0435\u0432\u043D\u0438\u043A\u0430:", e);
    }

    const diaryPage = diaryByISO.get(todayISO);
    const srTodayCount = wordsData ? wordsData.reviewedTodayDirections : 0;
    let savedTodayCount = srTodayCount;


    if (diaryPage) {
      const prevSaved = typeof diaryPage.\u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u0435\u043A_\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0439\u0434\u0435\u043D\u043E === "number" ? diaryPage.\u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u0435\u043A_\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0439\u0434\u0435\u043D\u043E : 0;
      savedTodayCount = Math.max(prevSaved, srTodayCount);
    }

    // 3b. \u0410\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0441\u0438\u043D\u0445\u0440\u043E\u043D\u0438\u0437\u0430\u0446\u0438\u044F \u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0446_\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E \u0438 \u043F\u0440\u0438\u0432\u044B\u0447\u043A\u0438 \xAB\u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435\xBB (\u0442\u043E\u043B\u044C\u043A\u043E \u0440\u043E\u0441\u0442, \u043E\u0434\u0438\u043D \u0440\u0430\u0437 \u0437\u0430 \u0441\u0443\u0442\u043A\u0438 \u0434\u043B\u044F \u043F\u0440\u0438\u0432\u044B\u0447\u043A\u0438)
    if (diaryPage) {
      try {
        const pagesToday = computeReadPagesToday(books, todayDate);
        const prevPages = typeof diaryPage[DIARY_PAGES_FIELD] === "number" ? diaryPage[DIARY_PAGES_FIELD] : 0;
        const effectivePages = Math.max(prevPages, pagesToday);
        const readingAlreadyOn = diaryPage[DIARY_READING_FIELD] === true || String(diaryPage[DIARY_READING_FIELD]).toLowerCase() === "true";

        const needPagesWrite = pagesToday > prevPages &&
          (ui.lastSyncedPagesDate !== todayISO || ui.lastSyncedPagesCount !== pagesToday);
        const needReadingWrite = effectivePages >= 1 && !readingAlreadyOn &&
          !hasAutoReadingMark(todayISO) && !isReadingHabitHandledManually(todayISO);

        if (needPagesWrite || needReadingWrite) {
          const dFilePages = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(diaryPage.file.path);
          if (dFilePages) {
            if (needPagesWrite) {
              ui.lastSyncedPagesDate = todayISO;
              ui.lastSyncedPagesCount = pagesToday;
            }
            if (needReadingWrite) setAutoReadingMark(todayISO);
            setTimeout(() => {
              app.fileManager.processFrontMatter(dFilePages, fm => {
                if (needPagesWrite) fm[DIARY_PAGES_FIELD] = pagesToday;
                if (needReadingWrite) fm[DIARY_READING_FIELD] = true;
              }).catch(e => console.log(e));
            }, 150);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.log("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u0430\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0441\u0438\u043D\u0445\u0440\u043E\u043D\u0438\u0437\u0430\u0446\u0438\u0438 \u0447\u0442\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F:", e);
      }
    }

    const wordsByBookPath = new Map();
    if (wordsData) {
      wordsData.cards.forEach(c => {
        if (c.resolvedBook) {
          const bp = c.resolvedBook.path;
          if (!wordsByBookPath.has(bp)) wordsByBookPath.set(bp, []);
          wordsByBookPath.get(bp).push(c);
        }
      });
    }

    const quoteCountByBookPath = new Map();
    allQuotes.forEach(q => {
      if (q.category === "\u041A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430" && q.resolvedBook) {
        const bp = q.resolvedBook.path;
        quoteCountByBookPath.set(bp, (quoteCountByBookPath.get(bp) || 0) + 1);
      }
    });


    // =====================================================================
    // \u0421\u0415\u041A\u0426\u0418\u042F 1. \u0421\u0415\u0413\u041E\u0414\u041D\u042F: \u0421\u0422\u0410\u0422\u0418\u0421\u0422\u0418\u041A\u0410, \u0417\u0410\u041F\u0423\u0421\u041A \u041F\u041B\u0410\u0413\u0418\u041D\u0410 \u0418 \u0424\u041E\u0420\u041C\u0410 \u0421\u041B\u041E\u0412\u0410
    // =====================================================================
    const todayPanel = root.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-panel" });

    if (!wordsFile || !wordsData) {
      todayPanel.createDiv({
        cls: "dh-muted",
        text: "\u041D\u0435 \u0443\u0434\u0430\u043B\u043E\u0441\u044C \u0437\u0430\u0433\u0440\u0443\u0437\u0438\u0442\u044C \u0437\u0430\u043C\u0435\u0442\u043A\u0443 \xAB" + FILE + "\xBB. \u041F\u0440\u043E\u0432\u0435\u0440\u044C \u043D\u0430\u043B\u0438\u0447\u0438\u0435 \u0444\u0430\u0439\u043B\u0430 \u0432 \u0445\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u043B\u0438\u0449\u0435."
      });
    } else {
      const todayHead = todayPanel.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-section-head" });
      const hLeft = todayHead.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-section-title" });
      hLeft.createSpan({ text: "\u0421\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0434\u043D\u044F \xB7 \u0410\u043D\u0433\u043B\u0438\u0439\u0441\u043A\u0438\u0439" });

      const headRightLinks = todayHead.createDiv({ attr: { style: "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;" } });

      const fileLink = headRightLinks.createEl("a", {
        cls: "internal-link dhe-section-sub",
        text: "\u{1F4C4} " + wordsFile.basename + " (" + wordsData.totalEntries + " \u0437\u0430\u043F.)",
        attr: { href: wordsFile.path, style: "text-decoration: none;" }
      });
      fileLink.onclick = e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        app.workspace.openLinkText(wordsFile.path, dv.currentFilePath, e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey);
      };

      const topGrid = todayPanel.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-today-bar" });

      const dueBox = topGrid.createDiv({
        cls: "dhe-stat-box",
        attr: { style: "border-top: 2px solid " + (wordsData.dueScheduled > 0 ? "#e5a158" : "#4aab80") + ";" }
      });
      dueBox.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-stat-label", text: "\u041A \u043F\u043E\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044E" });
      const dueValRow = dueBox.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-stat-val-row" });
      dueValRow.createSpan({
        cls: "dhe-stat-val",
        text: String(wordsData.dueScheduled),
        attr: { style: "color: " + (wordsData.dueScheduled > 0 ? "#e5a158" : "#4aab80") + ";" }
      });
      dueValRow.createSpan({
        text: wordsData.dueScheduled === 0 ? "\u041E\u0447\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0434\u044C \u0437\u0430\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u0430 \u2713" : "\u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442. \u043F\u043E \u0440\u0430\u0441\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0430\u043D\u0438\u044E",
        attr: { style: "font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-muted);" }
      });
      dueBox.createDiv({
        cls: "dhe-stat-hint",
        text: wordsData.newDirections > 0
          ? "+ " + wordsData.newDirections + " \u043D\u043E\u0432\u044B\u0445 \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442. \u0432 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0430\u0441\u0435"
          : "\u041D\u043E\u0432\u044B\u0445 \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u0435\u043A \u0432 \u043E\u0447\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0434\u0438 \u043D\u0435\u0442"
      });

      const isTargetMet = savedTodayCount >= currentTarget;
      const doneBox = topGrid.createDiv({
        cls: "dhe-stat-box",
        attr: { style: "border-top: 2px solid " + (isTargetMet ? "#4aab80" : "#599ed6") + ";" }
      });
      doneBox.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-stat-label", text: "\u041F\u043E\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0439 \u0441\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0434\u043D\u044F" });
      const doneValRow = doneBox.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-stat-val-row" });
      doneValRow.createSpan({ cls: "dhe-stat-val", text: String(savedTodayCount) });
      if (ui.showDailyTargetLine) {
        doneValRow.createSpan({
          text: "\u0446\u0435\u043B\u044C " + currentTarget,
          attr: {
            style: "font-size: 0.71rem; font-weight: 600; color: " + (isTargetMet ? "#4aab80" : "var(--text-muted)") + ";"
          }
        });
      }
      doneBox.createDiv({
        cls: "dhe-stat-hint",
        text: wordsData.reviewedTodayEntries > 0
          ? "\u0417\u0430\u0442\u0440\u043E\u043D\u0443\u0442\u043E \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0435\u0439 \u0441\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0434\u043D\u044F: " + wordsData.reviewedTodayEntries
          : "\u041E\u0446\u0435\u043D\u0451\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0435 \u043F\u043E\u043A\u0430\u0437\u044B \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u0435\u043A \u0437\u0430 \u0434\u0435\u043D\u044C"
      });


      const actionsBox = topGrid.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-actions-box" });
      const actionsRow = actionsBox.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-actions-row" });

      const reviewBtnLabel = wordsData.dueScheduled > 0
        ? "\u25B6 \u041A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043A\u0438 (" + wordsData.dueScheduled + ")"
        : "\u25B6 \u041A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043A\u0438";

      const reviewBtn = actionsRow.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dh-btn mod-cta dhe-btn-primary",
        text: reviewBtnLabel,
        attr: {
          type: "button",
          title: "\u041E\u0442\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u044C \u0430\u043D\u0433\u043B\u0438\u0439\u0441\u043A\u0438\u0435 \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043A\u0438 \u0432 my-sr-trainer",
          "aria-label": "\u041E\u0442\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u044C \u0430\u043D\u0433\u043B\u0438\u0439\u0441\u043A\u0438\u0435 \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043A\u0438"
        }
      });
      reviewBtn.onclick = () => openEnglishTrainer();

      const toggleAddWordBtn = actionsRow.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dhe-btn-secondary" + (ui.isWordFormOpen ? " is-active" : ""),
        text: ui.isWordFormOpen ? "\u2715 \u0421\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u044C \u0444\u043E\u0440\u043C\u0443" : "+ \u0421\u043B\u043E\u0432\u043E",
        attr: {
          type: "button",
          "aria-expanded": String(ui.isWordFormOpen)
        }
      });
      toggleAddWordBtn.onclick = () => {
        ui.isWordFormOpen = !ui.isWordFormOpen;
        if (ui.isWordFormOpen) focusWordInputAfterRender = true;
        renderHub();
      };


      if (ui.isWordFormOpen) {
        const formWrap = todayPanel.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-word-form" });

        const formTitleRow = formWrap.createDiv({
          attr: { style: "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px;" }
        });
        formTitleRow.createSpan({
          text: "\u041D\u043E\u0432\u043E\u0435 \u0441\u043B\u043E\u0432\u043E \u0438\u043B\u0438 \u0432\u044B\u0440\u0430\u0436\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435",
          attr: { style: "font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 650; color: var(--text-normal);" }
        });

        if (ui.lastAddedWordInfo) {
          const addedBadge = formTitleRow.createSpan({
            text: "\u2713 \u0414\u043E\u0431\u0430\u0432\u043B\u0435\u043D\u043E: " + ui.lastAddedWordInfo,
            attr: {
              style: "font-size: 0.73rem; font-weight: 600; color: #4aab80; background: #4aab8018; border: 1px solid #4aab8044; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 5px;"
            }
          });
          setTimeout(() => {
            ui.lastAddedWordInfo = null;
            if (addedBadge.isConnected) addedBadge.remove();
          }, 5000);
        }

        const mainInputsRow = formWrap.createDiv({
          attr: { style: "display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center;" }
        });

        const enInput = mainInputsRow.createEl("input", {
          attr: {
            type: "text",
            placeholder: "\u0421\u043B\u043E\u0432\u043E \u0438\u043B\u0438 \u0432\u044B\u0440\u0430\u0436\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435 (EN) *",
            value: ui.wordDraft.en || "",
            style: "flex: 1.2; min-width: 150px; font-size: 0.84rem; padding: 5px 10px; height: 32px;"
          }
        });

        const trBtn = mainInputsRow.createEl("button", {
          cls: "dh-chip",
          text: "\u{1F310} \u041F\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0432\u0435\u0441\u0442\u0438",
          attr: { type: "button", style: "font-size: 0.8rem; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer;" }
        });

        const ruInput = mainInputsRow.createEl("input", {
          attr: {
            type: "text",
            placeholder: "\u041F\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0432\u043E\u0434 (RU) *",
            value: ui.wordDraft.ru || "",
            style: "flex: 1.6; min-width: 170px; font-size: 0.84rem; padding: 5px 10px; height: 32px;"
          }
        });

        const variantsBox = formWrap.createDiv({
          attr: { style: "display: " + (ui.translatedGroups.length ? "flex" : "none") + "; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 8px; background: var(--background-secondary); border-radius: 6px;" }
        });

        const secondRow = formWrap.createDiv({
          attr: { style: "display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center;" }
        });

        const exInput = secondRow.createEl("input", {
          attr: {
            type: "text",
            placeholder: "\u041F\u0440\u0438\u043C\u0435\u0440 \u043F\u0440\u0435\u0434\u043B\u043E\u0436\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F (\u043D\u0435\u043E\u0431\u044F\u0437\u0430\u0442\u0435\u043B\u044C\u043D\u043E)",
            value: ui.wordDraft.ex || "",
            style: "flex: 2; min-width: 200px; font-size: 0.83rem; padding: 5px 10px; height: 32px;"
          }
        });

        const sourceBookSelect = secondRow.createEl("select", {
          cls: "dropdown",
          attr: {
            title: "\u041F\u0440\u0438\u0432\u044F\u0437\u0430\u0442\u044C \u0441\u043B\u043E\u0432\u043E \u043A \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0435-\u0438\u0441\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043D\u0438\u043A\u0443 (\u043D\u0435\u043E\u0431\u044F\u0437\u0430\u0442\u0435\u043B\u044C\u043D\u043E)",
            style: "flex: 1; min-width: 165px; max-width: 260px; font-size: 0.79rem; height: 32px;"
          }
        });
        sourceBookSelect.createEl("option", { text: "\u0418\u0441\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043D\u0438\u043A: \u0431\u0435\u0437 \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0438", value: "" });

        const sortedBooksForWord = [...books].sort((a, b) => {
          const aR = a.status === "\u0427\u0438\u0442\u0430\u044E" ? 0 : 1;
          const bR = b.status === "\u0427\u0438\u0442\u0430\u044E" ? 0 : 1;
          return aR - bR || a.title.localeCompare(b.title, "ru", { sensitivity: "base" });
        });

        sortedBooksForWord.forEach(b => {
          const opt = sourceBookSelect.createEl("option", {
            text: (b.status === "\u0427\u0438\u0442\u0430\u044E" ? "\u{1F4D6} " : "") + b.title,
            value: b.path
          });
          if (ui.wordDraft.bookPath === b.path) opt.selected = true;
        });

        sourceBookSelect.onchange = () => {
          ui.wordDraft.bookPath = sourceBookSelect.value;
        };

        const addBtn = secondRow.createEl("button", {
          cls: "dh-btn mod-cta",
          text: "+ \u0421\u043E\u0445\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0442\u044C",
          attr: { type: "button", style: "font-size: 0.82rem; height: 32px; padding: 0 16px; white-space: nowrap;" }
        });

        const dupHint = formWrap.createDiv({
          attr: { style: "font-size: 0.76rem; color: #e5a158; display: none;" }
        });

        const showDup = list => {
          dupHint.empty();
          if (!list.length) {
            dupHint.style.display = "none";
            return;
          }
          dupHint.style.display = "block";
          list.slice(0, 3).forEach(c => {
            dupHint.createDiv({ text: "\u26A0\uFE0F \u0423\u0436\u0435 \u0435\u0441\u0442\u044C \u0432 \u0431\u0430\u0437\u0435: " + c.front + " ::: " + c.back + " (\u0441\u0442\u0440\u043E\u043A\u0430 " + c.lineNumber + ")" });
          });
        };

        let pendingKey = null;
        const resetPending = () => {
          pendingKey = null;
          addBtn.setText("+ \u0421\u043E\u0445\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0438\u0442\u044C");
        };

        const applySelectedVariants = () => {
          ruInput.value = ui.selectedVariants.join("; ");
          ui.wordDraft.ru = ruInput.value;
          resetPending();
        };

        const renderVariants = groups => {
          variantsBox.empty();
          if (!groups.length) {
            variantsBox.style.display = "none";
            return;
          }
          variantsBox.style.display = "flex";
          groups.forEach(g => {
            const row = variantsBox.createDiv({ attr: { style: "display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; align-items: center;" } });
            row.createSpan({ text: g.pos, attr: { style: "font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--text-muted); min-width: 85px;" } });
            g.terms.forEach(term => {
              const chip = row.createEl("button", {
                text: term,
                attr: { type: "button", style: "font-size: 0.78rem; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer;" }
              });
              const paint = () => {
                const on = ui.selectedVariants.includes(term);
                chip.style.background = on ? "var(--interactive-accent)" : "";
                chip.style.color = on ? "var(--text-on-accent)" : "";
              };
              chip.onclick = () => {
                ui.selectedVariants = ui.selectedVariants.includes(term)
                  ? ui.selectedVariants.filter(x => x !== term)
                  : [...ui.selectedVariants, term];
                paint();
                applySelectedVariants();
              };
              paint();
            });
          });
        };

        if (ui.translatedGroups.length) {
          renderVariants(ui.translatedGroups);
        }

        const doTranslate = async () => {
          const en = enInput.value.trim();
          if (!en) {
            notify("\u0421\u043D\u0430\u0447\u0430\u043B\u0430 \u0432\u043F\u0438\u0448\u0438 \u0430\u043D\u0433\u043B\u0438\u0439\u0441\u043A\u043E\u0435 \u0441\u043B\u043E\u0432\u043E \u0438\u043B\u0438 \u0432\u044B\u0440\u0430\u0436\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0435.");
            enInput.focus();
            return;
          }
          if (trBtn.disabled) return;
          trBtn.disabled = true;
          trBtn.setText("\u23F3...");
          try {
            const groups = await fetchTranslations(en);
            if (!groups.length) {
              notify("\u041F\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0432\u043E\u0434\u043E\u0432 \u043D\u0435 \u043D\u0430\u0439\u0434\u0435\u043D\u043E \u2014 \u0432\u043F\u0438\u0448\u0438 \u0432\u0440\u0443\u0447\u043D\u0443\u044E.");
              ui.translatedGroups = [];
              ui.selectedVariants = [];
              renderVariants([]);
              return;
            }
            ui.translatedGroups = groups;
            ui.selectedVariants = [];
            if (groups.length === 1 && groups[0].terms.length >= 1) {
              ui.selectedVariants = [groups[0].terms[0]];
              applySelectedVariants();
            }
            renderVariants(groups);
            ruInput.focus();
          } catch (e) {
            notify("\u041D\u0435 \u0443\u0434\u0430\u043B\u043E\u0441\u044C \u043F\u043E\u043B\u0443\u0447\u0438\u0442\u044C \u043F\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0432\u043E\u0434: " + e.message + ". \u0412\u043F\u0438\u0448\u0438 \u0432\u0440\u0443\u0447\u043D\u0443\u044E.");
          } finally {
            trBtn.disabled = false;
            trBtn.setText("\u{1F310} \u041F\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0432\u0435\u0441\u0442\u0438");
          }
        };

        const checkDuplicatesLive = () => {
          const k = wordKey(enInput.value);
          showDup(k ? wordsData.cards.filter(c => c.key === k) : []);
        };
        checkDuplicatesLive();

        enInput.oninput = () => {
          ui.wordDraft.en = enInput.value;
          resetPending();
          ui.translatedGroups = [];
          ui.selectedVariants = [];
          renderVariants([]);
          checkDuplicatesLive();
        };

        ruInput.oninput = () => {
          ui.wordDraft.ru = ruInput.value;
          resetPending();
        };

        exInput.oninput = () => {
          ui.wordDraft.ex = exInput.value;
        };

        const submitWord = async () => {
          if (addBtn.disabled) return;
          const en = enInput.value.trim().replace(/\\s+/g, " ");
          const ru = ruInput.value.trim().replace(/\\s+/g, " ");
          const ex = cleanExample(exInput.value);
          const chosenBook = bookRegistry.byPath.get(sourceBookSelect.value) || null;

          if (!en || !ru) {
            notify("\u0417\u0430\u043F\u043E\u043B\u043D\u0438 \u0438 \u0430\u043D\u0433\u043B\u0438\u0439\u0441\u043A\u043E\u0435 \u0441\u043B\u043E\u0432\u043E, \u0438 \u0440\u0443\u0441\u0441\u043A\u0438\u0439 \u043F\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0432\u043E\u0434.");
            return;
          }

          addBtn.disabled = true;
          try {
            const freshContent = await app.vault.read(wordsFile);
            const freshParsed = analyzeWordsFile(freshContent, bookRegistry, todayISO);
            const k = wordKey(en);
            const same = freshParsed.cards.filter(c => c.key === k);

            if (same.length) {
              showDup(same);
              const exact = same.some(c => normText(c.back) === normText(ru));
              if (exact) {
                notify("\u0422\u0430\u043A\u0430\u044F \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043A\u0430 \u0441 \u044D\u0442\u0438\u043C \u043F\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0432\u043E\u0434\u043E\u043C \u0443\u0436\u0435 \u0435\u0441\u0442\u044C \u2014 \u0434\u0443\u0431\u043B\u0438\u043A\u0430\u0442 \u043D\u0435 \u0434\u043E\u0431\u0430\u0432\u043B\u0435\u043D.");
                return;
              }
              const pk = k + "|" + normText(ru);
              if (pendingKey !== pk) {
                pendingKey = pk;
                addBtn.setText("\u0412\u0441\u0451 \u0440\u0430\u0432\u043D\u043E \u0434\u043E\u0431\u0430\u0432\u0438\u0442\u044C");
                notify("\u0421\u043B\u043E\u0432\u043E \u0443\u0436\u0435 \u0435\u0441\u0442\u044C \u0441 \u0434\u0440\u0443\u0433\u0438\u043C \u043F\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0432\u043E\u0434\u043E\u043C. \u041D\u0430\u0436\u043C\u0438 \u0435\u0449\u0451 \u0440\u0430\u0437, \u0435\u0441\u043B\u0438 \u0445\u043E\u0447\u0435\u0448\u044C \u0434\u043E\u0431\u0430\u0432\u0438\u0442\u044C \u0435\u0449\u0451 \u043E\u0434\u043D\u0443 \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043A\u0443.");
                return;
              }
            }

            const front = ex ? en + EXAMPLE_SEP + ex : en;
            const backWithSource = chosenBook ? ru + " \xB7 [[" + chosenBook.fileName + "]]" : ru;
            const prefix = freshContent.length > 0 && !freshContent.endsWith("\\n") ? "\\n" : "";

            await enqueueDiskWrite(() => app.vault.append(wordsFile, prefix + front + " ::: " + backWithSource + "\\n"));

            ui.lastAddedWordInfo = en + " ::: " + ru + (chosenBook ? " (" + chosenBook.title + ")" : "");
            ui.wordDraft.en = "";
            ui.wordDraft.ru = "";
            ui.wordDraft.ex = "";
            ui.selectedVariants = [];
            ui.translatedGroups = [];
            focusWordInputAfterRender = true;

            notify("\u041A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043A\u0430 \u0434\u043E\u0431\u0430\u0432\u043B\u0435\u043D\u0430: " + front + " ::: " + ru);
            await renderHub();
          } catch (e) {
            notify("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u0434\u043E\u0431\u0430\u0432\u043B\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F: " + e.message);
          } finally {
            if (addBtn.isConnected) addBtn.disabled = false;
          }
        };

        trBtn.onclick = doTranslate;
        addBtn.onclick = submitWord;
        enInput.onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); doTranslate(); } };
        ruInput.onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); submitWord(); } };
        exInput.onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); submitWord(); } };

        if (focusWordInputAfterRender || scrollWordFormAfterRender) {
          const shouldScroll = scrollWordFormAfterRender;
          focusWordInputAfterRender = false;
          scrollWordFormAfterRender = false;
          setTimeout(() => {
            if (shouldScroll && formWrap.isConnected) {
              formWrap.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "nearest" });
            }
            if (enInput.isConnected) {
              enInput.focus({ preventScroll: shouldScroll });
            }
          }, 30);
        }
      }

      const totalCards = wordsData.totalCardDirections;
      const maturePct = totalCards > 0 ? Math.round((wordsData.matureDirections / totalCards) * 100) : 0;

      const statsDetails = todayPanel.createEl("details", { cls: "dhe-details" });
      statsDetails.open = Boolean(ui.statsDetailsOpen);
      statsDetails.ontoggle = () => { ui.statsDetailsOpen = statsDetails.open; };

      const summaryEl = statsDetails.createEl("summary");
      summaryEl.createSpan({
        text: "\u0421\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0438\u0441\u0442\u0438\u043A\u0430 \u0431\u0430\u0437\u044B \xB7 \u0417\u0430\u043A\u0440\u0435\u043F\u043B\u0435\u043D\u043E " + maturePct + "% (" + wordsData.matureDirections + " \u0438\u0437 " + totalCards + " \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442. \xB7 \u0441\u043B\u043E\u0432\u0430\u0440\u043D\u044B\u0445 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0435\u0439: " + wordsData.totalEntries + ")"
      });
      summaryEl.createSpan({ text: "\u25BE", attr: { style: "font-size: 0.7rem;" } });

      if (totalCards > 0) {
        const barTrack = statsDetails.createDiv({
          attr: {
            style: "height: 7px; background: var(--background-modifier-border); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; margin-bottom: 10px;"
          }
        });
        for (const [val, color, label] of [
          [wordsData.matureDirections, "#4aab80", "\u0417\u0430\u043A\u0440\u0435\u043F\u043B\u0435\u043D\u043E"],
          [wordsData.learningDirections, "#e5a158", "\u0412 \u0438\u0437\u0443\u0447\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0438"],
          [wordsData.newDirections, "#599ed6", "\u041D\u043E\u0432\u044B\u0435"]
        ]) {
          if (val > 0) {
            barTrack.createDiv({
              attr: {
                title: label + ": " + val + " \u0438\u0437 " + totalCards + " \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442. (" + Math.round((val / totalCards) * 100) + "%)",
                style: "width: " + ((val / totalCards) * 100) + "%; background: " + color + "; height: 100%;"
              }
            });
          }
        }
      }

      const breakdownGrid = statsDetails.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-stats-breakdown" });
      const createMiniStat = (title, val, hint, color) => {
        const b = breakdownGrid.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-mini-stat" });
        b.createSpan({ text: title, attr: { style: "font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--text-muted);" } });
        b.createSpan({
          text: String(val),
          attr: { style: "font-size: 0.96rem; font-weight: 700; color: " + (color || "var(--text-normal)") + "; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;" }
        });
        b.createSpan({ text: hint, attr: { style: "font-size: 0.67rem; color: var(--text-faint);" } });
      };

      createMiniStat(
        "\u0412\u0441\u0435\u0433\u043E \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u0435\u043A",
        totalCards,
        "\u0438\u0437 " + wordsData.totalEntries + " \u0441\u043B\u043E\u0432\u0430\u0440\u043D\u044B\u0445 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0435\u0439 (\u0443 ::: \u0434\u0432\u0435 \u0441\u0442\u043E\u0440\u043E\u043D\u044B)",
        "var(--text-normal)"
      );
      createMiniStat(
        "\u0417\u0430\u043A\u0440\u0435\u043F\u043B\u0435\u043D\u043E",
        wordsData.matureDirections + " (" + maturePct + "%)",
        "\u0438\u043D\u0442\u0435\u0440\u0432\u0430\u043B \u2265 " + MATURE_DAYS + " \u0434\u043D.",
        "#4aab80"
      );
      createMiniStat(
        "\u0412 \u0438\u0437\u0443\u0447\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0438",
        wordsData.learningDirections,
        "\u0438\u043D\u0442\u0435\u0440\u0432\u0430\u043B \u043E\u0442 1 \u0434\u043E " + (MATURE_DAYS - 1) + " \u0434\u043D.",
        "#e5a158"
      );
      createMiniStat(
        "\u041D\u043E\u0432\u044B\u0435",
        wordsData.newDirections,
        wordsData.unscheduledDirections > 0
          ? "\u0432 \u0442.\u0447. " + wordsData.unscheduledDirections + " \u0431\u0435\u0437 \u0448\u0442\u0430\u043C\u043F\u0430 SR"
          : "\u0436\u0434\u0443\u0442 \u043F\u0435\u0440\u0432\u043E\u0433\u043E \u043F\u043E\u043A\u0430\u0437\u0430",
        "#599ed6"
      );
    }

    // =====================================================================
    // \u0421\u0415\u041A\u0426\u0418\u042F 2. \u0427\u0418\u0422\u0410\u042E \u0421\u0415\u0419\u0427\u0410\u0421 \u0418 \u041F\u0420\u041E\u0427\u0418\u0422\u0410\u041D\u041D\u042B\u0415 \u041A\u041D\u0418\u0413\u0418
    // =====================================================================
    const checkIsBookFinished = b =>
      b.status === "\u041F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E" ||
      (b.totalPages !== null && b.totalPages > 0 && b.readPages !== null && b.readPages >= b.totalPages);

    const visibleBooks = books
      .filter(b => b.status === "\u0427\u0438\u0442\u0430\u044E" || b.status === "\u041F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043E")
      .sort((a, b) => {
        const aFin = checkIsBookFinished(a) ? 1 : 0;
        const bFin = checkIsBookFinished(b) ? 1 : 0;
        return aFin - bFin || a.title.localeCompare(b.title, "ru", { sensitivity: "base" });
      });

    const favFilterOn = Boolean(ui.onlyFavoriteBooks);
    const favBooksTotal = visibleBooks.filter(b => b.isFavorite).length;
    const activeBooks = visibleBooks.filter(b => !checkIsBookFinished(b) && (!favFilterOn || b.isFavorite));

    const doneDateKey = b => b.finishedISO || b.lastReadISO || "";
    const compareByDoneDate = (a, b) => {
      const ak = doneDateKey(a);
      const bk = doneDateKey(b);
      if (Boolean(ak) !== Boolean(bk)) return ak ? -1 : 1;
      if (ak !== bk) return String(bk).localeCompare(String(ak));
      return a.title.localeCompare(b.title, "ru", { sensitivity: "base" });
    };
    const doneBooks = visibleBooks
      .filter(b => checkIsBookFinished(b) && (!favFilterOn || b.isFavorite))
      .sort((a, b) => {
        if (ui.doneBooksSort === "fav") return (Number(b.isFavorite) - Number(a.isFavorite)) || compareByDoneDate(a, b);
        if (ui.doneBooksSort === "title") return a.title.localeCompare(b.title, "ru", { sensitivity: "base" });
        return compareByDoneDate(a, b);
      });

    function renderBookWordsDrawer(bCard, book, linkedWords) {
      const wCount = linkedWords.length;
      const wordsDrawer = bCard.createDiv({
        attr: {
          style: "padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--background-secondary); border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--background-modifier-border); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; max-height: 210px; overflow-y: auto;"
        }
      });
      const drawerHead = wordsDrawer.createDiv({
        attr: { style: "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;" }
      });
      drawerHead.createSpan({
        text: "\u0421\u043B\u043E\u0432\u0430 \u0438\u0437 \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0438 (" + wCount + "):",
        attr: { style: "font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted);" }
      });

      const drawerBtns = drawerHead.createDiv({ attr: { style: "display: flex; gap: 4px;" } });
      const trainBookWordsBtn = drawerBtns.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dh-chip",
        text: "\u25B6 \u0422\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u0430\u0442\u044C",
        attr: {
          type: "button",
          style: "font-size: 0.69rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 1px 8px; height: 21px; color: #4aab80; border-color: #4aab8055; cursor: pointer;"
        }
      });
      trainBookWordsBtn.onclick = () => {
        openEnglishTrainer("BOOK", book.path);
      };

      linkedWords.slice().reverse().forEach(cw => {
        const wRow = wordsDrawer.createDiv({
          attr: {
            style: "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.76rem; padding-top: 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--background-modifier-border); cursor: pointer;"
          }
        });
        const leftW = wRow.createDiv({ attr: { style: "min-width: 0; flex: 1;" } });
        leftW.createSpan({ text: cw.word, attr: { style: "font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-normal);" } });
        leftW.createSpan({ text: " \u2014 " + cw.back, attr: { style: "color: var(--text-muted);" } });
        if (cw.example) {
          leftW.createDiv({ text: cw.example, attr: { style: "font-size: 0.71rem; color: var(--text-faint); font-style: italic;" } });
        }

        const rightW = wRow.createDiv({ attr: { style: "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-shrink: 0;" } });
        if (cw.sourceCfi && book.epubPath) {
          const jumpBtn = rightW.createEl("button", {
            cls: "dh-chip",
            text: "\u{1F4D6} \u041A \u043C\u0435\u0441\u0442\u0443",
            attr: {
              type: "button",
              title: "\u041E\u0442\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u044C \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0443 \u043D\u0430 \u0442\u043E\u043C \u043C\u0435\u0441\u0442\u0435, \u0433\u0434\u0435 \u0432\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0435\u0442\u0438\u043B\u043E\u0441\u044C \u044D\u0442\u043E \u0441\u043B\u043E\u0432\u043E",
              style: "font-size: 0.66rem; padding: 1px 6px; height: 19px; color: #e5a158; border-color: #e5a15855; cursor: pointer;"
            }
          });
          jumpBtn.onclick = e => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            openBookInEpubPlugin(book.epubPath, cw.sourceCfi);
          };
        }

        rightW.createSpan({
          text: "\u0441\u0442\u0440. " + cw.lineNumber,
          attr: { style: "font-size: 0.68rem; color: var(--text-faint); white-space: nowrap;" }
        });
        wRow.onclick = () => {
          if (wordsFile) openFileAtLine(wordsFile.path, cw.lineIndex);
        };
      });
    }

    const readingPanel = root.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-panel" });
    const readingHeader = readingPanel.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-section-head" });
    const rTitleWrap = readingHeader.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-section-title" });
    rTitleWrap.createSpan({ text: "\u0427\u0438\u0442\u0430\u044E \u0441\u0435\u0439\u0447\u0430\u0441" });
    if (activeBooks.length > 1) {
      rTitleWrap.createSpan({ cls: "dhe-section-sub", text: String(activeBooks.length) });
    }

    const readingHeadActions = readingHeader.createDiv({ attr: { style: "display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;" } });
    if (favBooksTotal > 0 || favFilterOn) {
      const favBooksChip = readingHeadActions.createEl("button", {
        cls: "dh-chip" + (favFilterOn ? " is-active" : ""),
        text: "\u2665\\uFE0E \u041B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u044B\u0435 (" + favBooksTotal + ")",
        attr: {
          type: "button",
          title: favFilterOn ? "\u041F\u043E\u043A\u0430\u0437\u0430\u0442\u044C \u0432\u0441\u0435 \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0438" : "\u041F\u043E\u043A\u0430\u0437\u0430\u0442\u044C \u0442\u043E\u043B\u044C\u043A\u043E \u043B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u044B\u0435 \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0438",
          "aria-pressed": String(favFilterOn),
          style: "font-size: 0.74rem; padding: 2px 10px; cursor: pointer;" + (favFilterOn ? "" : " color: " + STATUS_COLORS["\u041B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u043E\u0435"] + ";")
        }
      });
      favBooksChip.onclick = () => {
        ui.onlyFavoriteBooks = !ui.onlyFavoriteBooks;
        renderHub();
      };
    }

    const addBookTopBtn = readingHeadActions.createEl("button", {
      cls: "dh-chip" + (ui.isNewBookDrawerOpen && ui.newBookDrawerContext === "reading" ? " is-active" : ""),
      text: ui.isNewBookDrawerOpen && ui.newBookDrawerContext === "reading" ? "\u2715 \u0417\u0430\u043A\u0440\u044B\u0442\u044C" : "+ \u0414\u043E\u0431\u0430\u0432\u0438\u0442\u044C \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0443",
      attr: { type: "button", style: "font-size: 0.74rem; padding: 2px 10px; cursor: pointer;" }
    });
    addBookTopBtn.onclick = () => {
      if (ui.isNewBookDrawerOpen && ui.newBookDrawerContext === "reading") {
        ui.isNewBookDrawerOpen = false;
      } else {
        ui.isNewBookDrawerOpen = true;
        ui.newBookDrawerContext = "reading";
      }
      renderHub();
    };

    if (ui.isNewBookDrawerOpen && ui.newBookDrawerContext === "reading") {
      renderNewBookForm(readingPanel, null);
    }

    if (visibleBooks.length === 0) {
      const emptyReading = readingPanel.createDiv({
        attr: {
          style: "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--background-primary); border-radius: 6px; border: 1px dashed var(--background-modifier-border);"
        }
      });
      emptyReading.createSpan({
        text: "\u041D\u0435\u0442 \u0430\u043A\u0442\u0438\u0432\u043D\u044B\u0445 \u0438\u043B\u0438 \u043F\u0440\u043E\u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u043D\u043D\u044B\u0445 \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433",
        attr: { style: "font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-muted);" }
      });
    } else {
      if (activeBooks.length === 0) {
        readingPanel.createDiv({
          text: favFilterOn ? "\u0421\u0440\u0435\u0434\u0438 \u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0435\u043C\u044B\u0445 \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433 \u043D\u0435\u0442 \u043B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u044B\u0445" : "\u0421\u0435\u0439\u0447\u0430\u0441 \u043D\u0438\u0447\u0435\u0433\u043E \u043D\u0435 \u0447\u0438\u0442\u0430\u044E",
          attr: { style: "padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-muted); background: var(--background-primary); border-radius: 6px; border: 1px dashed var(--background-modifier-border);" }

        if (book.totalPages !== null && book.totalPages > 0) {

    // =====================================================================
    const quotesSection = root.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-panel" });

    if (scrollQuotesSectionAfterRender) {
      scrollQuotesSectionAfterRender = false;
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (quotesSection.isConnected) {
          quotesSection.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "nearest" });
        }
      }, 30);
    }

    const mainQuotes = allQuotes.filter(q => !q.isArchivedCategory);
    const bookQuotes = mainQuotes.filter(q => q.category === "\u041A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430");
    const thoughtQuotes = mainQuotes.filter(q => q.category === "\u041C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C");
    const archivedQuotes = allQuotes.filter(q => q.isArchivedCategory);

    const quotesTopBar = quotesSection.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-section-head" });

    const leftTitleAndTabs = quotesTopBar.createDiv({
      attr: { style: "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap;" }
    });
    leftTitleAndTabs.createSpan({ cls: "dhe-section-title", text: "\u0426\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442\u044B \u0438 \u043C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u0438" });

"\u0422\u0435\u043A\u0441\u0442 \u0446\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442\u044B \u0438\u0437 \u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0438 *" : "\u0422\u0435\u043A\u0441\u0442 \u043C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u0438 \u0438\u043B\u0438 \u043F\u0440\u0438\u043D\u0446\u0438\u043F\u0430 *",

      const submitQuoteOrThought = async () => {

        if (!textVal) {

              saveQuoteBtn.disabled = false;
              return;
            }
            const cleanLink = encodeInline("[[" + chosenBook.path + "]]");
            const cleanTitle = encodeInline(chosenBook.title);
            const cleanText = encodeInline(textVal);
            entryLine = "\\n- (\u043A\u0430\u0442\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0440\u0438\u044F:: \u041A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430) (\u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430_\u0441\u0441\u044B\u043B\u043A\u0430:: " + cleanLink + ") (\u043A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430:: " + cleanTitle + ") (\u0434\u0430\u0442\u0430:: " + todayISO + ") (\u0446\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0430:: " + cleanText + ")";
          } else {
            const topic = (topicInput?.value.trim()) || "\u041B\u0438\u0447\u043D\u0430\u044F \u043C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C";
            const label = (labelInput?.value.trim()) || "\u041F\u0440\u0438\u043D\u0446\u0438\u043F";
            entryLine = "\\n- (\u043A\u0430\u0442\u0435\u0433\u043E\u0440\u0438\u044F:: \u041C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C) (\u0438\u0441\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043D\u0438\u043A:: " + encodeInline(topic) + ") (\u0441\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0443\u0441:: " + encodeInline(label) + ") (\u0434\u0430\u0442\u0430:: " + todayISO + ") (\u0446\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442\u0430:: " + encodeInline(textVal) + ")";
          }

          await app.vault.append(file, entryLine);

          ui.quoteDraft = { text: "", topic: "", label: "\u041F\u0440\u0438\u043D\u0446\u0438\u043F" };
          ui.isQuoteFormOpen = false;
          notify("\u0417\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u044C \u0441\u043E\u0445\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0430.");
          await renderHub();
        } catch (e) {
          notify("\u041E\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043A\u0430 \u0441\u043E\u0445\u0440\u0430\u043D\u0435\u043D\u0438\u044F: " + e.message);
        } finally {
          if (saveQuoteBtn.isConnected) saveQuoteBtn.disabled = false;
        }
      };

      saveQuoteBtn.onclick = submitQuoteOrThought;
      quoteInput.onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); submitQuoteOrThought(); } };

      if (focusQuoteInputAfterRender || scrollQuoteFormAfterRender) {
        const shouldScroll = scrollQuoteFormAfterRender;
        focusQuoteInputAfterRender = false;
        scrollQuoteFormAfterRender = false;
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (shouldScroll && formPanel.isConnected) {
            formPanel.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "nearest" });
          }
          if (quoteInput.isConnected) {
            quoteInput.focus({ preventScroll: shouldScroll });
          }
        }, 30);
      }
    }

    let filteredQuotes = [...mainQuotes];

    if (ui.activeFilter === "BOOKS") {
      filteredQuotes = filteredQuotes.filter(q => q.category === "\u041A\u043D\u0438\u0433\u0430");
      if (ui.selectedBookFilterKey) {
        filteredQuotes = filteredQuotes.filter(q => q.bookFilterKey === ui.selectedBookFilterKey);
      }

      const compareTitles = (a, b) =>
        a.displayTitle.localeCompare(b.displayTitle, "ru", { sensitivity: "base", numeric: true });

      switch (ui.bookSortOrder) {
        case "oldest":
          filteredQuotes.sort((a, b) => a.lineIndex - b.lineIndex);
          break;
        case "title-asc":
          filteredQuotes.sort((a, b) => compareTitles(a, b) || b.lineIndex - a.lineIndex);
          break;
        case "title-desc":
          filteredQuotes.sort((a, b) => compareTitles(b, a) || b.lineIndex - a.lineIndex);
          break;
        case "fav-first":
          filteredQuotes.sort((a, b) => (Number(b.isFavorite) - Number(a.isFavorite)) || b.lineIndex - a.lineIndex);
          break;
        default:
          filteredQuotes.sort((a, b) => b.lineIndex - a.lineIndex);
      }
    } else if (ui.activeFilter === "THOUGHTS") {
      filteredQuotes.sort((a, b) => b.lineIndex - a.lineIndex);
      filteredQuotes = filteredQuotes.filter(q => q.category === "\u041C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u044C");
    }

    if (ui.onlyFavorites) {
      filteredQuotes = filteredQuotes.filter(q => q.isFavorite);
    }

    const limit = ui.showAllQuotes ? filteredQuotes.length : QUOTES_DISPLAY_LIMIT;
    let displayedQuotes = filteredQuotes.slice(0, limit);
    if (ui.showRandom && filteredQuotes.length > 0) {
      const randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * filteredQuotes.length);
      displayedQuotes = [filteredQuotes[randomIndex]];

            "border-left: 3px solid " + accentColor + ";",
            "border-radius: 8px;",
            "display: flex;",
            "flex-direction: column;",
            "justify-content: space-between;",

          ].join(" ")
        }
      });

      if (isEditing) {

            placeholder: "\u0422\u0435\u043A\u0441\u0442 \u0446\u0438\u0442\u0430\u0442\u044B \u0438\u043B\u0438 \u043C\u044B\u0441\u043B\u0438 *",
            style: "width: 100%; font-size: 0.84rem; line-height: 1.4; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 6px; resize: vertical;"
          }
        });
        textArea.value = q.text;

          attr: { type: "button", style: "font-size: 0.74rem; height: 26px; padding: 0 10px;" }

          if (!newText) {

          title: q.isFavorite ? "\u0423\u0431\u0440\u0430\u0442\u044C \u0438\u0437 \u043B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u044B\u0445" : "\u0414\u043E\u0431\u0430\u0432\u0438\u0442\u044C \u0432 \u043B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u044B\u0435",

            (q.isFavorite ? STATUS_COLORS["\u041B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u043E\u0435"] : "var(--text-muted)") + ";"

          favBtn.disabled = false;

        cls: "dh-chip",
        text: "\u270E",
        attr: {
          type: "button",
          title: "\u0420\u0435\u0434\u0430\u043A\u0442\u0438\u0440\u043E\u0432\u0430\u0442\u044C \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u044C",
          style: "font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 1px 6px; height: 20px; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer;"

    if (displayedQuotes.length === 0) {

        },
        text: ui.onlyFavorites
          ? "\u041B\u044E\u0431\u0438\u043C\u044B\u0445 \u0437\u0430\u043F\u0438\u0441\u0435\u0439 \u0432 \u044D\u0442\u043E\u0439 \u0432\u044B\u0431\u043E\u0440\u043A\u0435 \u043F\u043E\u043A\u0430 \u043D\u0435\u0442. \u041D\u0430\u0436\u043C\u0438 \u2661 \u043D\u0430 \u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u043A\u0435."

      if (!ui.showRandom && filteredQuotes.length > QUOTES_DISPLAY_LIMIT) {

        const showMoreQBtn = showMoreQuotesRow.createEl("button", {

            : "\u041F\u043E\u043A\u0430\u0437\u0430\u0442\u044C \u0432\u0441\u0435 (" + filteredQuotes.length + ") \u25BE",

    if (archivedQuotes.length > 0) {

      archDetails.ontoggle = () => { ui.archiveSectionOpen = archDetails.open; };
