    // \u0421\u0415\u041A\u0426\u0418\u042F 4. \u0413\u0420\u0410\u0424\u0418\u041A \u041F\u041E\u0412\u0422\u041E\u0420\u0415\u041D\u0418\u0419
    // =====================================================================
    if (wordsData) {
      const dailySeries = [];
      for (let i = CHART_DAYS - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const dObj = todayDate.minus({ days: i });
        const iso = dObj.toISODate();
        const dPage = diaryByISO.get(iso);
        const fromDiary = dPage && typeof dPage.\u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u0435\u043A_\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0439\u0434\u0435\u043D\u043E === "number" ? dPage.\u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u0435\u043A_\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0439\u0434\u0435\u043D\u043E : 0;
        const fromSR = wordsData.srReviewsByDate.get(iso) || 0;
        const count = iso === todayISO ? savedTodayCount : Math.max(fromDiary, fromSR);
        dailySeries.push({
          iso,
          dateLabel: dObj.toFormat("dd.MM"),
          weekdayLabel: WEEKDAYS_SHORT[dObj.weekday - 1],
          count,
          isToday: iso === todayISO
        });
      }

      const allDatesSet = new Set([
        ...diaryByISO.keys(),
        ...wordsData.srReviewsByDate.keys(),
        todayISO
      ]);
      let allTimeSum = 0;
      let allTimeActiveDays = 0;
      let allTimeRecord = 0;
      for (const iso of allDatesSet) {
        const dPage = diaryByISO.get(iso);
        const fromDiary = dPage && typeof dPage.\u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u0435\u043A_\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0439\u0434\u0435\u043D\u043E === "number" ? dPage.\u043A\u0430\u0440\u0442\u043E\u0447\u0435\u043A_\u043F\u0440\u043E\u0439\u0434\u0435\u043D\u043E : 0;
        const fromSR = wordsData.srReviewsByDate.get(iso) || 0;
        const val = iso === todayISO ? savedTodayCount : Math.max(fromDiary, fromSR);
        if (val > 0) {
          allTimeSum += val;
          allTimeActiveDays++;
          if (val > allTimeRecord) allTimeRecord = val;
        }
      }
      const reviewedCardsInDeck = wordsData.learningDirections + wordsData.matureDirections;
      const totalAllTime = Math.max(allTimeSum, reviewedCardsInDeck);
      const avgPerDay = allTimeActiveDays > 0 ? Math.round(allTimeSum / allTimeActiveDays) : 0;

      const maxVal = Math.max(
        ...dailySeries.map(d => d.count),
        ui.showDailyTargetLine ? currentTarget : 0,
        20
      );

      const chartPanel = root.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-panel" });
      const chartHead = chartPanel.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-section-head" });

      const chartTitleWrap = chartHead.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-section-title" });
      chartTitleWrap.createSpan({ text: "\u0413\u0440\u0430\u0444\u0438\u043A \u043F\u043E\u0432\u0442\u043E\u0440\u0435\u043D\u0438\u0439" });

      const tilesRow = chartHead.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-chart-tiles" });

      const totalTile = tilesRow.createDiv({ cls: "dhe-smooth-tile" });
      totalTile.createSpan({ cls: "dhe-smooth-label", text: "\u0417\u0430 \u0432\u0441\u0451 \u0432\u0440\u0435\u043C\u044F" });

import { App, Component, MarkdownPostProcessorContext, Notice, TFile, moment, normalizePath, requestUrl } from "obsidian";

export interface HubInputParams {
  module: string;
  section?: string;
}

export function parseHubCodeblockSource(source: string): HubInputParams {
  const lines = source
    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .map((l) => l.trim())
    .filter((l) => l.length > 0 && !l.startsWith("#") && !l.startsWith("//"));

  if (lines.length === 1 && !lines[0]?.includes(":")) {
    const parts = (lines[0] ?? "").split(/\s+/);
    return {
      module: (parts[0] ?? "home").toLowerCase(),
      section: parts[1] || "all",
    };
  }

  const res: HubInputParams = { module: "home", section: "all" };
  for (const line of lines) {
    const idx = line.indexOf(":");
    if (idx === -1) continue;
    const key = line.slice(0, idx).trim().toLowerCase();
    const val = line.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "");
    if (key === "module" || key === "hub" || key === "модуль") res.module = val.toLowerCase();
    else if (key === "section" || key === "секция" || key === "mode") res.section = val;
  }
  return res;
}

export class NativeDateWrapper {
  private m: moment.Moment;

  constructor(inp?: unknown) {
    if (inp instanceof NativeDateWrapper) {
      this.m = inp.m.clone();
    } else if (inp === "today") {
      this.m = moment().startOf("day");
    } else if (inp === "now") {
      this.m = moment();
    } else if (typeof inp === "number") {
      this.m = moment(inp);
    } else if (typeof inp === "string") {
      const clean = inp.trim();
      this.m = moment(clean, ["YYYY-MM-DD", moment.ISO_8601], false);
    } else if (inp && typeof inp === "object" && "toISODate" in (inp as Record<string, unknown>)) {
      const iso = (inp as { toISODate: () => string }).toISODate();
      this.m = moment(iso);
    } else {
      this.m = moment.invalid();
    }
  }

  get isValid(): boolean {
    return this.m.isValid();
  }

  get weekday(): number {
    return this.m.isoWeekday();
  }

  get daysInMonth(): number {
    return this.m.daysInMonth();
  }

  startOf(unit: "day" | "month" | "year"): NativeDateWrapper {
    const next = new NativeDateWrapper();
    next.m = this.m.clone().startOf(unit);
    return next;
  }

  minus(opts: { days?: number; months?: number }): NativeDateWrapper {
    const next = new NativeDateWrapper();
    const c = this.m.clone();
    if (opts.days) c.subtract(opts.days, "days");
    if (opts.months) c.subtract(opts.months, "months");
    next.m = c;
    return next;
  }

  plus(opts: { days?: number; months?: number }): NativeDateWrapper {
    const next = new NativeDateWrapper();
    const c = this.m.clone();
    if (opts.days) c.add(opts.days, "days");
    if (opts.months) c.add(opts.months, "months");
    next.m = c;
    return next;
  }

  set(opts: { day?: number }): NativeDateWrapper {
    const next = new NativeDateWrapper();
    const c = this.m.clone();
    if (opts.day !== undefined) c.date(opts.day);
    next.m = c;
    return next;
  }

  setLocale(loc: string): NativeDateWrapper {
    const next = new NativeDateWrapper();
    next.m = this.m.clone().locale(loc);
    return next;
  }

  toISODate(): string {
    return this.m.format("YYYY-MM-DD");
  }

  toMillis(): number {
    return this.m.valueOf();
  }

  valueOf(): number {
    return this.m.valueOf();
  }

  diff(other: NativeDateWrapper, _unit = "days"): { days: number } {
    const diffMs = this.m.valueOf() - other.toMillis();
    return { days: diffMs / 86_400_000 };
  }

  toFormat(fmt: string): string {
    const mapped = fmt
      .replace(/yyyy/g, "YYYY")
      .replace(/yy/g, "YY")
      .replace(/dd/g, "DD")
      .replace(/cccc/g, "dddd")
      .replace(/LLLL/g, "MMMM")
      .replace(/(?<![dD])d(?![dD])/g, "D");
    return this.m.format(mapped);
  }
}

export class NativeDataArray<T> extends Array<T> {
  where(pred: (item: T) => boolean): NativeDataArray<T> {
    const filtered = super.filter(pred);
    return NativeDataArray.fromArray(filtered);
  }

  array(): T[] {
    return Array.from(this);
  }

  static fromArray<U>(arr: U[]): NativeDataArray<U> {
    const inst = new NativeDataArray<U>();
    inst.push(...arr);
    return inst;
  }
}

export function buildDvShim(
  app: App,
  container: HTMLElement,
  ctx: MarkdownPostProcessorContext,
  component: Component
) {
  const pluginsHolder = app as unknown as {
    plugins?: {
      plugins?: Record<string, { api?: Record<string, unknown> }>;
    };
  };
  const realDvApi = pluginsHolder.plugins?.plugins?.["dataview"]?.api as
    | {
        pages?: (q?: string) => unknown[];
        page?: (p: string) => Record<string, unknown>;
        date?: (d: unknown) => unknown;
        isArray?: (v: unknown) => boolean;
      }
    | undefined;

  if (realDvApi && typeof realDvApi.pages === "function") {
    return {
      container,
      component,
      currentFilePath: ctx.sourcePath,
      api: realDvApi,
      current: () => realDvApi.page?.(ctx.sourcePath) ?? { file: { path: ctx.sourcePath } },
      pages: (query?: string) => realDvApi.pages?.(query) ?? [],
      page: (path: string) => realDvApi.page?.(path) ?? null,
      date: (d: unknown) => realDvApi.date?.(d) ?? null,
      isArray: (v: unknown) => Array.isArray(v) || Boolean(realDvApi.isArray?.(v)),
    };
  }

  const buildPageObject = (file: TFile): Record<string, unknown> => {
    const cache = app.metadataCache.getFileCache(file);
    const fm = cache?.frontmatter ? { ...cache.frontmatter } : {};
    const ctimeDate = new NativeDateWrapper(file.stat.ctime);
    const mtimeDate = new NativeDateWrapper(file.stat.mtime);

    return {
      ...fm,
      file: {
        name: file.basename,
        path: file.path,
        folder: file.parent?.path ?? "",
        link: `[[${file.path}|${file.basename}]]`,
        ctime: ctimeDate,
        mtime: mtimeDate,
        cday: ctimeDate.startOf("day"),
        mday: mtimeDate.startOf("day"),
        lists: [],
      },
    };
  };

  return {
    container,
    component,
    currentFilePath: ctx.sourcePath,
    api: {
      table: (headers: string[], rows: unknown[][], targetEl: HTMLElement) => {
        const tbl = targetEl.createEl("table", { cls: "dh-table" });
        const thead = tbl.createEl("thead").createEl("tr");
        headers.forEach((h) => thead.createEl("th", { text: String(h) }));
        const tbody = tbl.createEl("tbody");
        rows.forEach((r) => {
          const tr = tbody.createEl("tr");
          r.forEach((cell) => tr.createEl("td", { text: String(cell ?? "") }));
        });
      },
    },
    current: () => {
      const f = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(ctx.sourcePath);
      if (f instanceof TFile) return buildPageObject(f);
      return { file: { path: ctx.sourcePath, name: ctx.sourcePath } };
    },
    pages: (query?: string) => {
      let folderFilter = "";
      if (typeof query === "string" && query.trim()) {
        folderFilter = query.trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "");
      }
      const files = app.vault.getMarkdownFiles().filter((f) => {
        if (!folderFilter) return true;
        return f.path.startsWith(folderFilter + "/") || f.parent?.path === folderFilter;
      });
      return NativeDataArray.fromArray(files.map(buildPageObject));
    },
    page: (pathOrLink: string) => {
      const clean = pathOrLink.replace(/^\[\[|\]\]$/g, "").trim();
      const direct = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(clean);
      if (direct instanceof TFile) return buildPageObject(direct);
      const dest = app.metadataCache.getFirstLinkpathDest(clean, ctx.sourcePath);
      if (dest instanceof TFile) return buildPageObject(dest);
      return null;
    },
    date: (v: unknown) => {
      const d = new NativeDateWrapper(v);
      return d.isValid ? d : null;
    },
    isArray: (v: unknown) => Array.isArray(v),
  };
}

export async function runBundledHubModule(
  codeBody: string,
  app: App,
  dvShim: ReturnType<typeof buildDvShim>,
  inputObj: { section?: string }
) {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    (window as unknown as { requestUrl?: typeof requestUrl }).requestUrl = requestUrl;
  }
  const obsidianShim = { Notice, normalizePath, requestUrl };

  const AsyncFunction = Object.getPrototypeOf(async function () {}).constructor as new (
    ...args: string[]
  ) => (
    appArg: App,
    dvArg: unknown,
    inputArg: unknown,
    momentArg: typeof moment,
    NoticeArg: typeof Notice,
    obsidianArg: typeof obsidianShim
  ) => Promise<void>;

  const runner = new AsyncFunction(
    "app",
    "dv",
    "input",
    "moment",
    "Notice",
    "obsidian",
    codeBody
  );

  await runner(app, dvShim, inputObj, moment, Notice, obsidianShim);
}

return n;\n    };\n\n    const getPagesRead = p => p ? parseValidNum(p.страниц_прочитано, 0, 1500, true) : null;\n    const getSleepHours = p => p ? parseValidNum(p.сон_часов, 0.5, 24, false) : trimmed.slice(idx + 3).trim();\n    } else if (trimmed.includes(\" - \")) {\n      const idx = trimmed.indexOf(\" - \");\n      qPart = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim();\n      aPart = trimmed.slice(idx + 3).trim();\n    }\n\n    if (qPart && aPart) {\n      const { question, hint } = parseFrontQuestionAndHint(qPart);\n      parsed.push({\n        question: cleanLineText(question),\n        answer: cleanLineText(aPart),\n        hint: cleanLineText(hint),\n        isBi\n      });\n    }\n  }\n  return parsed;\n}\n\nasync function modifyStudyCardLine(card, { newQuestion, newAnswer, newHint, newIsBi, deleteCard = false }) {\n  return enqueueDiskWrite(async () => {\n    const fileObj = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(card.deckPath);\n    if (!fileObj) throw new Error(\"Файл темы не найден.\");\n\n    const rawContent = await app.vault.read(fileObj);\n    const lines = rawContent.split(/\\r?\\n/);\n    const idx = card.lineIndex;\n    if (!lines[idx]) throw new Error(\"Строка не найдена.\");\n\n    if (deleteCard) {\n      if (card.srOnNextLine && lines[idx + 1] && lines[idx + 1].includes(\"<!--SR:\")) {\n        lines.splice(idx, 2);\n      } else {\n        lines.splice(idx, 1);\n      }\n      await app.vault.modify(fileObj, lines.join(\"\\n\"));\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const line = lines[idx];\n    const srIdx = line.indexOf(\"<!--SR:\");\n    const srTail = srIdx !== -1 ? \" \" + line.slice(srIdx).trim() : \"\";\n\n    const sep = newIsBi ? \":::\" : \"::\";\n    const frontPart = newHint ? cleanLineText(newQuestion) + HINT_SEP + cleanLineText(newHint) : cleanLineText(newQuestion);\n    lines[idx] = frontPart + \" \" + sep + \" \" + cleanLineText(newAnswer) + srTail;\n\n    await app.vault.modify(fileObj, lines.join(\"\\n\"));\n  });\n}\n\n// =====================================================================\n// ОТРИСОВКА СЕКЦИИ КАРТОЧЕК\n// =====================================================================\nlet focusQuestionAfterRender = false;\n\nasync function renderCardsSection(cardsContainer, activeProjects) {\n import {
  App,
  MarkdownPostProcessorContext,
  MarkdownRenderChild,
  Notice,
  Plugin,
  PluginSettingTab,
  Setting,
  TFile,
} from "obsidian";
import {
  buildDvShim,
  parseHubCodeblockSource,
  runBundledHubModule,
} from "./shim";
import { BUNDLED_HUB_SCRIPTS } from "./modules";

interface HubPluginSettings {
  scriptsFolder: string;
  autoRefreshOnMetadataChange: boolean;
  refreshDebounceMs: number;
}

const DEFAULT_SETTINGS: HubPluginSettings = {
  scriptsFolder: "Скрипты",
  autoRefreshOnMetadataChange: true,
  refreshDebounceMs: 600,
};

const MODULE_FILE_CANDIDATES: Record<string, string[]> = {
  home: ["home.js", "Скрипты/home.js", "Scripts/home.js"],
  diary: ["diary.js", "Скрипты/diary.js", "Scripts/diary.js"],

  english: ["english_2.js", "english.js", "Скрипты/english.js", "Scripts/english.js"],
};

class HubBlockRenderer extends MarkdownRenderChild {
  plugin: MyDashboardHubsPlugin;
  source: string;
  ctx: MarkdownPostProcessorContext;
  private refreshTimer: number | null = null;
  private isRendering = false;
  private pendingRerender = false;

  constructor(
    containerEl: HTMLElement,
    plugin: MyDashboardHubsPlugin,
    source: string,
    ctx: MarkdownPostProcessorContext
  ) {
    super(containerEl);
    this.plugin = plugin;
    this.source = source;
    this.ctx = ctx;
  }

  onload() {
    this.plugin.activeRenderers.add(this);
    void this.renderBlock();

    if (this.plugin.settings.autoRefreshOnMetadataChange) {
      this.registerEvent(
        this.plugin.app.metadataCache.on("changed", (file) => {
          this.scheduleSmartRefresh(file.path);
        })
      );
    }
  }

  onunload() {
    this.plugin.activeRenderers.delete(this);
    if (this.refreshTimer !== null) {
      window.clearTimeout(this.refreshTimer);
      this.refreshTimer = null;
    }
  }

  scheduleSmartRefresh(_changedPath?: string) {
    if (this.refreshTimer !== null) {
      window.clearTimeout(this.refreshTimer);
    }
    this.refreshTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      this.refreshTimer = null;
      if (!this.containerEl.isConnected) return;

      const activeEl = document.activeElement;
      const isFocusedInside =
        activeEl &&
        (this.containerEl.contains(activeEl) ||
          activeEl.tagName === "INPUT" ||
          activeEl.tagName === "TEXTAREA" ||
          activeEl.tagName === "SELECT");

      if (isFocusedInside || document.querySelector(".modal-container")) {
        return;
      }

      void this.renderBlock();
    }, this.plugin.settings.refreshDebounceMs);
  }

  async renderBlock() {
    if (this.isRendering) {
      this.pendingRerender = true;
      return;
    }
    this.isRendering = true;

    try {
      const params = parseHubCodeblockSource(this.source);
      const codeBody = await this.plugin.resolveModuleScriptCode(params.module);

      if (!codeBody) {
        this.containerEl.empty();
        const err = this.containerEl.createDiv({ cls: "dh-panel" });
        err.setText(
          `Модуль «${params.module}» не найден. Запусти "npm run import" при сборке или проверь папку скриптов в настройках.`
        );
        return;
      }

      const prevHeight = this.containerEl.offsetHeight;
      if (prevHeight > 40) {
        this.containerEl.style.minHeight = `${prevHeight}px`;
      }

      this.containerEl.empty();
      this.containerEl.addClass("dashboard-home", "my-hub-native-container");

      const dvShim = buildDvShim(
        this.plugin.app,
        this.containerEl,
        this.ctx,
        this
      );
      await runBundledHubModule(codeBody, this.plugin.app, dvShim, {
        section: params.section,
      });

      this.containerEl.style.minHeight = "";
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      this.containerEl.style.minHeight = "";
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.stack || err.message : String(err);
      this.containerEl.createDiv({
        text: `Ошибка модуля дашборда: ${msg}`,
        attr: {
          style:
            "padding: 12px; color: #d85b57; background: rgba(216,91,87,0.12); border: 1px solid #d85b57; border-radius: 8px; white-space: pre-wrap; font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.8rem;",
        },
      });
    } finally {
      this.isRendering = false;
      if (this.pendingRerender) {
        this.pendingRerender = false;
        void this.renderBlock();
      }
    }
  }
}

class HubsSettingTab extends PluginSettingTab {
  plugin: MyDashboardHubsPlugin;

  constructor(app: App, plugin: MyDashboardHubsPlugin) {
    super(app, plugin);
    this.plugin = plugin;
  }

  display(): void {
    const { containerEl } = this;
    containerEl.empty();

    containerEl.createEl("h3", { text: "Мои дашборды (Ускоритель)" });

    new Setting(containerEl)
      .setName("Папка со скриптами в хранилище (резервная)")
      .setDesc(
        "Если скрипт не вшит внутрь плагина, плагин может подгружать .js файл напрямую из этой папки хранилища"
      )
      .addText((text) =>
        text
          .setPlaceholder("Скрипты")
          .setValue(this.plugin.settings.scriptsFolder)
          .onChange(async (val) => {
            this.plugin.settings.scriptsFolder = val.trim();
            await this.plugin.saveSettings();
          })
      );

    new Setting(containerEl)
      .setName("Автообновление при изменении заметок")
      .setDesc(
        "Автоматически обновлять карточки и счётчики в фоне (без сброса фокуса в полях ввода)"
      )
      .addToggle((toggle) =>
        toggle
          .setValue(this.plugin.settings.autoRefreshOnMetadataChange)
          .onChange(async (val) => {
            this.plugin.settings.autoRefreshOnMetadataChange = val;
            await this.plugin.saveSettings();
          })
      );
  }
}

export default class MyDashboardHubsPlugin extends Plugin {
  settings!: HubPluginSettings;
  activeRenderers = new Set<HubBlockRenderer>();

  async onload() {
    this.settings = Object.assign({}, DEFAULT_SETTINGS, await this.loadData());
    this.addSettingTab(new HubsSettingTab(this.app, this));

    this.registerMarkdownCodeBlockProcessor("my-hub", (source, el, ctx) => {
      const child = new HubBlockRenderer(el, this, source, ctx);
      ctx.addChild(child);
    });

    const shortModules = ["home", "diary", "health", "study", "3d", "english"];
    for (const modName of shortModules) {
      this.registerMarkdownCodeBlockProcessor(
        `my-${modName}`,
        (source, el, ctx) => {
          const trimmed = source.trim();
          const fullSource = trimmed
            ? `module: ${modName}\nsection: ${trimmed}`
            : `module: ${modName}`;
          const child = new HubBlockRenderer(el, this, fullSource, ctx);
          ctx.addChild(child);
        }
      );
    }

    this.addCommand({
      id: "refresh-active-hubs",
      name: "Обновить все открытые дашборды",
      callback: () => {
        for (const r of this.activeRenderers) {
          void r.renderBlock();
        }
        new Notice("Дашборды обновлены");
      },
    });
  }

  async resolveModuleScriptCode(moduleName: string): Promise<string | null> {
    const key = moduleName.toLowerCase().trim();

    const bundled = BUNDLED_HUB_SCRIPTS[key];
    if (bundled && bundled.length > 10) {
      return bundled;
    }

    const folder = this.settings.scriptsFolder.replace(/\/+$/, "");
    const candidates = [
      ...(folder ? [`${folder}/${key}.js`] : []),
      ...(MODULE_FILE_CANDIDATES[key] ?? [`${key}.js`]),
    ];

    for (const candidatePath of candidates) {
      const file = this.app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(candidatePath);
      if (file instanceof TFile) {
        try {
          return await this.app.vault.cachedRead(file);
        } catch {
          // Игнорируем
        }
      }
    }

    return null;
  }

  async saveSettings() {
    await this.saveData(this.settings);
  }
}
